Meanwhile, the martial practitioners from the western Wulin have gathered here, feeling the decline of the righteous and the rampant evil. Thus, they aspire to emulate you by forming a blood oath alliance to jointly resist the demons and uphold justice.
Whatever, it's not me being humiliated, heh. I'll just stand aside and keep quiet, it's not my business.
Why hasn't the head of the Nangong family responded yet?
I can't very well say that none of them are heroes.
Well...
Impressive—that trick of ganging up on the outnumbered, learned straight from Monk Shi Ming. Turn his own method back on him, and let's see you all taste a bit of that squeezed-out feeling too.

What the benefactors say is much the same as what this monk thought—great heroes truly do see eye to eye. Since we are all heroes united in purpose, those who oppose us clearly cannot be heroes. Benefactor Nangong, do you count as a hero?
This humble monk said that the king he mentioned is merely a foolish person of the mortal world, naturally not as wise and perceptive as King Sabodai.
Moreover, we haven't even received our salary from the Imperial Court yet. Do they think they can just take a piece of us? What a pipe dream!
Damn it, that was close. Luckily, I am in the Great Song and not born in a country ruled by such a tyrant!

Kill one guard today, and tomorrow the eagle comes back clutching a pigeon, asking the king for meat again—will he have to kill yet another guard? Just how much does the king owe that eagle in food, anyway?
Right! What's the king doing, going around saving pigeons when he's got nothing better to do? Pigeons are eagle food by nature—why the needless meddling!
Of course it's that king's fault! Why should he get to kill just because he feels like it?
Well said, well said, the benefactor has wisdom. The king I spoke of is merely a foolish person in this worldly realm, naturally not comparable to King Saboda's wisdom and understanding.
Ying'er, now even you are of one mind with this monk.
If it were in the past, Ying'er would never allow me to suffer such humiliation in front of others.

Hearing the Dharma Master's words opened my eyes — now that you mention it, I did think it strange. Doves are meant to be prey for hawks; why should the king go meddling in that! Kill one guard today, and tomorrow the hawk comes back demanding meat again — will he have to kill another guard then?
Miss Shangguan speaks well!
What Lady Ying said is absolutely correct, well said!

The dove's ordeal is the working of cause and effect — this is the hardship marked in its fate. As for the king the Dharma Master speaks of, who meddles with cause and effect on a whim yet shifts the karma onto another while reaping the reward himself — that is both unwise and lacking virtue. That is precisely why that king could never become King Saboda, but only a tyrant without virtue! A hypocrite!

King Saboda cut his flesh to feed the hawk because he saw all beings lost in blind ignorance — not perceiving the Three Jewels, nor hearing the Buddha's teaching, indulging their hearts in ruinous deeds, casting themselves into the hell without escape. Seeing such folly, he was moved to sorrow and vowed to seek Buddhahood, to deliver all beings from their suffering and bring them to Nirvana.
It is naturally the king's fault!

This monk asks all you heroes: the guard has elders at home and children below; even a man alone in the world still fears pain. How could he ever be willing to die? Pushed to the brink, he'd have no choice but to rebel. Is that truly the guard's fault — or is it the king's lack of virtue that brought it about?
This...

Benefactor Nangong, today you would sacrifice yourself for the greater good and win the whole world's admiration. But you yourself suffer not the slightest harm, while urging others to end their own lives to fulfill this so‑called greater good — that is indeed worth questioning.

Because all beings are equal, the guard too is one of them — a man favored by King Saboda's own grace. Given any chance to live, he surely would not go to his death gladly; dying with fear and resentment in his heart, far from earning merit, he might even incur the karma of killing. Can this still be called the greater good?

So this monk asks the benefactor: why did King Saboda not do this? Was he truly so foolish that even this monk could think of it, while his own great wisdom could not? Or is it that the story in the Buddhist scriptures simply cannot stand scrutiny? ──Neither.
That guard ate the king's bread, and by giving his life to save the king, he may be said to have died a worthy death. Even the Commoners' welfare owes him some credit — what fine fortune for him!

You mention the dead guards? Who cares about them? The death of ten guards doesn't compare to the importance of one king. After all, it's not their own flesh being cut, so it doesn't hurt; this is for the greater good!
Uh.
Huh?

King Saboda's subjects number in the millions — and if the dove absolutely must be saved, why not simply summon a guard to die in its place? That way the dove is saved, the hawk is fed, and the king lives on. Wouldn't everyone be pleased?
The stories in the Buddhist scriptures are meant to be parables; why take them so literally? Isn't Master Fu Yun just shooting himself in the foot?
Hey, Nangong family believes in the Dao, yet you come to ask me about your Buddhist stories?

As the ruler of a nation, King Saboda carried a body worth ten thousand in gold — the whole country's rise and fall rested on him alone. It's rare indeed for one in his place to hold such compassion for the Commoners; if he had died, to whom would the people have turned? Yet the king actually maimed himself just to save one dove — is that not strange?
Dharma Master, why say such a thing? I only urge everyone to lay down their blades and spare the peace of heaven — is that truly wrong?
Oh, wow... is it really that ruthless?

You inherited the seat of Nangong Family Head, but not the Nangong family's heart. You look the part of a Great Hero, cloaked in that fine cape and cutting a striking figure — but it's gilt over rot: however broad your pauldrons, they can't bear real weight. You're no Great Worthy Nangong — just Nangong, wanting for virtue.
What tone is that? The one this monk admires is Great Worthy Nangong — Old Patriarch Nangong, the former family head, Great Hero Nangong Yuan. Not you, Benefactor.
Dharma Master, you flatter me. This Nangong is merely──

Nangong Dade's compassionate wishes are likewise profound; although not a monk, they possess a great heart of compassion. Revered as a mediator in Jianghu and the heart of the Wulin, they have friends all over the world, and no one fails to respect them. Within the temple, the masters and elders all hold Nangong in high regard, and this humble monk has always admired them greatly.

As for what Benefactor Nangong just said, this monk cannot agree. In the Six Perfections Sutra, there is a story of King Saboda, who made a great vow and cut his own flesh to feed a hawk, to save a dove. King Saboda gave himself to deliver all beings, embracing every hardship gladly, for his heart held great compassion.
This is nothing more than saying that if you can't win someone in a debate, you resort to violence!

It is indeed the Eighteen Bronze Men of Songshan. Each of the Eighteen Bronze Men favors a different weapon — blade, spear, staff, sword, shovel — and this monk's weapon is his mouth. This monk will first seek guidance from Benefactor Nangong; should I fall in defeat, my fellow brothers stand ready to challenge you in turn!
Songshan Eighteen Bronze Men?

Amituofo, Benefactor Zhao, leave this to me; you step aside. This monk has transformed into gold, which is not an ordinary state. I fear that if I speak carelessly, I might inadvertently harm our allies.
Fu Yun Dharma──Master...?
Benefactor Nangong, your words are mistaken. This monk, Fu Yun, dares to offer a humble opinion before the heroes of the land.
Counterargument
There's nothing much to say
Hypocritical sophistry
Fu Yun: The time to speak has come.
His words left everyone feeling anxious. If everyone took it to heart, the Western Wulin Alliance might never come to fruition and could die before it even began.
He was clearly doing it on purpose.
Is that so? I apologize.
No, what I mean is... Nangong Family Head, you retreated too quickly and the pauldron poked me.
Hmm? Are you scolding me?
Damn!
Exactly! Kneel and kowtow in apology right now, and the Alliance Leader and I might just be willing to show you mercy beyond the law.
Zhao Huo, why are you all so stubborn, willing to ignore the bigger picture? Can you answer that? If not, it would be better to disperse early.
Brother Zhao, come tell me, whether you believe it or not, I am truly curious. Why are you all so stubborn?
Zhao Huo, you must not let that person suppress you.
How can this be...
Moreover, I am also filled with confusion in my heart, and like the Eldest Young Lord, I would like to hear how the heroes of the Tang Clan would respond.
The younger sister indeed has the words to argue and can easily refute the Eldest Young Lord. However, at this moment, it should not be her place to intervene.
Zhao Di, you've never lost a debate against him — it's all up to you now. Hurry and take him down!
How can this person be so talkative? What should we do about it?

The Eldest Young Lord's words are indeed not without merit. The national grievances and personal enmities have yet to be avenged; if we consider the well‑being of the people, we should value harmony and unite against external threats. Is it truly appropriate for us to lightly initiate war?
Y-yeah, that's right! That's exactly what I was going to say!

Third Master Tang! Any discerning eye can see the vast gulf in strength between our two sides—stubborn resistance will only mean dying for nothing! If you lay down your weapons and surrender now, sparing this needless slaughter, you can atone through service in days to come—our Nangong family will vouch for you with our full word!

Taking advantage of the chaos in the Western Wulin Alliance before the conflict escalates, let us bring this to a peaceful conclusion. I, Nangong Shen, hereby guarantee that with the mercy of the Alliance Leader, while the mastermind will not be lightly pardoned, the accomplices will not be pursued too deeply!
If you still have the spirit of chivalry, you should understand the greater righteousness and quickly abandon the darkness to embrace the light!

Brothers of the Tang Clan, it isn't too late to rein in your steeds at the cliff's edge. Our two families have been friends for generations—we should stand shoulder to shoulder, not at each other's throats. There must be another way. Put down your weapons, and let us work out a fair and just solution together.
With the wisdom and magnanimity of the Alliance Leader, he will surely discern right from wrong.
Everyone here is a person of benevolence and chivalry, and you should all understand the greater cause. While no blades have yet been drawn, let us lay down our arms right now!

Today's battle will only betray our Nangong vow of Great Harmony. Wounds taken in needless strife, deaths that should never have come to pass—and all the while we let the Demon Cult run free, plunging our Great Song into a world turned upside down. Faced with such a tragedy, I ask you all, who call yourselves heroes in name only: why do you merely stand by and watch!

The heroic souls of the martyrs who sacrificed themselves for the nation are not far away, yet the righteous of the Wulin cannot unite in strength. Instead, they are incited by treacherous individuals, leading to infighting and conflict within the Eastern and Western Wulin, which is truly lamentable.

These people probably can't grasp the situation; they won't realize their impending doom until it's too late. When you rabble see the might of our Wulin Alliance, you'll all wet your pants! By then, not a single one of you will escape; you'll all meet your end!

And yet look at you, gathered here at the Tang Family Compound, calling yourselves the Western Wulin Alliance—what do you truly want? Is whatever you're fighting for, that you'd defy the sage's own edict, truly worth wagering your lives?

I only ask you all: the righteous of the Wulin gathers at Fengyu Mountain, feeling the internal troubles and external threats faced by the Great Song. Therefore, they swear an oath of blood to unite against evil and bind the fate of the nation to themselves, holding the great righteousness and justification in their hands.

...Today, the Tang Clan holds a Wulin Assembly here, and heroes from every corner have gathered to join this grand occasion. I, Nangong, am honored to attend such a splendid event as well—since such pleasantries could go on and on much the same, allow me to skip the customary three hundred words for today.

Sect Leader Tang, the Tang Clan and Nangong have always been family friends, yet today they stand as enemies. Someone from Nangong has come to request the Alliance Leader's permission to act as a mediator, hoping to reason with them and turn hostility into peace, thus avoiding a bloody conflict. I ask everyone to please listen to my words patiently.
Brother Zhao, I have sought the permission of the Alliance Leader to come and make a plea. You may need to hear some words that might not be pleasant, so I ask that you listen patiently to my words.
Thank you, Lord Song
...Zhao Huo, my duty requires me to be impartial and to ensure fairness at all costs. You should take care of yourself.

I have come here solely to witness, to prevent any unscrupulous individuals from inciting the masses and creating confusion. As long as you maintain your boundaries and do not harm the people in the slightest, I will merely observe and not intervene. Conversely, if there are any injustices, I will not remain silent.

I have come here solely to witness and uphold justice. As long as you, the people of the Wulin, strictly adhere to your boundaries and do not infringe upon the common folk, I will remain a mere observer and will not intervene with a word or a gesture.
I must go back and report this. As soon as I return, I will immediately tell the Alliance Leader! Just wait and see, Nangong Shen, I want you dead!
I bear the weighty task of persuading you to surrender; I'm not here to brawl. You useless oaf, get out of the way if you're no help, and stop your prattling.
Wait a moment, Nangong Family Head, why are you calling this person brother? Are we still going to fight the Tang Clan today?
Where does all this nonsense and empty flattery come from?
No, it's not that. This Zhao dare not presume such an honor.

Why such a surprised look? Don't you have the surname Zhao? Or is it that you no longer consider me your brother? Because on Fengyu Mountain, I was forced by circumstances and couldn't speak up for the Tang Clan.
Why the surprised look? Don't you have the surname Zhao? Or are you no longer considering me a brother? On Fengyu Mountain, I stood by your side against the majority.
Uh
Brother Zhao, how have you been?
Are you two here to act as negotiators?
Greetings, Great Hero Nangong; greetings, Lord Song.
Yes
Junior Brother, let me handle this
Hmph!
I got hit, I'm a little rattled, my stomach's churning, and I need to take a shit. Why don't you go instead?

...Weren't you boasting in front of the Alliance Leader that you have a silver tongue and can talk your way out of anything, wanting to become a negotiator at the Tang Family Compound? Why aren't you saying anything now?
Cluck
That son of a bitch, that corrupt official — bastard.
Oh, I thought... well, never mind.

Do you think this official is so foolish and incompetent that you can provoke them? If you consider yourself a common person, you should keep your mouth shut and stay away from this place of conflict. Officials and Imperial Soldiers protect the Commoners, and it is not for you to act with false authority! If you dare to test this official again, be careful with your tongue!
But I have no sect or school and haven't practiced martial arts; I'm as powerless as a Commoner. If they strike me, haven't they violated the Tang Clan's taboo?
This official has seen it, and also witnessed you provoking and seeking a beating yourself.
I didn't see it
You dare to hit me! Nangong family head, Lord Song, you all saw it, they hit me!

Hmph, what's wrong with that? You're already half a foot in the coffin, so why are you still being stubborn? Am I supposed to be afraid of you? I'm just going to move forward, so what? What are you going to do about it?
Nangong Family Head, please hold on! You've come uninvited — if you continue forward, that wouldn't be proper, would it?
Don't speak of people so barbarically. The Wulin Alliance is a righteous alliance, and even when dealing with evil and heretical forces, they believe in courtesy before conflict.
That's funny, you're quite skilled! Come on, let's see who wins. Are you brave enough?

Don't panic. We are acting righteously and sitting upright, with a clear conscience. There is no need to feel anxious at this gathering. They simply want to rely on their strength to bully us, but the heroes present are not the kind to fear for their lives.

Every household in the town has shut its doors, and the streets are eerily silent, filled with a chilling atmosphere. In contrast, that group of people is all eager and restless, ready to spring into action, constantly proclaiming their intent to punish the wicked and eliminate evil. They are just waiting for the Alliance Leader's command to storm the Outer Fort and invade the main courtyard.
Sect Leader, what should we do now?
See you later
See you later, Fourth Senior Brother
Alright, go ahead. We'll see each other again, my brothers.
Of course, it's not about running away
They're here? Then I suppose it's about time I head down and get ready.

Reporting to the Sect Leader, they have arrived... The people from the Wulin Alliance have truly come. They have surrounded Meishan Town, with various factions represented in different attire, a sea of people. Even the officials and Imperial Soldiers have formed a formation under the pretext of protecting Commoners, and the display is no less grand than that of the Battle of Jiangling!
It can't be helped

I am just as anxious, but the more so, the more I should remain calm. The road to Qinzhou is long, and it's uncertain if there will be delays along the way. The time has not yet come, and people are still arriving one after another. Let's be patient a little longer.

Two junior disciples, please remain calm. Am I not also anxious? But the more anxious we are, the more we should stay composed. The road to Qinzhou is long, and it is possible that there are delays along the way. The time has not yet come, and people are still arriving one after another. Let us be patient a little longer.

I see that you all are calm and composed; it turns out I'm not the only one worrying. They should have set out earlier; they should have arrived a few days ago, yet there is still no sign of them. Could it be that they changed their minds at the last minute?
Has there been no news at all from the Kongtong Sect? The junior disciples who went north to meet them haven't signaled or sent any messages; that's quite strange.
She went with the sisters to meet up with Kongtong — she should have been back by now, yet there's still no word, and it's leaving me sick with worry.
What is Xiaozhu so busy with? She still hasn't returned home.
Where on earth has Xiaomei gone? If she doesn't come back soon, I might not even get to see her one last time.
It's just talk, don't get worked up
Absolutely not! That way lies the loss of public support, and the Western Wulin Alliance will collapse on its own.
Third Senior Brother, are you trying to have her taken now so that the Wulin Alliance Leader will be hesitant to act?
She really left without another word.
If that's the case, then let's part ways here.

We appreciate Heroine Nan's good intentions.
There's no need to go to such lengths—please, go back.

We're grateful for Heroine Nan's good intentions.
But even if we trust you, that doesn't mean everyone in the Western Wulin Alliance will feel the same.
This is indeed true; those who believe will always have faith.
There's no need to make it so complicated; those who don't understand won't believe even if given a token.
Wait a moment, shouldn't we discuss a token of trust? What if our allies mistake you for an enemy?

Well, that's the gist of it. I came up the mountain just to give you word:
the Wulin Alliance's official envoy will arrive soon, and I must be on my way.

...There are also people within the Wulin Alliance working to clear the Tang Clan's name.
But they're all useless, just flailing about for nothing.
Best I keep this to myself, lest someone go soft when the fighting starts.
That would be our honor
So I will do you a favor first. In the future, when I return to Lingnan to eliminate the traitors, I hope your esteemed family can lend me a helping hand.
It's no problem; what Young Hero Zhao said is also the truth. If it were that easy, I wouldn't have been forced to travel north.
Junior Brother! How can you say such a thing! Where is your restraint!

That's a tall order. I've only ever heard that a single rat dropping can ruin a pot of porridge,
never that a single grain of rice can fix a pot of dung.
Indeed, let everyone witness that today I, Nan Xi, will cleanse the name of Lingnan.
You, you are the heir of the Seven Stars Sword Master? The authentic inheritance of the Lingnan Sect!
The direct heir of the Seven Stars Sword Master, Nan Xi—I swear on the Seven Stars Sword, I will not let you down.
...On Fengyu Mountain, the heroes of the Wulin might doubt their peers due to rumors. Yet, the Tang Clan heroes possess a different magnanimity, truly splendid and fearless.
If Junior Brother trusts you, then I, Tang Laosan, have nothing more to say.

Alright, since you're all ganging up on me, I'll believe you too.
What else can I do, anyway?
Third Senior Brother, even you...
If Junior Brother trusts you, then I, Tang Laosan, have nothing more to say.
I do.
Junior Brother, you believe her?
I trust you
Do not trust Nan Xi
Believe in Nan Xi
How is it? Have you thought it over? Just say it plainly in one sentence, no need to be long‑winded.
She shared a bed with the Wulin Alliance Leader, yet how could I trust her?

She's the wife of the Wulin Alliance Leader—of course she'd be in league with the Wulin Alliance.
Yet how could I ever trust her?

One must always be cautious of others; no normal person has ever emerged from the Lingnan Sect.
How can I trust that she isn't just as bad, merely hiding it deeper?
Don't say things that can be misunderstood!
Not only that, you also helped me dispose of the body, so we are accomplices.
It's just a fleeting connection
This... Junior Brother, you have a history with Heroine Nan. What do you think?
If you suspect that I have ulterior motives, that's fair enough—just treat it as though I was never here. It's that simple.
No, I fear trouble. Let's speak plainly and simply. If Sect Leader Tang trusts me, I will go to help defend the Outer Fort.
...Junior Brother, may I have a word?
The most self‑willed Tang Clan Disciple under the heavens has the nerve to speak to me.
You're really far too self-willed.
I won't explain. He can think whatever he likes.
How will Heroine Nan explain her association with the Western Wulin to her husband?
You...
After all, the Lingnan Sect still owes you a favor.
Young Hero Zhao didn't say that good Lingnan disciples are too silent, right? So here I am.
...You're not joking, are you?
There isn't any
Third Senior Brother, be careful; there must be a trick!
Join the Western Wulin Alliance
Heroine Nan arrives uninvited. What brings you here?
You two, step back
Senior Brother, this woman is one of the Wulin Alliance Leader's lovers!
Sister Xiang?
Who is coming?
Sect Leader, we really can't stop her — she's coming.
Heroine, stop! If you don't halt, I, I might have to take action!
I'm too fat, and I don't have any clothes that fit me right now, so I might as well let it go.
Weren't you saying you'd change and make a run for it?
Alright, I'm back
Alright, we'll see each other again
Brother, we will meet again
...My thanks, Sect Leader Tang. There's no time to lose — I'll set off now. Farewell.
What do you mean by trustworthiness? We've known each other for such a long time!

The Cangsong Swordsman Ye Yunzhou humbly petitions Sect Leader Tang. I have already severed all ties with Diancang. If the Great Heroes of the Tang Clan trust me, I ask leave to serve as a gatekeeper at the Outer Fort, so that no petty thieves may cause trouble.
She shared a carriage with the Little Divine Doctor, which should not be jostled. However, with the great battle between the Eastern and Western Wulin approaching, I decided to come on ahead.
Where is Shang'er now?

Yes, it cannot be permanently cured at the moment. But Little Divine Doctor has another effective method to suppress it. Thanks to Second Hero Tang's skillful and compassionate hands, using medicinal cuisine for long-term care, he laid the groundwork for Yunshang's rescue. As long as she doesn't die, there will always be hope. With a few more years, she is bound to recover completely.
Yunshang has been saved?!
Oh... oh! That means...

Thanks to the medicine gifted by Heroine Tang Fang, the Ye siblings traveled a thousand miles to Jin in search of a doctor. After enduring many hardships, they finally met the little divine doctor, Doctor Liang, and sought her help to treat their younger sister.
Sect Leader, please wait — this is not the time for idle chat.
Quick, quick, someone go call Shang'er over

To keep Ye from bringing reckless trouble down on the Tang Clan, I've spent this time living quietly in some remote village, keeping a low profile - which is why word reached me late, and only now have I returned to repay the debt.
Young Hero Ye, you... you went away and there was no news at all. Everyone was very concerned about you.
Benefactor, you may simply call me Yunzhou; the title of Great Hero belongs to the Tang Clan.
Great Hero Ye!
Brother Ye!
It has been a while since we last communicated. How have Master Tang and Great Hero Zhao been?
He's back - I'll leave the two of you to it.
I was wrong, Senior Sister, please forgive me... oh.
Are you looking down on my determination? A mere outsider disciple!
What are you thinking? You can't do it. Hey!
Good idea, I will take care of it right away.

That makes sense. During the battle, remember to hide well. Or you could simply change into different clothes and go down the mountain to seek refuge. The Wulin Alliance probably won't cause you any trouble.
I've lost all my martial arts - would I just be a nuisance, staying here?
Who has arrived? You seem so surprised. It's actually you, Junior Sister, who has been holed up in the alchemy room for quite a long time without showing your face.
Senior Brother, Junior Brothers! Can you guess who has arrived?
I figured they wouldn't be reasonable, so I decided to climb up high and keep an eye on their movements.
Fourth Senior Brother, don't speak carelessly. Killing is killing, and blinking is blinking; they cannot be confused. When I decide to kill, I won't show any mercy, whether I blink or not.
Don't act like you've quit; aren't you the one who kills without blinking?
No matter how many or how few others there are, once they arrive, they shouldn't expect to leave unscathed. Today, I must unleash a massacre!

If they could have a good heart, they wouldn't have forced the Palace Mistress of Jinxiang Palace to her death at the Wulin Assembly, nor would they have believed the words of the evil monk and made things difficult for our sect. Being overly polite would only serve to diminish their own prestige.

What Great Hero Xie said is indeed true; it is wise to show courtesy before resorting to arms. However, the visitors are not benevolent and have arrived uninvited, so we must never let our guard down.
Third Hero Tang, what nonsense are you talking? Who has the patience for such fine distinctions?

They are also people of the Wulin. If they wish to participate in the Western Wulin Assembly, then they are guests. However, if they come with the intention of causing trouble, they will be turned away at the door.
It won't be so easy for them to storm up here; the Tang Clan still has the Outer Fort.
I went to scout around - the Wulin Alliance's men are all itching for a fight, looking set to storm the mountain any moment.
Sin upon sin. Today this monk has steeled his heart, determined to break his vow of clean speech.
Can you stop being so serious and talking nonsense?

Amituofo, then this humble monk shall go borrow the lacquer. I'll take your gold lacquer and never give it back, but turn it on the wicked instead - that's called borrowing flowers to offer the Buddha. Once we've beaten them till they spit blood and splatter it across the Tang Clan's ground, that's called the cycle of cause and effect.
So the eminent monks of Songshan have been hiding their true skill all along - with the Eighteen Bronze Men backing them, that's truly reassuring!
Exactly - the Eighteen Bronze Men's Luohan Formation. Each man wields a staff, drawn up in ranks ahead: monks can't step out of the Wooden Man Alley, and laymen can't set foot in the Luohan Hall.
Could it be that the Eighteen Bronze Men of Songshan are making a comeback in Jianghu?
The infamous Eighteen Bronze Men of Songshan!
For us eighteen Songshan brothers - to paint on our bodies, for courage and to save face.
There is indeed some in the alchemy chamber. May I ask, Dharma Master, what you need it for?
Amituofo, may I ask, Benefactor, does the Tang Clan have any golden lacquer? It's urgent.
...Sigh, got it.
It is indeed a time that calls for everyone working together; it's not as though the culprit is someone we cannot live under the same sky with. Junior Brother, just be patient for now.

The death of Eldest Senior Brother is not directly attributable to Gang Leader Shi, though he bears some responsibility. He sincerely repented and knelt before Eldest Senior Brother's grave. Not to mention that in the Jianghu, life and death are determined by fate; furthermore, since Eldest Senior Brother did his utmost to help you, he would likely not wish for you to bear a grudge anymore.
...Hmph.
The debt for Eldest Senior Brother's death — we'll settle it after the Wulin Assembly.
They are particularly easy to deceive and can be sold anything worthless.
I also admire such people.
Speaking so directly is quite refreshing.
...Thank you. To be honest, I admire him for that, too. Everything worth saying has already been said by our Gang Leader, so I won't add more. Please, go ahead.
Lady Shi spoke too harshly. Gang Leader Shi is a genuine and passionate fellow, a fine man well worth admiring.
I'm sorry, this uncouth oaf has no manners at all.
Shi Gongyuan!
Master Tang, Brother Zhao, there's no need for any formalities; I, Old Shi, will support you to the end.
Reporting to the Sect Leader, the Flying Stone Gang Leader and his wife have arrived, along with the gang members.
Those who came with me have all received the favor of the Tang Clan. If we don't repay this kindness now, when will we? Let's go all out; at worst, we will fight for our lives against them.

You probably don't know that before I joined Qingcheng to practice cultivation, I was an outer disciple of the Tang Clan. If that status still holds any weight, you all should address me as Martial Uncle.
This... you all...
And this time I came with a dozen or so Qingcheng disciples to attend. They all believe in the Tang Clan's innocence. If we are killed by the Wulin Alliance, it will be our own doing.
For the Daoist to say such a thing shows real breadth of spirit.
Sigh, it should be this way. Since it was a decision made on their own, they should also bear the consequences. There's no reason for the Great Hero of the Tang Clan to take risks and show mercy.

They don't even realize they're feeding money to their own enemy - I've bled them dry before a single blow is struck! Fleeced them raw, hahahaha!

The more prestigious the sect, the more they value their reputation; they always need a place to settle down. If they don't want to sleep rough in the wilderness, they have to pay up. Why shouldn't I take this opportunity to raise the price? After all, the woodshed can serve as the main room for rent!

I am not crazy; I am ecstatic. It is largely thanks to Miss Shangguan's foresight that I was able to buy up the small inns and vacant houses in the neighboring village and town at a bargain price ahead of time.
Well, it's been hard on him. Give him a stick of Dream-Returning Incense and let him sleep.
Third Senior Brother, Fourth Senior Brother is laughing - he's lost his mind.
Regardless of who wins or loses, the inns in every village and town around Shu are about to make a fortune - hahaha!
Listen to him bragging - this guy is all mouth, able to boast to the heavens. In a real fight, he wouldn't last more than a few blinks before he's dead, wouldn't he.
Haha, now that's the kind of spirit I like to see!
Don't panic, you all take on as many as you can, and I'll handle the rest.
Senior Brother, how can you still be smiling? Each of them spits at us, and we would drown. Even if we each fought ten of them, they would still have some left over.
There are quite a few people here.
Is it true...? This number sounds really shocking. How did you count it? Don't just count randomly because there are a lot of people; that only boosts others' confidence while diminishing your own.
Don't even think about running away!
Ah, enough, brothers. The green mountains remain unchanged, and the rivers flow eternally. I will remember to offer incense for you. Farewell for now.
Junior Brother, calm down a bit.
That's ridiculous! The Tang Clan and the Commoners of Meishan Town combined might not even number that many! What are they even fighting for?
Don't think about running away! If you're going to run, at least take me with you!
Ah, enough, brothers. The green mountains remain unchanged, and the rivers flow eternally. I will remember to offer incense for you. Farewell for now.
Junior Brother, calm down a bit; disaster cannot be avoided.
It's over... I'm definitely done for this time! This really wasn't a good idea. No, I need to think of a way out.
So many people!
Alright, then I really won't say anything anymore.
You! Ugh, this is outrageous—you really are something else.

This is to commemorate the opportunity that led to the birth of the New Demon Cult. At that time, everyone will know that it was you who insisted on driving me out of the Tang Clan, which ultimately resulted in so many deaths.
Absolutely not, have you lost your mind! Why are you using my name!
I've got it all planned out. If I go down the mountain, I'll found a New Demon Cult! And I'll call it the Tang Sheng Cult!
This...

I have left home, and this foreign land is not a place where I belong. Even though my heart is dark, I do not wish to blend in with the world; I only abide by the rules of the Tang Clan. Do you really want to let me descend the mountain and become a scourge to the nation and its people?
Ever since I was young, I've run from every beating—but no matter what, I've always wanted to play the hero, just once. Don't be so tactless and keep nagging me.
I did say that.

Third Senior Brother, didn't you just say recently? A hero is not swayed by fame and fortune, seeking only to live without regret. Even if we have seen the end, we must hold our heads high and finish this journey.
Why go through this again?
Are you serious?
I can always divorce her, drive her away, and return to being all alone.
Out of the question.
You already have your own family and connections, so why not...
That's right... The sect leader said that if I want to stay, no one can force me to leave.
Master's Wife instructed you to handle matters, and you have seen them through. You owe Tang Clan nothing.
That's very good. As for you, Junior Brother Zhao...
I have taken Third Senior Brother's valuable advice to heart; I will pack my belongings right away.
Don't try to persuade me to go down the mountain and live in hiding, just to survive in a cowardly way.
I have something to say, and it's the same old refrain. You'll probably think me tedious for repeating myself yet again. But as your Senior Brother, I still have to say it once more.
What's going on?
‑Junior Brother.
Sigh... in the end, it has turned out like this.
What's going on?
—Junior Brothers, both of you.
Sigh... in the end, it has turned out like this.
What do you think?
It's over?
Dear Senior Brothers, thank you all for your support. No matter whether I succeed or fail tomorrow, I will not regret joining the Tang Clan.
Okay.
Junior Brother, you have worked hard on your journey. Please take a rest.

If we really must name someone, it would only be the Flying Stone Gang.
Their Gang Leader thumped their chest and vowed it to us, but who knows if they'll actually show up to die tomorrow.

As for us... even with everyone mobilized, our numbers don't reach a tenth of theirs.
We've worn our tongues out pleading, yet still no one is willing to stand with us.

The brothers went out to scout — there are Wulin martial artists from every sect, all within half a day's journey of Meishan Town.
They've surrounded Meishan Town from every direction, with the great sects marching in force, and more still arriving.
By the look of it, there must be at least two or three thousand of them!

This is not pedantry — it is protecting the honor of our sect.
We do not fear what others say, so long as we ourselves act with honor.
Third Senior Brother, you are being a bit old‑fashioned.

Absolutely not — if you act now, you'll only cement the Tang Clan's reputation for evil.
Even if a clash is unavoidable, we show courtesy before resorting to arms; we mustn't forfeit the moral high ground.

If you had told me sooner, I'd have struck first.
Watch me poison them — before the fight even starts, I'll have half of them dead already.
Why didn't you say so earlier?

Recently, there have been suspicious newcomers in Meishan Town, inquiring about information.
They don't dare to directly encroach on Tang Clan territory, but are scattered instead among the neighboring villages and towns.
Well, this isn't bad news; we anticipated that they would come to cause trouble.
They really came...!
The bad news is that the Wulin Alliance has arrived as scheduled.
What is meant to come will eventually arrive.
I'll listen to some bad news first, and then I'll listen to the good news later to adjust my mood.
Third Senior Brother, you are being too negative.
Let's hear the bad news first.
Would you like to hear the bad news first or the good news?
Sigh, Senior Brothers, you'd best brace yourselves — I've come back with bad news.
...Alright, go ahead.
Reporting in, Sect Leader, Senior Brother — the brothers have all returned with news, and I've come to relay it.
...I have to say, it really does stir something in the heart.
The greater the odds of winning, the slower I run.
So you're going to run after all?
I'll run tomorrow instead.
Honestly.
I was joking.
We've already come this far; do you still want to run?
...Should I run away early?
Yes... everything has been done, and the outcome will be revealed tomorrow.
The sun is about to set; tonight is the last night of the Tang Clan.
Tomorrow is the Western Wulin Assembly.
Alright, be careful on the road, and don't be gone too long.
This is my reward, after all
...As for matters that fall within the wife's responsibilities, I naturally have no choice but to take them on myself.
With no one around, just answer me honestly.
My dear! It's still broad daylight!
Even at night? Will you wait on me then as well?
I want your company, morning till night — never apart, not for a single one of the day's twelve watches.
Isn't everything I have all yours?
When I return to take credit, please be sure to reward me, my dear.
Oh... alright.

Please stay here, Sect Leader. Lingering only wastes time for nothing.
I shall return in a few days, so there is no need to worry.
Alright... then let me escort you for a short distance.
Then I shall take my leave and bid farewell to the Sect Leader.
Yes
Otherwise, they might read too much into it.
Otherwise, they will think I can't control you.
What do you mean, supervision? When have I ever not trusted you...? Still, since you put it that way, it's important to show the other Junior Martial Brothers and Sisters of the Tang Clan.
That's good. I'll go ask the finest and most virtuous of our sect sisters to protect you.
Then let me put it differently: how about I ask the senior sisters to accompany me, to protect your wife instead?
In order to achieve this wish, I am working hard, so please let me go.
I am ready to face death
My dear, I—I can't hold back any longer. I have to speak my true feelings.
Forget that you're the one I love and cherish—even set purely as lord and subordinate, I still hold by this: once you trust someone with a task, you do not doubt them.
Uh

I simply refuse to guard against you; I love leaving my gate wide open. Even if you plunged a knife into me, I'd welcome it gladly. Truly, if you wanted to hurt me, you wouldn't need all these twists and turns. Just say, here and now: 'I actually hate you'—and I would drop dead on the spot.
That's good. I'll go ask the finest and most virtuous of our sect sisters to protect you.
Then let me put it differently: how about I ask the senior sisters to accompany me, to protect your wife instead?
Your trust without doubt fills Xiao Ju's heart with joy. As your subject, so it is; and as your wife, no less.
...Understood.

As the Sect Leader, you cannot show weakness like this. Although Kongtong Sect holds you in high regard, there are also those with ambitious intentions lurking within. To maintain control over them, you must remain enigmatic and inscrutable.
The Sect Leader... my dear.
I trust you completely, so please don't say such things again; it makes one feel lonely.

The Sect Leader. If the Kongtong Sect harbors ill intent, then once Wei Ju goes to join them, I would be entirely beyond my lord's control. Without an escort to watch over me, what if I secretly harbored treachery of my own? One must always guard against such things, so I ask the senior sisters to accompany me, which also serves to clear my own name.
What nonsense are you talking about!
Naturally, it is to supervise me. If I have any ulterior motives, my senior sisters can execute Wei Ju on the spot.
Who did you have them supervise? The Kongtong brothers? They probably don't understand the ways of marching and fighting.
I would like to petition you, Senior Brother Sect Leader, for several female disciples to accompany me, for oversight, and so I can send word home at critical moments.
One could say so
If you don't keep an eye on it, your heart won't feel at ease, right?

Senior Brother Danxiazi carries military strategy in his breast and surely knows the key of it. But I am timid at heart, no strategist fit to command troops from a thousand miles away while sitting at ease in a plain tent. I dare not be negligent in anything, and prefer to act with caution above all, which is why I seek your leave.
There's no need for you to go yourself. The General of Dao Techniques is a capable commander; with your strategy, a brief note in your letter should be enough for him to grasp it.
But does it have to be you?
This matter is indeed of great importance...

Yes. Kongtong's forces are quite numerous, and simply flooding into Mount Meishan to brawl blindly is no wise strategy.
To keep the Wulin Alliance from splitting off to encircle us from the north,
I wish to go there in person, lay out the plan face-to-face, position the troops, and secure a line of retreat in case of the worst.
You mean to go receive the Kongtong reinforcements yourself?
Wei Ju, female disciple of Kongtong's Mystic Skill Gate, petitions the Sect Leader for leave to go to Zhaohua and render support.
Yes
Great!
It is reported, Sect Leader, that Kongtong's reinforcements will soon arrive in Shu territory.
Little Chrysanthemum

I'll write as well. I've had some dealings with the other three sect leaders too, especially the Iron Fist Gate Leader.
If we need someone to carry letters, let's entrust it to a traveling merchant.
Since they're not Wulin folk, no one could lay a hand on them.

As the day of the conference approaches, it is not advisable to allocate more manpower. I will entrust this letter to someone else and spend money to send them to Kongtong to inquire with the Four Sect Leaders.
They are at least a reputable sect; they can't just force our people to stay in the mountains.
Our sect's envoy sent to Kongtong Sect still hasn't returned — I only hope nothing has gone wrong.

How can I not be anxious? I don't know what has happened at Kongtong —
Talented Woman Wei has been slow to answer my letters for so long, and when I sent someone to inquire, even that person's news went silent.
Miss Ying, don't worry just yet.
Zhao Huo, Third Brother, still no word from Kongtong?

Kongtong Mystic Skill Gate Leader Wei has become a guest of the Tang Clan.
When the day comes that the Wulin Alliance marches east, the Kongtong Sect shall stand shoulder to shoulder with the Tang Clan in battle!
Little Sister is very honored
You are truly wonderful; having you as a friend is the best investment I've ever made in my life.
Talented Woman Wei answered by quoting Mencius, and alluding to a Tang-dynasty poem by Liu Zongyuan.

Life is something I desire, and righteousness is also something I desire; if I cannot have both, I will forsake life to uphold righteousness. I raise my head and draw my blade, considering who would care for appearances when it comes to righteousness. The martyr does not forget death; what they die for is loyalty and integrity.

Zhao Di... you might end up dead, you know. A child of a thousand golds shouldn't die at the hands of thieves, right? You usually seem quite clever, so why are you being so foolish, getting yourself caught up in this mess?

Since I began wandering the Jianghu, I have known countless hardships. Yet fortunately there remains one good thing —
that unseen, untouchable bond of loyalty and righteousness.
I am but a frail, humble woman, but I too wish to follow that example, and share the hardship with Lady Shangguan.
It's not hard. Besides, I still have selfish motives.
This... Talented Woman Wei has great talent, so why suffer?
The Kongtong Sect caused trouble in the past, and now it falls to me to make amends.
...To speak plainly, I have come to show my resolve.

There is nothing wrong with that — though Talented Woman Wei must have heard the rumors of the Jianghu:
the Wulin Alliance is sharpening its blades and will soon march east. I only fear that lingering in my humble home might drag her into it when that day comes.

Master Tang, this humble young woman is bold enough to ask for a brief stay at your esteemed clan, to keep Lady Shangguan company.
I wonder if it might be convenient, and whether you would grant permission?
Miss Ying has a good friend
Why are you laughing and crying at once? Aren't you afraid people will laugh at you?

{size=24}You worried I would suffer hardships in Kongtong, so every time you visited you insisted on stuffing money into my palm.{/size}
{size=24}I accepted it all without a word, and now that you truly need money, don't you dare refuse me — or I really will be upset.{/size}
This... this is...
Did I forget something?

Lady Shangguan, I have also brought along a few things you once left behind with me.
Back then you paid them no mind, but they should serve you well now.
Talented Woman Wei is too polite.

Thank you, Sect Leader, for your generosity in not holding this against me.
I have heard that Lady Shangguan has found shelter under your clan's protection, and I have come this time expressly to visit my friend.
I have brought a few modest gifts — nothing precious, only local specialties of Qinzhou — I hope you will accept them with a smile.

I have never met Sect Leader Wei in person, yet I have long admired her talent and renown.
An honored guest's arrival graces our humble Tang Clan. Please, say no more of any impropriety.
Sister-in-law is absolutely right

That's right, it was me.
Third Brother, is it not a joy when friends arrive from afar? I rushed out to welcome you so eagerly I nearly put my shoes on backward —
the children of Jianghu drown in empty formality, and it only hides true sincerity.

Why must Sect Leader Wei stand on such ceremony, and even twist the truth?
Third Senior Brother, she originally intended to stay at the inn at the foot of the mountain and send a visiting card up first —
it was I who asked Sister-in-law to go down and drag her up here by force.

Master Tang, Great Hero Zhao, this humble young woman offers her respects.
I set out in such haste that I outpaced my own letter, arriving unannounced and unbidden — a breach of manners.
I beg your generous indulgence and forgiveness.
Kongtong's Mystic Skill Sect Leader — Talented Woman Wei!
Oh, this is...
Zhao Huo, do you see who has arrived?
Ah, everyone make way, Third Senior Brother has arrived.
Let's go out and take a look
At this moment, the two of you finally caught the sound of a woman's giggling laughter outside.
Huh?
Here
But no one knows where she's gone...

Sect Leader Wei has such good relations with the Commoners that they all say she resembles a virtuous official more than the county magistrate, and they are eager to keep her. Even the other Three Sect Leaders, who have always had a mutual dislike for her, hold her in great respect. In the end, she settled for a compromise, claiming she wanted to travel and relax, and only then did the Three Sect Leaders reluctantly agree.
So how did it all end?

Yes, when I go to Kongtong to do business, I have to avoid her; that woman is too shrewd. She's always smiling, and her smile sends chills down my spine. Whenever I run into her, I can't turn much of a profit, which forces me to quietly find someone else to offload my goods, like I'm running some shady trade.

Ha, that's refreshing! Do you not know who that Sect Leader Wei is? Before she ever set foot in the Jianghu, she was already a renowned top scholar of Lin'an. A martial artist from the mountains trying to seize power is like wielding a great axe before Lu Ban—only inviting humiliation.

Once she leaves, the Flying Heaven Gate is sure to retaliate. Many of the Soul-Stealing Gate's powers will be stripped away, their status will plummet, and they may well end up beside the Iron Fist Gate hauling night soil in some degrading trade. At this the Soul-Stealing Sect Leader was crying out in constant distress, bowing again and again in apology, just short of dropping to their knees and kowtowing.

Her methods were remarkably shrewd—rather than lead the Mystic Skill Gate into a power struggle, she styled herself the steward instead. She skillfully used political maneuvering to nominally defer to the Flying Heaven Gate, while cleverly inventing pretexts to assign the Soul-Stealing Gate to key posts in security and fire-watch, keeping the Flying Heaven Gate wary enough to rein itself in—and that was how stability held without a sect leader.

You should know, Flying Heaven and the Soul-Stealing Gate are like fire and water—when the Flying Heaven Gate holds power the Soul-Stealing Gate has a hard time of it, and vice versa. This generation has barely kept the peace, all thanks to Sect Leader Wei's deliberate balancing, both openly and in secret.

After it was agreed she'd head south to support our Clan, Sect Leader Wei seized the moment to press her own point. She said she felt unworthy of her position—that in overseeing the livelihood of Kongtong's people, she had unknowingly stirred resentment in the Soul-Stealing Gate. So she asked to step down, intending to pass the position of sect leader to Mystic Skill Guardian Ju Dongyin.
The matter is not over yet
The Kongtong Sect will fight side by side with the Tang Clan on the day the Wulin Alliance comes east!
A blessing in disguise
It really is thanks to the Soul-Stealing Gate.

Seeing that their plot for power had failed, they could only feign seriousness, repeatedly claiming it was for the greater good. After that, the four sect leaders held a meeting under the Banyu Terrace, and following the commotion caused by the Soul-Stealing Gate, each had their own reflections. They were deeply aware of the saying when the lips are gone, the teeth are cold, and finally, they managed to take my words to heart.

Rest assured, they're just making noise and have no real intention of coming. Once they saw they'd stirred up public fury, and realized that killing and suppressing the crowd would leave no one to farm or hunt to sustain them, the Soul-Stealing Sect Leader's face changed in an instant—all smiles and soft words, truly damn good at bending when it counted.
This... is indeed the case, but there are many residents in Kongtong; how can our sect accommodate them all?

Sect Leader Wei then turned around and stirred up public sentiment—the Commoners of Kongtong had long harbored grievances against the Flying Heaven and Soul-Stealing Gates. Hearing that the Tang Clan had once built an Outer Fort to shelter refugees as outside disciples, a fine and celebrated deed, they all began to clamor, refusing to submit to Kongtong's rule any longer. They wanted to relocate to Shu, and as for Kongtong itself, it could do as it pleased.

The Soul-Stealing Gate suddenly turned hostile, taking hostage the common residents under Iron Fist Gate who knew no martial arts, and threatening Sect Leader Wei into opening the secret realm of the Mystic Skill Cave and handing over the Kongtong treasures.
Since he's bent on making trouble, no matter how impeccably those two conduct themselves, he'll always find something to pick at. It's plainly nitpicking—deliberate provocation.
What grounds do those two give for blame? What explanation is there to demand? The regrettable outcome of the Wulin Assembly was never their doing.

He blamed Danxiazi and Sect Leader Wei for tarnishing Kongtong's prestige, insisting on an explanation. He also questioned the disappearance of the Soul-Stealing Direct Disciple, Soul-Stealing Orchid, suggesting the Three Gates were behind it.

The position of sect leader stands vacant, and Kongtong is without a head, with the four sect leaders each harboring their own agendas. This time at the Wulin Assembly, the Soul-Stealing Sect Leader, who has been in seclusion for years, seemed to have found a pretext and stepped forward to demand an accounting.
Oh dear, the Wulin is about to fall into chaos, and those Four Gates are still busy fighting each other. Fat Lord went in and got dragged straight into their civil war—nearly lost his own life.
What happened?
The worst part is that I almost lost my life, and the lingering fear still remains.
It has been accomplished...
Succeeded
Hoo hoo, what were you thinking about, Miss Ying, that your face suddenly turned red? Hehehe.
Miss Ying, you're feeling shy, haha
If you're truly a hero, it wouldn't be a hardship for Ying'er to serve you.
Oh, how could I dare? How could I bear to make you feel wronged?
Asking for a beating, aren't you? Would it kill you not to say such annoying things?
Where can you find such a large maid? Even if you serve others, you are still an old woman.
In that case, I will give you everything I can. Even if it means becoming a servant to assist you with washing and changing, I am willing to do so.
You must keep your word and help me rescue Lady Wei.
Why are you suddenly getting serious?
Zhao Huo
Aside from your face, I really can't find any faults. Your appearance isn't great, losing nine points out of ten, but you have the ability to make up for that nine points.
It's just a face
What are you talking about? What's wrong with me?
Her eyes are so bright, unlike my blind eyes and foolish heart, that I actually followed you.
Hahaha!
Hahaha, stop being so vain! How could Talented Woman Wei possibly be interested in you! Talking about dying to prove a point, how shameless!
Pfft, hehe
You, you...

Alright, stop hitting me, I won't say anything more. If Talented Woman Wei has any ulterior motives towards me, I will definitely refuse her sternly and tell her: A mere Zhao Huo is unworthy; in this life, I only belong to Shangguan Ying, unwavering and unchanging. If she insists on forcing me, I can only express my resolve with death.
Say it again! Say it again!
You actually dared to claim you would strike the current top talented woman? That's quite barbaric, isn't it?
I... I will beat the two of you up together!
How can it be said that it's a matter of whether I dare or not? What if I save her, and she willingly offers herself in return?
You dare!
Really? Then I will marry Talented Woman Wei as well—
Talk nonsense to provoke her
I don't disbelieve, it's just... sigh. I'm anxious inside, so please don't hold it against me.
You can doubt me all you want, but I will keep my word.
If only you could really make it happen... Sigh.
Why the bitter smile? Have a little more confidence in me; I will definitely make it happen.
Very well.

Ying'er, you still have the Tang Clan as your support. Daoist Danxiazi said that Talented Woman Wei is not in immediate danger. Once the troubles here are resolved, we will take our fellow brothers and head north to bring back Talented Woman Wei.
Ah... I forgot, I am no longer a member of the Shangguan family, how could I call out to them.
Do you take Shangguan Ying for a pushover? We'll see! Once I get home and bring reinforcements, I'll use the power of the Shangguan family to reclaim justice...
That group of Kongtong bastards, filthy rascals, and country bumpkins actually dared to be so disrespectful to the foremost talented woman of our time! It is simply an affront to culture!
How could this happen...?
Danxiazi, the General of Dao Techniques, joined the Tang Clan.
Hahaha, sharpening the spear at the last moment, it may not shine, but it still has its luster. Reckless command is precisely the specialty of this general. Just wait and see!

Standing on the same side as General of Dao Techniques brings immense peace of mind; there is no reason to doubt. What worries us, the folks from the mountains and fields, is that sharpening our spears at the last moment will be of no use.
General, please rise quickly!

I vow to serve Master Benefactor once more as a general. If Sect Leader Tang trusts me, he may entrust his disciples to my training. On the day that the Wulin Alliance invades, it shall be when this humble general puts his skills to use!

As for this humble Daoist, before I am fully recovered, I will inevitably have to trouble the Tang Clan. I escaped penniless and owe the Fourth Hero Tang my life; it would be unacceptable for me to stay without repayment.
The virtuous are watched over by heaven; Talented Woman Wei's fate cannot end here!
Farming in the valley? Sect Leader Wei has eaten too much... Sect Leader Wei truly has a remarkable foresight.
Is it true? That's really great!

Enough. Others may not know, but within the Mystic Skill cave lies another world, leading to a secluded valley. In the Secluded Valley, there are fruit trees that can collect rainwater. Sect Leader Wei had the foresight to cultivate farmland there, becoming self‑sufficient. It seems they could live there for fifteen or sixteen years without any issues.
I wonder if the food stored in the cave can last until then. Their situation can't be more critical than ours, can it?

I've severed all ties with the Flying Heaven Gate, but I can't bear to see the commoners of Kongtong suffer.
Sooner or later I'll fight my way back to Kongtong, find the Iron Fist master craftsman Yu Zhu to forge a great axe, split open the Forgetting-Dust Stone,
and rescue my sisters of the Mystic Skill Gate!
Hahaha! Brother Zhao speaks truly. These scars are the marks of my rebirth through trials; as long as I am alive, the more, the better.
The Daoist has fought a hundred battles and earned a scarred body for it. This time he didn't die, and just picked up a few new marks—looking quite dashing, honestly.
Whether there is fortune or not depends on my actions in the days to come. If I were to give up like this, it would be no different from being dead.
It is truly a blessing for the Commoners that the Daoist priest has escaped disaster.

Those who contribute should be rewarded; a good Sect Leader is one who is clear about rewards and punishments.
Third Senior Brother, please give me money!
Indeed, this time our Fourth Junior Brother can be said to have made a great contribution.
It's great that the Daoist priest is fine!

I am but a practitioner of the Dao, without military status, and I have intruded upon the battlefield without permission. I am grateful to Old General Zhao Fang for his leniency in not taking my life and for being so accommodating, valuing talent above all else. This allows me to contribute, albeit in a small way, to the Commoners of the Great Song. I fear I have brought laughter to Master Tang; I am truly ashamed, truly ashamed.
Hahaha! "General of Dao Techniques"? That's just something the brothers in the army joke around and call me—don't take it seriously!
Are you the General of Dao Techniques?
That's the whole story, Sect Leader Tang, Great Hero Zhao—it's an honor to meet you both!

Fortunately, I brought a cart full of goods, which included plenty of healing medicine. In that moment, I decided to treat the dead horse as if it were alive, using everything I had without worrying about whether it was the right remedy, just to cover the wounds. Later, I secretly sought out a doctor who prepared several doses of medicine, and only then was I able to save the person.
He didn't die?

Third Senior Brother, don't cry yet—I'm not finished. I also assumed he was certainly doomed, so I thought only of saving my own skin and fled in a hurry. But on the way back in my carriage, this man suddenly burst out from underneath it, covered head to toe in blood.
What a pity, for such a hero.

I had long heard the Fire Dragon Immortal Monarch never favored this eldest disciple of his,
but Daoist Danxiazi is none other than the General of Dao Techniques, renowned for his brilliant defense of Xiangyang!
And a pillar of Kongtong besides—how could he be so blind to right and wrong as to strike him down so ruthlessly?
How despicable!
Daoist Danxiazi held a clear advantage against the Soul-Stealing Sect Leader, but was suddenly struck down from behind by his own master, the Fire Dragon Immortal Monarch.
How can we keep this from Miss Ying? If she hears the bad news, she will surely be heartbroken.
Sect Leader Wei
How is that possible...?

Sect Leader Wei devised a plan to break the siege, leading the disciples into the Mystic Skill secret realm. They placed the Forgetting-Dust Stone to block the cave entrance, determined to never surrender. They planned to collectively martyr themselves once the food and water stored in the cave ran out.

The Soul-Stealing Gate suddenly turned hostile, taking the common folk of the Iron Fist Gate—those with no martial skill at all—hostage,
forcing Sect Leader Wei to open the secret realm of the Mystic Skill Cave and hand over the Kongtong Secret Treasure.

Since he's bent on making trouble no matter what, those two could be as tactful as they like—he'd still find something to say.

The Dayi Branch is gone for good now. I bled out more silver for their travel funds, and the Dayi Branch's friends scattered to the winds—some west, some south—retiring from the Jianghu.

By the time we arrived, the brothers of the Dayi Branch had already suffered heavy losses. That pack of vicious beggars wielded their staffs, beating people like dogs—jabbing eyes or striking throats with bamboo rods. It was ruthless beyond words, without a shred of humanity.
