No backbone -- even this needs Grandfather to decide for you. Fine, just you wait, I'll send you off somewhere truly incredible.
Grandson, wherever you go is fine, but it's better to let Grandfather make the arrangements.
But maybe you shouldn't go to Jinxiang Palace after all, you're truly a man.

Of course!
The six great sects — Songshan, Quanzhen, Emei, Qingcheng, Diancang, and Kongtong —
even Jinxiang Palace is no problem.
Can I really choose on my own?

Nangong Heng's words were clearly meant for the sect leaders to hear. In truth, there was no need for him to say it—who didn't already show the Second Young Lord of this wealthy patron every courtesy?

Silly child, Grandfather is letting you choose for yourself.
You are Grandfather's good grandson, the Second Young Lord of the Nangong family.
No matter which sect you study at, the elders of the Wulin will all give this old man some face and look after you especially.
Grandson, the grandson will only follow Grandfather's orders. Wherever Grandfather sends me, the grandson will not disobey.

So many good friends in the Jianghu are willing to give your grandfather face.
Good grandson, are you willing to be the first student to study abroad at another sect, to set an example for everyone else?
Senior Brother Zhao, Grandpa called me, I went over.
Qian'er, where did you run off to? Come here, Grandpa.
Unfortunately, you're wrong; she'll never care about anyone but your brother.
I knew it! I really envy you. I wish Sister Ying and I could get along better too.
Indeed, it was a bond forged through shared trials and tribulations.
A deep friendship... is that what it is?

Brother Zhao, you don't know this, but Sister Ying is very capable, handling everything in an orderly way. Father and Grandfather both say she'll make a fine, capable wife someday; she rarely lets herself look flustered. The way she treats you is already rare for her, so you two must be quite close.
You call the way she treats me caring? Your standards are really low.
If she treated me as well as she treats you, that would be good.
How could that be? If she wasn't caring about you, fearing that you might offend my older brother, she wouldn't have interfered.
Her greatest wish is probably to poison me mute.
Hmm, she gave you several glances, trying to tell you to shut up.
Did you notice?
Brother Zhao, do you know Sister Ying?
About Shangguan Ying
S-Second Hero Tang? Al-alright, I-I'll remember not to resist him.
But you'll occasionally run into trouble. Someone like my Second Senior Brother, you'd best not even think about trying to resist him; it could cost someone their life.

That's nothing, to be honest, I'm often the target of bullying. Although I don't always dare to retaliate, once I do, I often realize that the bully isn't as capable as I thought. It's just that I've been imagining the opponent to be far more formidable than they are.

You and Nangong Qian share a mutual understanding born of shared struggles, with a deep sense of mutual understanding that makes your meeting a moment of profound connection, as if you've met too late, leaving a sense of regret that you didn't meet earlier.
I agree. When I'm bullied, I don't always dare to fight back. But fighting back is really satisfying. Getting hit is better than feeling mentally oppressed.
Y-yeah, that's true! But I—I did fight back. Even though I got hit, I felt really good about it.
I didn't help you at all, and we ended up being beaten together.
Sorry, listening to me say all this probably ruined your mood for drinking. Thank you for helping me, no one's ever helped me before, I'm really happy.
My time in the Tang Clan wasn't easy, but at least I chose it myself. He, on the other hand, had no choice from start to finish, which is pitiful.
After all, who would want a wild child to suddenly pop up and claim kinship? My father is a person of status and standing, someone remarkable. I might be like his stain or something like that.
If I were really just sold as a servant, maybe that would be better. That way, not everyone would look down on me, haha...

I'm... how do I put it? I just appeared out of nowhere. Father originally had only one son, my brother. I was seven or eight when Mother brought me in. I actually thought I was going to be sold, haha.
How so?
Hmm, but... but that's my own fault. The people from the Nangong family hate me, and I can understand that too.
Okay, next time I won't be helping you. You need to be more assertive and don't let people bully you anymore.
......This isn't the first time this kind of thing has happened. Your brother knows about it too, right?
Let's talk about what happened earlier
End conversation
Senior Brother Zhao, please
That's true
He is my future husband, how can he treat me? Why are you meddling in others' affairs?
Call me if there's something, I won't go far.
Okay
Zhao Huo, please take a closer look at A'Qian for me.
Right, sorry, Senior Brother Zhao, this way please.
Don't you have any backbone at all? Seeing your pathetic look just annoys me — get out!
However, the gifts here haven't been moved yet.

...A'Qian, send your brother Zhao out.
Your senior brother and I still have things to discuss.
Sorry, Senior Brother
A'Qian, look at your fine achievement — thanking an outsider who's practically a servant.
A small matter
Ah... um, Senior Brother Zhao... thank you.
You don't need to, I can walk on my own.

We're done talking, so please leave — this is no place for you to linger.
Someone, see the guest out!
Alright
Alas, this is Miss Shangguan's beloved. I won't argue with him.
Zhao Huo, hold your tongue.
Young Lord, you are so refined and courteous; speaking like this is somewhat beneath your station, isn't it?
Well, that's good. You invited me, but I didn't really want to come yet.

Unfortunately, I'm quite busy and have no time for such trivial matters.
If you say it happened, then it happened — name your compensation, and I'll have the accountant see to it when you leave.
But remember, today is the last time the Nangong family treats you as a guest.
Shangguan Ying was in a bad mood and wanted to scold you, but suddenly remembered her fiance was nearby, so she swallowed her words.

You got hit and you're still so full of confidence.
Not injured... right...
You've got it backwards — clearly it's me, the guest, who got scolded by your servant.
As for why I'm here, you should ask your own servant what happened.

Hmph, you've gone to great lengths.
But no matter how prominent our Nangong family is, it's not for outsiders to interfere.
How bold of the Tang Clan, barging into my inner courtyard to discipline my servants for me?
Shangguan Ying gave you a glance, signaling you to be quiet.

Eldest Young Lord, you've misunderstood—those two wicked servants took advantage of the Second Young Lord's kindness, thinking him easy to push around,
and ordered him to haul these gifts. I couldn't just stand by, so I got into it with them.

Eldest Young Lord, in my opinion, this was no ordinary bit of fun and games.
The servants of your esteemed household use the tiger's might to bully others, arrogant and unruly in temperament—setting aside their rudeness to guests, they even dared to lord it over their own masters.
Since when does a servant order a young lord to haul goods? I couldn't just stand by, so I got into it with them.
No problem, A'Qian is just teasing the servants.
Brother...... Sister Ying.
What's going on? So noisy.
No! Nothing's wrong, we'll go right away, we'll go right away.
Since there's nothing, just go do your own business. Is the Nangong family keeping idle people?
Eldest Young Lord!? N-nothing.
What are you going to report?
Y-you all, don't get so pleased with yourselves—wait till I go report you to the Eldest Young Lord!
We won
Senior Brother Zhao, you won!
No! Nothing's wrong, we'll go right away, we'll go right away.

On ordinary days, if you like to play around, that's fine. Today is the birthday banquet of the Supreme Family Head, and no one in the Nangong family has time to spare, yet you are still playing around here. It seems that this Young Lord has failed in my upbringing.
Young Lord!?
I thought someone was causing a commotion here, but it turned out to be some obnoxious servants.
But waste is waste; two of them together are still useless.
Two useless wretches, and you still dare waste our time.
Aaah!
Hey‑am I also going to fight?
Good, Senior Brother Zhao, I will help you!
Beat them until they stop yapping and making a racket—only then will we treat them as human!
Second Young Lord, please come help me; let's teach these two contemptuous scoundrels a lesson!

Damn it, out of respect for you being a guest, I gave you some slack—now you're pushing your luck!
See how formidable our Nangong family fist is!
I'm going to fight you to the death! I swear I'll fight you to the death! Hand over your life!!
So, have your ancestors scolded you for being unfilial, little miss?
He's really alive! Senior Brother Zhao, you're too amazing!
Idiot! ‑

Don't worry, he's just gone down to report to his ancestors.
His sort snaps right back after one kick.

You've scolded someone to death, truly Zhang Yi reborn. Your scolding leaves no mercy, like a vicious dog that can speak human language, stunning heaven and earth, making ghosts weep. The Buddhist lion's roar, the Tang Clan's Mad Dog barking, they should be called the twin masterpieces.
Wh-what do we do?! Someone's died!
He's dead! You've scolded him to death!

It's too late to say all that now, you pitiful eunuch.
Go on and be reborn—though with your virtue, I'd wager nine times out of ten you'll come back as a beast.
But that's still better than this life; after all, not every beast opens its mouth just to eat filth or spew it.
Hahaha! Sorry, but it's really funny!

What are you saying? Do you think your descendants won't dig up your grave?
How absurd! Even if you're counting on leaving no heirs, that doesn't mean you can act recklessly!
Have you never considered that you're heirless precisely because you've done evil?
You‑you!!

Your ancestors are already furious with you; are you still being so reckless here? Are you only satisfied when you make your descendants so angry that they dig up your grave? If you don't want to be cursed by future generations, stop doing such wicked deeds of bullying the weak and fearing the strong!

Even if our ancestors weren't ambitious, that's not a problem. To live with dignity and self‑respect, one must first value oneself. You are so self‑deprecating and submissive; it's not that the ancestors don't respect you, but that you don't respect them. Why haven't you gone down to bow to your ancestors yet?

You're just a pitiful person who spends all day degrading others to comfort your own soul. Isn't that just insecurity at work? Go ahead and degrade your own ancestors if you're so capable. It's not others who made you a servant; it's your own ancestors who were unambitious!
Outsider disciples can just quit anytime if they don't want to do it. What about you? Your Indenture Contract is in someone else's hands‑how can you compare with me?
Don't be so forward, who is your friend? I'm a guest with a signed name card who brought a gift to attend the banquet!
This Tang Clan friend, are you an outsider disciple who came with Great Hero Tang to serve? You trespassed into the Nangong family's inner courtyard‑what are you up to?
Verbal Attack? Is it like Lion's Roar?
It's not that. This itch of mine is the kind that makes me have to speak ill of people-I can't hold it in. Second Young Lord, please step aside so my Verbal Attack doesn't harm anyone innocent.
This...? But was it that the banquet's wine and dishes were not properly served?
No, my mouth is itchy, so I came over.
Ah, hello, my name is Nangong Qian. Are you looking for the restroom, Brother Zhao?
Hello, Second Young Lord. I am a member of the Tang Clan, my name is Zhao Huo.
Phew, so heavy! I don't even know what treasures these things of Sister Ying's are.
Loudly reprimand the servant for not respecting the hierarchy
I was originally hoping to keep the peace, but since you were the first to act, don't blame me for being ruthless!
What's the problem if you push me? Even if I hit you in the Nangong Family's courtyard, no one would say I'm wrong. If you don't want to be punished, stay out of it and get out of here.
Don't get handsy and shove people around. I'm just helping the Second Young Lord myself-how is that any business of yours?
Zhao, don't refuse the toast of goodwill only to end up drinking the wine of punishment. Ugly as you are, you still dare play the hero here.
Then let's move quickly, finish moving, and go back to the hall.
Yes, after that the mistress and steward will come to check, then distribute to the clan members according to seniority.
I had thought the Nangong Family was a place that valued propriety. Now that I've seen it, heh heh. Second Young Lord, can the rest of these gifts just be moved to the central well like this?

You there, friend from the Tang Clan, aren't you the outsider disciple who came to serve alongside Great Hero Tang? As a fellow servant, let me give you some advice: if you're too full and want to walk it off, go outside. Barging into someone else's inner courtyard isn't very proper, is it? Who knows if your hands are clean.
Y-you want to help me?
No, I'm just too full. I thought I'd walk around a bit to help digest, and seeing the Second Young Lord working so hard here, I really admire it, and I wanted to help too.
Ah, hello, my name is Nangong Qian. Are you looking for the restroom, Brother Zhao?
Hello, Second Young Lord. I am a member of the Tang Clan, my name is Zhao Huo.
Whew—so heavy! Sister Ying, I don't know what these are, but they must be treasures.
As long as the truth of the laborer's menial tasks is confirmed and then revealed at the right time, the important figures of the Nangong family will know about the Second Young Lord's grievances.
Let's go help first.
Servant of the Nangong family, it's not my place as an outsider disciple from another sect to scold you.
Step forward to help Nangong Qian
I've got it! I'll deal with my Eldest Senior Brother like this next time!
What kind of world is this, where a servant dares to bully the young master?
Fine, I'll move it, I'll move it!

Don't just stand there laughing, hurry up and move it. If you don't get this done quickly and properly, don't even think about leaving. If you refuse to move it, I'll tell Master you've been secretly wearing that pauldron!
Hehe

Sigh, why do you get to be so lucky, landing yourself a big-shot father for no reason? Living it up as the Second Young Lord-if I, A'Yi, could take the Nangong surname too, heh heh. Nangong Yi! Now that would be impressive.
No, not at all, I didn't say that.

What nonsense are you talking? The meals the old master assigned you are the same as the Eldest Young Lord's. Are you doubting the old master's fairness, or accusing the Eldest Young Lord of mistreating you? Or maybe the kitchen uncle? I get it now-you think A'Yi and I, A'Bing, stole your food, don't you?
I don't eat much; every time the food is... leftover.

Second Young Lord, you eat so much chicken, duck, fish, and meat every day‑how come you haven't gained any strength? The things you're moving around can be handled with one hand by Ah Yi. You were born in the city streets, knowing the hardships of life‑how can you be so delicate?

A'Yi, A'Bing, I've helped out so much already, that should be about enough, right?
I—I still need to go back and greet the guests, or Father will get angry.

Hey, what's going on over there? Is the Second Young Lord moving gifts too?
No, looking closer, it's the Second Young Lord doing the moving, while the other servants just watch.
......Aren't I a guest? How can that be reasonable? Alas.
You ran into a peculiar servant whose name you badly wanted to know. Unable to get a word in, you were talked over by him and sent off to work in the backyard.

No. I am the unique child born of my father and mother; you simply don't know my name. It's the same as how I don't know your name. In my eyes, you look like a passerby. If you wish to look down on me, I'll be the first to look down on you.
Are all the Nangong Family's household servants like you?

Otherwise, I'll have to beg you. You great heroes are always eager to help others for pleasure. After all, Lady Shangguan is so beautiful; you have the chance to see her more, isn't that your good fortune? In fact, you should thank me. Go on, go on.
Brother, you really are one of a kind, coming up with a threat like that.

We're both servants, so just bear with it—why split hairs between you and me! If things don't go well and I get hauled up and scolded, it'll still be your Tang Clan's fault! I don't just blame your Eldest Senior Brother; I also blame you for not helping at all!
Oh, all right... but brother, we're not exactly close, are we? Why do you want me to go? I'm still a guest here, you know.
Forget it, I need to go change clothes. You go to the back yard and tidy up Lady Shangguan's gifts for me.
Uh... although it wasn't me who did it, I'm sorry.
If I dared to complain to him, why would I come to you?
Then go blame him! What's the point of telling me?
You— you're from the Tang Clan, aren't you? Your Eldest Senior Brother drank himself sick and vomited all over me! And it even got me scolded by the Eldest Young Lord!
What happened?
Brother, don't go!
......Forget it, go ahead and eat my meal.

Gaozi once said: Food and sex are natural desires. Since beauty is unattainable, why not eat more? You bowed your head to eat, thinking about this time capturing Tan Badao, a task you had risked your life to accomplish, and not eating more would be an injustice to heaven and conscience.
......Forget it, eat my food.
Then, she fell into deep self-doubt.
Am I... haven't grown taller for a long time? Will I grow taller again?
Junior Sister tries to straighten her leg.
That Shangguan Sister in purple is really tall and beautiful.
Though she is considered a beautiful woman, she is not my heart's true love.
(Not bad)
My heart hurts, did I eat too much?
Miss Shangguan is exceptionally beautiful. Graceful and composed, with a commanding presence, entirely unlike any other woman I've met in my life - truly admirable.
(Very pretty)
What do you think about Shangguan Ying?
Is that the only daughter of the Shangguan Family, Shangguan Ying?
My heart hurts, did I eat too much?
Don't think about it; this is inherently an unreasonable desire and not acceptable.
Feeling a bit down... like wanting to cry.
Miss Shangguan has also arrived; that's only natural. After all, this is her future husband's family.
Don't even think about it, you. Only a young lord like Nangong, with such impeccable family background, appearance, and martial arts skills, would be fortunate enough to marry a beauty like her.
What spirit she has, and how fragrant. Ah~ No, no, this is really disrupting my Dao heart.
Among the guests in the hall, men and women alike, fully half of them kept their eyes fixed on Shangguan Ying until she turned down the corridor and vanished from sight.

Yes, Young Lord. So, Grandfather, Ying'er will first instruct the servants to bring all the gifts that couldn't fit in the front courtyard into the inner courtyard. Later, I will take a bath and change clothes, then pay my respects to you after the guests have gone.
Yes, Grandfather. Ying'er, come with me.

Do not be too domineering with your future wife, Ying'er was right; it was Grandfather who had misunderstood. She is your betrothed wife, and Grandfather does not want her to appear in public before outsiders. Take Ying'er down for a private talk; she has traveled a long distance and must be tired.
Ah, Young Lord... I...
Ying'er, how did you speak to Grandpa?
Ah...

Grandfather, you're getting forgetful.
Father received the imperial decree appointing him overseer of the royal shipbuilding works - he's an official now, no longer part of the Jianghu.
The Shangguan Family would love nothing more than to help you realize your dream, but if we get involved, it may only cause more trouble.
Grandfather was just discussing important matters when you arrived, perfect timing, Grandfather asked you...
Thank you, Grandpa, for your kindness. Ying'er is fine, very strong.
Ahhh, enough about bad omens - it's all this old fool's doing. If only I hadn't rushed you. Thankfully my good granddaughter-in-law came through without a single hair harmed.

...Ying'er gave the family a condolence payment, and everything has been arranged. This morning, I arrived in a hurry and could only hastily wash up, using mugwort to purify my body with incense. I suppose it won't bring bad luck.
Oh dear, is anyone hurt?

Apologies. Ying'er brought too many gifts on this trip. Midway, we ran into a heavy downpour that made the mountain roads slippery, and in our haste, one of the carriages slid down the hillside. Retrieving the scattered jewels was what delayed us.
Good child, you've finally come, how could you be so late?

Uncle Nangong, Grandfather Nangong, Ying'er pays her respects to you. Congratulations on your hundredth birthday, Grandfather. May you be as fortunate as the East Sea and as long‑lived as the Southern Mountain.
Shangguan Family's Eldest Daughter, Shangguan Ying──Arrived──
Should've said so earlier. It's Young Lady Shangguan, so of course that's a different matter. Let's go, let's go.

Young Lady Shangguan's gift is quite large and needs a whole team to move. I must ask you all to bear with the inconvenience. I'll rearrange seats for you Great Heroes right away; forgive any offense.
Says who? I've sat down, and I won't budge.
Sorry, Great Heroes, could you please make way? This table needs to be cleared first.
As the atmosphere gradually became lively and more and more mid‑sized and smaller sects began to voice their positions, suddenly a household servant rushed in.
You feel a deep sense of injustice, overflowing with resentment.

This... I've been in the Tang Clan for so long without receiving any teachings. What if disciples from other sects, after completing their studies abroad, understand Tang Clan martial arts better than me, an outsider disciple? How could I bear it?
You are filled with hope and eager to try.

With so many disciples from other sects coming to the Tang Clan for study, the Sect Leader can't possibly be so stingy as to not teach even a few techniques. Then I can take the opportunity to sneakily learn a few moves‑maybe there's even a chance to officially become a disciple!
Now that the Tang Clan has joined, the Nangong Family naturally won't fall behind either!
Stupid.
I... support.

I need to get a grip-I almost went to ask Junior Brother Zhao for his opinion. Asking anyone else would be fine, but asking him would be the most unfair. However hard I try, I can't be that shameless.
Third Senior Brother, agree, just agree, that's a thousand taels of gold. Even if divided among all the sects, it's still a substantial sum. Don't forget we still have debts‑be practical!
You're right, I'm really being foolish.
What would Little Junior Sister know? The sect leader is asking you-don't push it off on someone else.
L-Little Junior Sister, what do you think?

Old Patriarch Nangong is compassionate and merciful; the intention behind this matter is commendable. Our sect has received sponsorship, which can alleviate financial pressures. However, our sect's martial arts have never been passed on to outsiders. Are we to treat disciples from other sects as outsiders?
You-hmph! Third Junior Brother, what do you say?
Then I will support it.
That must have a reason not to inform us in advance‑I oppose this matter.
Indeed, it's the Sect Leader's handwriting and seal. How come you didn't inform us beforehand?
Esteemed Tang brothers, here are the letters.

Tang Clan's esteemed nephews, I have already communicated this matter with your sect's Sect Leader via letter. Your Sect Leader's intention is for the Eldest Disciple, second disciple, and third disciple to jointly decide. Shen'er.

Yin Zhiping, this wicked and deceitful false gentleman only joined us when he saw that I and Fatty Zou had agreed, rushing to take a stance only when the situation became favorable. Where is there any good intention in him? You can see he's not a good person.
No need to be so polite-actually, the Quanzhen Sect has been doing exactly this all along. Hearing a like-minded senior take the lead has stirred this junior with great excitement.
Great, great! With the Quanzhen sect's support, this matter is bound to succeed. This old man speaks on behalf of future generations to thank Daoist Yin for your kindness.
Elder, allow this poor Daoist to speak for my mentor, who could not be here: the Quanzhen Sect too is willing to lend its support.
That... is indeed the case; this Zou can only accept your kindness then.

Daoist Zou, please do not decline. I know you are not interested in worldly gains. But handling this matter will inevitably place some burden on various sects and schools. Instead of calling it compensation, let's say it is a form of sponsorship or assistance. Think about it‑many Taoist temples could use some repairs, couldn't they?
Thieving Daoist priest, always sticking your nose in to play the good guy and look generous!
Old Man, this affair counts as a share for the Qingcheng Sect. As for the silver and gold, there's no need at all. This is a most commendable deed, doing good and accumulating virtue, why not do it?

Nangong Old Man's matter is truly absurd. This old Daoist finds it hard to foresee, but the intention is indeed kind‑hearted and compassionate, with a deep sense of empathy for all beings. Even if I know it's difficult to achieve, how could I not express my support?
Our old birthday host has such kind intentions; this Immortal Lord shall accept on behalf of the four sect leaders of the Kongtong Sect!

A thousand taels of gold? This deal is well worth it. After all, it's limited to half a year. If I don't pass on formidable skills, no other sect can take advantage of the Kongtong Sect. At most, I'll send them to the Iron Fist Gate, making those disciples from other sects work hard for our sect without any loss.

The Nangong Family is willing to offer a thousand taels of gold to encourage disciples from various sects to exchange. Sect leaders and elders who wish to join in this endeavor, kindly speak up‑do not let the old fellow handle it alone!
Old Patriarch Nangong's words were too shocking and scandalous, leaving the crowd staring with wide eyes.

The disciples you sent out who can master martial arts from other sects count as half‑disciples. If such a disciple achieves success in the future, it will be a great honor for both sects. Should the two sects ever have a rift in the future, this disciple could serve as a bridge to mediate and bring harmony, wouldn't that be wonderful?
It's said to be a study abroad internship, but in reality, it's also an opportunity for exchange among the various sects. This time, we'll limit it to six months, letting us test the waters.
This old man's method is simple: have the various sects exchange disciples for study and observation!

I, an old man, also know that to eliminate prejudices between sects all at once is but a fool's dream. Each sect has its own established foundations; who could easily relinquish their hold? Therefore, my wish is merely to start this matter.

Hearing the Old Longevity Star's sincere and heartfelt words, you Tang Clan members were deeply moved. You also temporarily forgot the fact that you had been called around and forced to work hard in the Tang Clan.
The magnanimity of the Tang Clan, I, an old man, must admit I can't help but be biased; it's very difficult to achieve. As for the heroes of the Tang Clan, that's genuine admiration.

On this matter, the Nangong family has maintained generations of friendly relations, and the Tang Clan, one of the Three Great Families, serves as a respectable example. No matter where you come from, regardless of your gender, age, or surname, once you join the Tang Clan, you become part of the family.

But if I ensure that the various schools in Central Plains do not contend with each other out of personal grievances, what need should we have to fear the Supreme Bliss Cult or the Mud Cult, let alone the Jin people? The most deadly foes in the Jianghu are not external enemies but the disputes among our own people.

I, an old man, often think: if the Wulin had no divisions between sects, and all were brothers and sisters,
without distinguishing one school from another, then not only could we avoid fighting amongst ourselves,
but when outside enemies came to threaten us, we could set aside our differences, rally swiftly, and stand together against them.

You young heroes are eager to build your names and win renown—this old man understands the feeling.
But what I truly wish for is not mere violence, but the two words: 'unity'.

This bunch is far too bloodthirsty—rooting out demons and upholding the Way is well and good,
but marching straight into someone's home is a bit much, especially when they're shouting for blood at a birthday banquet.
Could it be that Old Patriarch Nangong truly wants to stir up trouble again, and see blood flow like a river?
Is this too extreme?

You're swept up in the crowd's fervor, your blood boiling, your heart pounding—all you want is to make your move,
and claim some small place in the tales of the Jianghu; that alone would satisfy you.
Attack the Six Paths Canyon! To rid the Wulin of evil!
Kill them on the Six Paths Gorge! Chop down his whole family!
Willing to uphold peace in the Jianghu and root out evil! Charge into the Six Paths Canyon! Fulfill the elder's heartfelt wish!

Exactly! We mustn't let the Demon Cult grow any further!
Storm the Six Paths Canyon! Kill every last one of the Demon Cult's disciples!
For the sake of fulfilling the elder's wish! What do you all say?

Now let us all have our say.
If the Mud Cult truly isn't a good thing, and we sit idly by watching it grow stronger by the day,
wouldn't that be repeating the mistakes of the past?

Exactly! Not to mention the Six Paths Dharma Kings, their identities shrouded in mystery, their conduct outrageous.
They don't follow the Wulin's rules at all, and stand utterly at odds with us of the Central Plains orthodoxy!

That's obviously an evil sect, a Demon Cult!
Teaching people to soak their whole bodies in mud and recite wicked scriptures—how is that not a Demon Cult!
Is the Mud Cult righteous or evil? This old man dares not say...

The campaign against the Supreme Bliss Cult cost the Songshan and Tang Clan sects the heaviest casualties of all.
The Supreme Bliss Cult may be destroyed, but the lesson is far from old—now the Jianghu has given rise to a Mud Cult.

If it weren't for the high monks of Songshan Temple sacrificing themselves to uphold righteousness and awaken the chivalrous hearts of the sects,

Even the pig and Brother Zhao know how to seek benefits and avoid harm. Aren't you forgetting what that person has done? Aren't you forgetful? Are you a pig?

Let's get back to the main point. Duan Zhixiu knows that using force is the worst strategy, so he shows weakness and adopts a gentle approach, aiming to move your heart and make you soften. To achieve his goal, he is willing to abandon trust and be unscrupulous, resorting to any means necessary.
After all, I'm not some sheltered Young Lady who's never seen the world.

Who in the world would disregard their own interests and genuinely care for me? Brother Zhao is one such person, truly rare. So even if it's a bit unattractive, it's not a big deal; practicality is best.
Foolish, you don't even need to ask such a question. I see through everything.
Oh my～ You think you really care about that ugly Brother? Are you blind?

But... but I really feel guilty. Brother Zhao was injured by the Withering and Flourishing Divine Skill of the Duan Family, and several senior brothers from the Tang Clan have also gone missing one after another. How can I pretend not to hear or see, and focus solely on my own well‑being?

You are right; a person should have self‑awareness. I am merely a weak woman, a pitiful little miss. If I act on impulse and make a mistake, falling into Duan Zhixiu's clutches, how could that be resolved?

Stop your mouth! My foolish conscience! If I already knew Duan Zhixiu was after me, how could I still be so naive and invite him over? Don't let good intentions lead to bad outcomes; using yourself as bait, only to end up being caught by the fish, and instead cause trouble for others.

As a descendant of the Ye family, I cannot let our ancestors be disgraced! Knowing well that Duan Zhixiu is after me, how can I stand by and let the Tang Clan be implicated? Even if I can't beat them, I at least have to extract some information from them.
But have I truly thought it through? Have I made up my mind? Is it really today? This very moment? Is there a more secure way?

Fine weather, Brother's busy, and Sister Fang has gone to the clinic to sit in the hall.
Those who'd get in the way won't be around to get in the way; the moment is now.
Hmm... Brother ran off, has the opportunity finally come?
Okay

Don't worry, unless I pack myself into the wolf's mouth, I'll be completely safe.
Go on, hurry off.

I'm going back.
Senior Sister was invited today to sit for a consultation and will return soon. Before that, you shouldn't wander off alone.
You... You... Ah, I'll settle this with you later.
You... you... Ugh, it's really both frustrating and amusing.
No, it's not my fault—it's your own laziness that messed things up～
Not good, what time is it now? I promised Qingcheng High Priest to help buy talismans. I was going to have lunch and then return, but I got caught by your trick. I can't delay any longer.
I didn't fall for Bewitching Incense, but for your trickery.
A Tang Clan disciple fell into the trap of his own clan's Bewitching Incense.

Was it my choice to sleep on the floor?
Who ordered me to bring food, then suddenly sprayed me with Bewitching Incense?
You said you'd wipe it off, but the cloth still had incense on it.
Brother, you really are a pig — the floor's so cold and you can still sleep.
Oh... after you said that... it seems like it was indeed my handiwork.
I'm asking you! Hurry up and untie me!
Pervert! How could you sleep in my room!
Oh, my ribs!
Don't read it!
But once you read it, we can never return to today.
Stop messing around
Because... because I don't want you to read.
Why?
No, Brother Duan, don't read that letter!
This pigeon is still flapping on my hand, probably looking for you.
Right, he used to talk like this — it was only later that he changed.
Yes, indeed, before even meeting, Ye has already bowed down in admiration of this brave man.
How could you...

If there really is such a person, he could be considered our brother too.
I'd love to meet him and see just what kind of hero, one who can bend and yield,
can put up with our sister's peculiar temper.
Is your brother a position? If he's missing, someone else can take over.
You say that as if such a person really existed.

Hey? You're the one who should be careful. The day you offend me, I'll replace you with a new brother in a heartbeat.
The new one might be a little less good-looking, but he won't be as arrogant or foul-tempered as you.
He'll spoil me rotten — I won't miss you one bit, not even a little!

You impudent thing, what do you mean by permissions and approvals? Don't forget that this Young Lord is a member of the Duan clan.
If anyone else heard you say that, they'd surely have you charged with disrespect.
Well then, I'll graciously permit Brother Duan to remain whole.
Split into two halves, and I'd be dead.
What's the problem? If you split into two, then I'll have three brothers.
Thankfully you didn't have a sword in your hand, otherwise you might have accidentally cut Brother Duan.
In short, you're just sleepy

I had a dream, sometimes I dreamed of things from long ago, and sometimes it felt like I was dreaming of future events.
In the dream, we seemed... seemed to have become enemies.
Don't know...
What happened?
Don't, don't come over!
Still drooling
Didn't you tell us to dance swords? When did you fall asleep?
Oh my!

Remember that your lives, brother and sister, are no longer your own.
Preserve the Ye family's blood, engrave the word 'righteousness' deep in your hearts, and give your lives for it without hesitation.
Yunshang, you must be Lord Yun's cloak, shielding him from the elements.
Yunzhou, you must be General Yue's boat, carrying him across the Yangtze River to recover my Song Kingdom's vast and beautiful rivers and mountains.
I'll say this only once, so you must remember it well.
Children, you two are both very clever, your father's pride and joy.
What do you want?
No need to be nervous, Brother. This Young Lord has been waiting a good while - not to fight you.
You... you're...! You knew I'd take this path?
You accompanied Ye Yunshang in laughing and eating until Tang Fang returned from the clinic and sent you away.
I believe.

That's not entirely without some deeper meaning either - I already told you I picked you on purpose to torment. Otherwise there are thousands who'd gladly lower themselves to come serve at my beck and call - don't you dare not believe it!
Oh, so that's how it is. Here I thought you were addicted to ordering me around.
In contrast, you, Brother, are entirely worthless; no one would even consider taking an interest in you.
Sister Fang is too kind - too easy to take advantage of. If I were a villain, I'd scheme against her too.
Yes, yes, yes, thank you so much for troubling me. So what about my senior sister Tang Fang?
Of course - you're the only one I've got figured out, Brother. You should be walking with pride. If it were anyone else, I wouldn't bother at all!
But you ate the food I brought just fine.
But does Young Lord Duan not stop to think who I, Ye Yunshang, am? A man I look down on - I'd think even his money filthy. I don't want gold or jewels, let alone care about food!

None of that. This inn is located opposite the government office, with first‑rate security. Since the hard approach won't work, he opted for a conciliatory strategy. Thus, the innkeeper collected money from someone, sent over a sumptuous feast, and urged me to eat.
But is it that you're out of money, or that you can't get used to the inn's food?
Well, thank you, Brother
I have no money, you'll have to make do for now.
This isn't from Li's Roast Meat Shop... and there's no dessert either...
Sure, I'm easy to please. Something sweet can shut me up.
I don't have much money, so I picked and chose - not sure if I got what you were hoping for.
Thank you, Brother!
I bought exactly what you asked for, so I hope you're happy.
Thank you, Brother!
Got it right!
Emergency in the jianghu, Yunshang is starving. Lying in bed, crying for food. Brother, hurry to the end of Qingxia Lane, to Li's Roast Meat Shop, and bring back countless delicacies...
Um
Read the pigeon message aloud
This time, I've got you
Oh no, don't take it away～ I was just mistaken～ Please don't take my food～
So nagging, you don't eat, you don't eat, I'll eat on my own.
Don't eat, I'll take it away!
What's the big deal? You're not using your face to peel shrimp, wash your hands clean, what's the problem?
If you can eat the shrimp I peeled, it's fine for me to peel them for you, but I'm just afraid you might lose your appetite.
If there are bones, shouldn't you help me remove them? If there are shrimp shells, shouldn't you help me peel them off?
You're eating alone, what's there to plate?
Just kidding~ Brother, you still need to help me set the table, don't leave yet.
Guess there's no arguing with you. I'll leave it on the ground outside, eat it while it's hot, don't let anyone take it.
Such a bad temper, that's just like you, can't take a joke.
I suggest you open the door properly, don't make me break it down.
Drive people away, yet leave the food? That's absolutely absurd.
Wrong! Put down the food, you can go.
Mountain forests with ink‑stained bones, scholarly fragrance; Flower Street's silk garments share the same stench.
It also depends on whether you believe me or not, oh? Is there no standard answer then?
You just tell me one, try it, and see if I believe you.
Still need the secret password? You didn't mention it beforehand.
The secret password?
Miss Ye, your summon has come
Ah, my roasted pigeon has flown away!
Didn't we say we'd face difficulties together?
Since it's not a reply, this is none of my business. She's the sworn sister you took in, so go take care of her yourself.
What's this mess...?
Oh, don't forget the saying about pastries and drinks. Without meat, one becomes thin; without sugar, Brother gets beaten!

Jianghu Rescue, Yunshang is starving. Lying in bed, starving and desperate for food. Brother, please hurry to Li's Roast Meat Shop at the end of Qingxia Lane, bring countless delicious delicacies to save me from my rumbling stomach! Sister Yunshang bows deeply.
Elder Brother Zhao Huo, with respect: Respectfully, the elder brother Zhao Huo should read this letter with due respect.
It's a homing pigeon! It must be a reply from the master's sect. Oh dear, both convenient and inconvenient. You hurry to open the letter and read it, so I can go and call Junior Brother.
Caught it! What good luck! Although I don't know whose pigeon it is, once I catch it, it's mine! My own bird, I can eat it whenever I want!
Oh, what's going on with this bird, it just flew straight into me without looking where it was going.
I won't say more; I'm off
No need to talk about trouble, we're all from the same sect. Share fortune, share hardship... though in truth there's been plenty of hardship and little fortune.
Well... so I'll have to trouble you, Junior Brother.
No way, I'll have to go myself. We can't just wait around forever.
Yes, it's truly unsettling. Let's hope he hasn't run into an enemy ambush.
So slow... Senior Brother went home for reinforcements, and he still isn't back? By rights, a round trip should take at most three to five days on foot.
Yes, yes, that's how it should be. If the Second Senior Brother comes himself, let's see who speaks louder!
We might as well pretend nothing happened and engage with him. Also, send someone back to the Tang Clan to bring reinforcements, and then turn against him once they arrive.
That's right
Dumb brother, don't be so reckless. Once you use poison, it will immediately turn into hatred between the two factions, and even the Tang Clan will hold you accountable.
Then I'll strike first! First, I'll poison the water well in Qingcheng, then replace all their incense in the incense burners with our sect's poison incense!
That old ox-nosed Iron Crown Daoist, bold as he is, still wouldn't dare cross the sect leader.

Uncle Tang chased him a thousand miles to kill him, furiously pounding on Songshan South Temple's gate over a hundred times — it shook the whole era. It scared the abbot into resigning and wandering off as a monk; who under heaven doesn't fear him?

That's right. If we act rashly without cutting off the root, once the Sect Leader learns of it, he'd fly into a rage and come charging into Qingcheng himself — who would dare guarantee his safety then?

The Tang Clan's reputation for ferocity is well‑known; both the underworld and the righteous forces hold their restraint. Uncle Tang has already said he would protect me thoroughly; under heaven, there are probably not many who dare to have such boldness, let alone dare to have thoughts of harming me. Even the Qingcheng Sect would have to weigh the pros and cons; how could they easily risk offending the Tang Clan?
Right, this isn't Dali. Even with his great prestige, Young Lord Duan must temper his demeanor, and he probably won't dare to start any trouble.
But a gentleman's revenge, even after ten years, is not too late. I believe he is temporarily not daring to act recklessly, so we can plan and then act.
Why are you hitting me? I'm innocent, right?

As for that scoundrel, forgiveness is naturally out of the question. No one has ever crossed me, the Demon King of Chaos Ye Yunshang, and lived to enjoy a peaceful day! Not even you are an exception! Hah!
It's not that it can't be done, really.
Hey? Aren't you curious about anything else? Not asking a single question, so straightforward?
Strategy
Things that don't have a 100% guarantee of being achieved, I hope you don't say anymore. I don't like hearing those. Let's change the topic.
Don't say that, you'll be fine
You won't die

I insist! I'll die on purpose, just to break your heart!
You'll regret not feeding me well every day with good food and drink while I was alive!
You want to abandon us, who have suffered so much, just to enjoy a carefree life? That's really heartless. Don't die!
Do not die

I don't care anymore. After all, I never cared about your Jianghu grudges. If I die of illness, let it be. From now on, I won't bother with anything else. You'll have to deal with your own troubles. Just suffer slowly.
Ugh, there aren't enough clues, I can't figure it out.
That's true
Don't forget, they happened to come up the mountain and drive off the Mud Cult's men.
Don't forget, there's another group of people posing as Mud Cult disciples.
That's too much!

Even you could think of it, Brother — that alone proves this guess is nine times out of ten wrong.
Clever as I am, and yet I ended up thinking the exact same thing as you; I feel my intelligence has been gravely insulted.
Yes
Wow... we don't have any evidence, it's just the two of us guessing wildly, but thinking about it, I can't help feeling a chill down my spine.

If the Tang Clan traces the issue back to Duan Zhixiu, the Duan Family of Dali will certainly not remain silent. Should the dispute from the Jianghu escalate into a conflict between two nations, the biggest beneficiary would be the Jin Kingdom.
The most suspicious are the Jin people. They may have colluded with Duan Zhixiu, hoping to stir up conflict in the Central Plains.
Jin people!
I haven't thought that far yet, after you said that...
Hmm, what about excluding Dali?
It is said that His Majesty the Emperor of Dali has no suspicion; he is indeed a virtuous ruler.
Assume this conspiracy is not targeting the Central Plains Wulin, but rather a foreign conspiracy?
Impersonating the Nangong Family, and the Siege of Jiangling—both incidents targeted the Nangong Family. Who stands to benefit? Could the mastermind behind it be the Mud Cult?
Do you think everyone's like me?
It's hard to say; they might not be seeking any benefits at all, purely to incite chaos.

True, the two countries share a border, but they've always kept out of each other's affairs. Dali and Song can hardly manage to stay at peace as it is—why would they go out of their way to provoke a tiger for no reason?
How could it be? Don't make wild accusations and blind guesses. Causing chaos in the Jianghu would bring Dali no benefit—only harm.
Could it be that this matter is related to the Duan Family of Dali after all?

Indeed, the Tang Clan is the long‑standing rival of Diancang. Those who understand Diancang best are none other than the Tang Clan. The Diancang Sect is a bunch of madmen, always shouting about seeking the Dao through swords, without such roundabout thoughts.
Come to think of it, this secretive, evasive style doesn't seem like the Diancang Sect's way.
Motive
I only desire your beauty
At least I didn't covet the treasure
You don't need to test your heart; you just know it's black.
Alas, people's hearts are always unable to withstand trials.
At least Brother's an honest scoundrel, a cut above a hypocrite—not nearly so slick, you can spot the villain in him at a glance.
What a load of nonsense! Those people themselves have unscrupulous intentions; they are the ones who should be gone.
Yes, and you too
Ah, that's assuming he actually thinks of me as a friend.
It's not that none are left; isn't there still me?

Seeing my older brother in such a disappointed state, sometimes I even think that if I hadn't been born, it would have been better. Then my older brother wouldn't have been abandoned by all, even his closest relatives, ending up with no friends left, which makes me feel very guilty.

Duan Zhixiu spread rumors about the Yue Clan's treasure to force us to reveal ourselves, and it worked. While my brother traveled the Central Plains, he made many friends who always talked about brotherhood and loyalty, yet they all believed the treasure rumors and turned into different people one by one—not one of them could be trusted.

The events that followed, you already know. No matter how destitute he became, he still carried the blood of the Duan Family; the Diancang Sect would only show favoritism towards him. My brother had no choice but to take me down the mountain to escape.
...Alright.
...Let's skip this part for now; I don't want to talk about it.
Alas, it's connected to the treasure, yet the treasure itself is secondary. The tale is intricate, yet not at all strange.
Could it be it's over the Yue Clan's treasure again?
I've finally come to know his true nature, but how did you two end up turning against each other?
What was the reason you turned against each other?
If it were me, I wouldn't sleep soundly a single night—afraid my head might get chopped off in the middle of the night.
That's right
If it weren't for the city walls and heavy military presence, even I could stroll into the palace. Imagine if there were a group of Wulin experts living next door to you‑could you not be on edge?
Brother, I don't think you understand, do you? Do you know how close the Diancang Sect is to Dali City?
It's surprising that the Dali Kingdom still values Jianghu sects.

The late emperor revered Buddhism, and mindful of their kinship, seeing him young and innocent, couldn't bear to take his life. He merely stripped him of his position as heir, barring him from inheriting the Duke of Loyalty's title, then sent him off to Diancang—rather like sending a hostage, meant to placate and win over.
In summary, although he was a royal relative, he had no power or influence. He was exploited by ambitious court officials, angering the emperor and nearly losing his head.
You really won't listen, huh... Well, then.
Since it's not very important, please speak briefly.
In a nutshell
Well deserved.
He has his pitiable side too.
Oh, so that's the case...
It's fortunate that he is still young, and the former emperor, following his father's example, was a Buddhist who did not wish to create more killing, so he exiled him to Diancang.
It turned out that person was just a hair's breadth away from becoming emperor.

He was bound to lose—he was only five years old that year.
Pushed forward by others without his consent, so close to succeeding only to fail, and made a criminal instead. How innocent he was.
But this coup ultimately ended in failure
That is Duan Zhixiu

I suppose so. So, the second branch, quiet for so long, started stirring again.
The Gao family's powerful ministers, suppressed for years by Emperor Xianzong, found a descendant of Emperor Tianming Duan Suxing,
a seven-generation descendant, only five years old——
Oh... This person is really... I don't know what to say. This is also another form of decadence and tyranny.

Emperor Xuanzong Duan Zhixing promoted Buddhism, but he was very shrewd and didn't easily become a monk. Before his monastic ordination, he abused his power recklessly, completely neglecting state affairs, and spent the entire treasury to build sixty temples! Sixty temples! The centuries of accumulated wealth from the treasury of the Dali Kingdom was all converted into his personal merit.
I knew it, let me guess, Duan Zhixing later became a monk. If he didn't, he was corrupt and licentious, inciting heaven's wrath and people's resentment.
The successor was Jingzong Duan Zhengxing, who abdicated the throne to his son, Duan Zhixing, and then became a monk.
Is the ending of the Dali Emperor's story only about becoming a monk?
But in his later years, he also became a monk.
Such a fierce emperor, no wonder you drew him like this.

During his reign, he was targeted for assassination by the Gao family more than once.
Emperor Xianzong would dismiss his attendants and personally fight the assassins himself, taking on many at once, undefeated every time, sparing their lives.
He would even praise the assassins for their loyalty, encouraging them to try again—and those who were accidentally killed could still be recorded at the tomb of the righteous.
Right, it's said that when his sword trembles, he can project invisible sword qi, injuring enemies from just over a zhang away.
What? He was the Diancang Sword Saint?

Emperor Xianzong, as a youth, once trained at the Diancang Sect and also mastered his family's inherited internal skill, practicing it to the highest Realm. He was both the ruler of Dali Kingdom and the contemporary Diancang Sword Saint, his martial arts skills divine, and he lived nearly a hundred years!
Go ask his mother, why ask me? How could it be the other person's fault? Senseless quarrel.

Wait, wait, why does this guy look different from the others! Only he has a body, and it's especially big, pushing the person next to him aside! Then the person next to him is really messy, is this atavism!
Next up is Emperor Xianzong Duan Heyu, who is really impressive. He was a youth who once...
It's different; actually, he went to Wuwei Temple. After all, his older brother is also at Tianlong Temple; it would be quite awkward to go there, wouldn't it?
Again, Tianlong Temple

The high‑ranking official from the Gao Family controlled the court, even after stepping down, he still served as chancellor. Duan Zhengchun was very afraid, so he voluntarily abdicated in favor of his son, Duan Heyu, and ran off to become a monk.
Half right
Let me guess, he was licentious and tyrannical, and was forced to become a monk at Tianlong Temple?
Has he become a monk again?
......Okay, I won't speak anymore.
Have you dug up his grave? Why do you say he isn't like this? What evidence?
How could someone look like this!
It's very sharp
I was very concerned earlier—what's wrong with this person's jaw? It looks like it's been sharpened.
Chin
Where did we get to? Oh, right, Duan Zhengchun.
It really is like that
Even the best person can look repulsive when standing across from you. For example, the Tang Clan and Diancang are at odds; I've often heard people criticize you, and I imagine you feel the same way.
Just like you, even though you're a terrible villain, you treat me well. Therefore, to me, you are good.
The loyalty and treachery, goodness and wickedness of people cannot be universally judged. Perhaps most people in this world are both good and bad.
Oh... I never thought... this evil minister actually has a conscience. Should he be considered an evil minister or a loyal minister?

The Gao family had held power for so long, with the emperor driven out, that he simply seized the throne himself. But guilt seems to have caught up with him, for he died after only three years, returning power to the Duan clan before his death. And so Emperor Zhongzong, Duan Zhengchun, younger brother of Emperor Baoding, succeeded to the throne.
What's going on with that Tianlong Temple? Is it a dumpsite?

The next one raised to the throne was Emperor Baoding Duan Zhengming. Though he lasted a bit longer, reigning for over a decade, he too was driven from the throne by that same minister surnamed Gao and forced into Tianlong Temple to become a monk.

This minister wanted to make himself emperor, but was soon killed by another minister surnamed Gao. The Gao family then put Emperor Shangming, Duan Shouhui, on the throne, but he was forced to become a monk after just a year as emperor.
Karma comes swiftly
Then he died. Killed by his ministers.
It seems that the Lian in Duan Lianyi's name isn't referring to moral integrity, but rather the meaning of cheap. Then, this Duan Lianyi looks like the Fourth Senior Brother.

After a century, Emperor Xiaode Duan Silian deposed Duan Suxing, and the political power finally returned to the control of the first branch. He reigned for twenty‑one years and was forced by his own son, Duan Lianyi, to shave his head and become a monk, retreating into Tianlong Temple.
He is clearly a villain!
He was deposed for his debauchery and fondness for courtesans, which enraged heaven and man alike, and Duan Silian, son of Duan Zhisi, great-grandson of Taizu, was installed as emperor in his place.
You're right, I've also suffered greatly; it was my carelessness.
Brother! You can't do that! How can you judge someone by their appearance? How can the goodness or badness of a person's character be determined solely by their appearance?
This guy doesn't look like a good person.
The last emperor of the second branch is the Tianming Emperor Duan Suxing.
After all, it's the bloodline of Emperor Taizu. Killing them would inevitably draw criticism. Thus, it led to the endless succession of power struggles between the two factions.
Is there such a good thing?

Duan Siliang did not eradicate the first branch entirely. After his death, his son ascended the throne as Emperor Guangci. The subsequent seven emperors, some wise and others foolish, ruled for a hundred years without completely eliminating the first branch, still granting them titles of prince and marquis, allowing them to enjoy wealth and honor.
Here, Duan Siliang, the uncle of Wenjing Emperor, ascended the throne, initiating the second branch of the Duan clan. His posthumous title was Saintly Benevolent and Martial Emperor.
Can you not keep involving me?
If I had to say, he's even more like you-rough on the outside and rotten within. You'd better take that as a warning, or you'll be the next one forced into the monkhood.

Far worse! I heard he was a debauched, tyrannical ruler who enraged heaven and man alike. He'd been on the throne barely a year, the seat still warm, when they dragged him down, shaved his head, and threw him into Tianlong Temple to be forced into monkhood.
Is he a bad person?
Bold! Bold! My memory is so good, how could I forget? The only reason is that Dali people hold a fear, dare not directly call his name, and only refer to him as that person.
Well, they are father and son, looking just like his father, and their hats are really strange. But why didn't you write his name? Could it be you forgot?
This is his son, the second‑generation emperor of Dali, Wenjing Emperor.
Right, he looks just like you, so hush up already!
This Emperor Taizu of Dali looks really rough.
Alright, look at the picture. This individual here is the founding emperor of Dali, the Holy Divine Emperor Duan Siping.
True, rushing won't get us anywhere anyway.
Right, drawing calms my mind; what's wrong with that? After all, Duan Zhixiu dares not do anything to us. The more we rush, the more it plays into his hands.
Is this... the genealogy chart of the Dali Emperor? You just went specifically to draw this?
Coming.
The task is completed‑Brother, come quickly to see my drawing!
As if forgetting the earlier panic, Ye Yunshang picked up the brush and wrote, spending the better part of two hours before finally declaring the task complete.
Since you've earnestly asked, then fetch paper and ink, prepare the ink for me! Just talking won't make it clear; you must draw it out.
Complete version
It's a long story, but even if we say it's important, it's not that important. Would you like me to tell it in detail or summarize it briefly?
What does this mean? High is high, low is low‑how can something be both high and low?
Both high and low
He's in charge of that pavilion. So was his status quite high?

Guess again! The one housing the scriptures is the Songyun Pavilion on the opposite peak, which is far older and located in the rear mountains of Diancang. The Songyan Pavilion, however, was built by the Emperor Xianzong's orders and sits atop the highest peak with the best view, offering a panoramic sight of the Cang Mountains‑while also allowing surveillance of the Diancang sect.
Is it a place like the Tang Clan's Scripture Hall or Songshan's scripture repository, used to store Diancang sect's scriptures and secret manuals?
Before discussing our grudge, let's first talk about this person's background. Brother, do you know what kind of place Songyan Pavilion is?
Ah ah... my heart seems improperly connected, fell to the ground and rolled twice, causing a subtle ache, not to mention the dust it picked up‑it's more uncomfortable than having a fever.
To be fair, although he was self‑deprecating and vain, he treated me quite well back then. I think he wasn't bad from the start.
I and my older brother are orphans who left our hometown to flee from calamity. Duan Zhixiu's parents are still alive, yet he was left alone.
Is that so...?
I... used to indeed call him Brother...

After I and my older brother entered Diancang, we bowed to the Sword Master Ting Haisheng as our teacher, and that person was the beloved disciple of the sect leader Guan Yun Ke. He said we grew up together from a young age, and actually, he didn't say it wrong.
You don't ask, I'll still say it
Young Master of Songyan Pavilion
I have nothing to say; money is truly important.
Even the six major sects of Central Plains, considered top‑tier, are like this, it's hard not to feel disheartened.
You're right

It's not necessarily foolish; perhaps it's just pretending to be. So-called righteous sects don't mean everyone in them is truly righteous, and not everything a cultivator says is true. As long as you pay to smooth things over, right and wrong aren't so important anymore.
Qingcheng's Daoist priest is too foolish, mistaking the thief for a good person, and it's better to trust him.
It's not impossible, you know. Even if it was originally a coincidence, once he found out who you really are, how could he let the tiger go back to the mountain?
Could it be that he found out about my whereabouts and intentionally came to track me down to kill me in silence?

I anticipated that the man injured by Brother's sword would not give up easily and would eventually come to seek revenge. However, suddenly facing him, I could not help but feel fear... I didn't expect him to dare come to Shu region.
I didn't disbelieve?
I saw with my own eyes, that person claimed to be Nangong Xiu!
That person is indeed the real mastermind!
Oh, so that's the case. Makes sense.

Hmm, Duan Zhixiu's own men can't be brought up the mountain, they're probably hiding in the front and back mountains. Although he will eventually bribe Qingcheng disciples with money, it's not going to happen now. He wants to newly join Qingcheng, so he still has to act obediently.
It seems no one is paying any attention to us. I accidentally made eye contact with someone, and he still showed a look of contempt.
You circled the house twice, flipped onto the roof, and gazed intently. The Qingcheng disciples, as usual, idled around or practiced their skills, with nobody paying any attention to you.

Hold on, to prevent eavesdropping through the walls, I'll go out and take a walk around.
Walls have ears

It's a long story; I don't know where to start.
Why don't you ask me? I'll tell you one by one, so I can slowly sort out my tangled thoughts.
How do you know that guy?
You're right...

Don't be afraid. Sect Leader Zou is righteous and resolute; he will certainly not allow Duan Zhixiu to act as he pleases. On the contrary, if we lose our composure, when he comes, we'll run, which would make us suspicious.
No, no, no, Brother, be calm, be calm~
Don't be afraid, stay here, I'll take up the knife and fight him to the death.
Yes!
Yunshang!
...Yunshang?
Outrageous! Qingcheng can't tell right from wrong at all!

I suspect Sect Leader Zou is stationed in the mountain fortress; even if he wants to act mischief, he must still be cautious. Now we are guests, and if we attempt to flee, it would only make us seem guilty of wrongdoing.
Duan Zhixiu appears, probably having already set up a trap that spans the heavens and earth. Setting out at this moment will certainly alert the enemy, and there's no way to escape.
Thanks to your unreliability, Ye Yunshang could only calm down slightly.
Stop～ You're a man of your standing; how can you be more panicked than me when faced with a situation?
Is this the calamity foretold by the thunder in the dry season? Qingcheng is no longer a place to stay; I must hurry and pack my belongings to leave! Quick, Yunshang, quick, pack your things!
He actually showed up here... What should I do?
It's all due to Duan Zhixiu's overconfidence, causing me, this old monk, to fail in handling the matter. Now I don't know how to report this to the Cult Leader.
It's all because of Duan Zhixiu's self‑importance, causing this old monk to fail in handling the matter and anger the Cult Leader.
A ridiculous game, wasting time
Very good
I vow to be Young Lord Duan's loyal servant, serving at his side! I will devote myself entirely to this duty until my last breath!
I, Qiuchanzi... this humble Daoist, Qiuchanzi......
