Perfect, this young lord happens to need someone useful in Qingcheng‑you'll be my errand boy.
It's not him! This is Young Lord Duan from Dali. I called for you lot and none of you were anywhere to be found‑the one we should've caught got away long ago!
Oh dear! Senior Martial Uncle, what are you doing?
Audacious rogue, this humble one‑
Senior Martial Uncle, someone's here! Who are you taking? This guy?
Well, this old Daoist isn't afraid, Qingcheng Sect isn't afraid either, but just make sure you're aware.
I specially sought the Daoist master's guidance for this matter, requesting permission to approach the Ye family maiden with gentleness, in hopes of thawing the previous grievances.

I have not yet received the sect leader's approval, nor formally performed the apprenticeship ceremony. I know the eminent ones of Qingcheng care nothing for wealth, viewing money as mere dirt. My ten boxes of apprenticeship gifts are modest, but they show my sincerity. I dare not let my personal grudge bring trouble to Qingcheng.
Of course, Qingcheng would never fear the Tang Clan.
Of course, this is based on the premise that they honestly stayed in Qingcheng without attempting to escape.

However, to strike at Ye Yunshang here might draw in Qingcheng, leading to unimaginable consequences. Qingcheng certainly does not fear the Tang Clan, but in my opinion, we are far from reaching the point where open conflict is necessary.
That outsider disciple is nothing but a minor figure, his life as cheap as an ant. Since he's joined the Qingcheng sect, even if he were killed, Old Demon Tang wouldn't hold it against him.
What? Old Demon Tang really said this?

Not because I'm soft‑hearted, but the master has been in seclusion for years and is unaware. The Tang Clan Sect Leader once declared they would protect the Ye siblings; anyone who dares to harm them is declaring war on the Tang Clan.

Xiu'er! You're being foolish! Once you've turned your back, you must carry through the matter completely, to prevent future troubles. I, the teacher, support you, yet you are so soft‑hearted‑how can you become a great person?
Master Iron Crown Daoist, forget it, I don't want to be untrustworthy.
Innocent child, don't go──
What else? Hurry up, hurry up～
Wait, is that it? Just left like that?
That's also your own fault, don't forget what you've done! Brother, let's go!
It's over. From now on, Jianghu will no longer have the Clear Smoke Swordsman. My career as a sword hero has ended, all because of you.
Your hand......
So his right hand really is crippled?
At least give me the chance to explain myself; whether you forgive me is another matter. I've paid a painful price too—doesn't that deserve some softening on your part?
Oh
Young Lord Duan, what you're doing is called a threat, not sincerity.
Yielding to this extent clearly demonstrates my sincerity. This time, don't even think about escaping from me.

{size=24}Yunshang, you know my temper—the Young Lord has never tolerated so much as a grain of sand in his eye, and once I'm in the right, I show no mercy.{/size}{size=24}Your elder brother Yunzhou isn't here, and on Qingcheng Mountain there's no one who can stop me from doing as I please.{/size}{size=24}So long as the Young Lord has no wish to forgive, there's no way this ends peacefully today.{/size}
Oh, bullshit!
My mind is made up, Master; there's no need to advise me further. Only this way can the Young Lord show the breadth of his generous heart. Younger Sister Yunshang, don't you agree?

{size=24}Young Lord Duan, this matter is neither big nor small—it all depends on your word.{/size}{size=24}As this old Daoist sees it, even if you mean to forgive them, you could still have the two of them seized first,{/size}{size=24}and taught a proper lesson—how could you let them off so lightly?{/size}
Huh?
What?

......But then, no man is a sage; who is without fault? Everyone deserves a chance to reform. Perhaps you, Young Hero Zhao, loyal and righteous at heart, were merely deceived by villains. The Young Lord chooses to forgive you this once, and will not pursue the matter.
Oh, really? Then come on and fight it out!
Qingcheng, a renowned righteous sect, could it be so indifferent to right and wrong!
You...!
You...!

Senior Brother's conduct here, though hard to admire, is not without reason. You two Laymen need not be so tense. With the Sect Leader watching over Qingcheng, once the truth comes to light, you will surely be given justice.
This old Daoist may as well say it to you straight: so what if I am? Injustice is nothing new in this world—blame yourself for being worth nothing, not even worth favoring!
Old Daoist Master, you are deliberately favoring him by always siding with him!
How absurd! Where did everyone go? Are they all dead? Insisting that this old Daoist has to personally take action.
You're right. Our Qingcheng Sect cannot stand idly by when faced with such injustice! Come here! Arrest them both, the brother and sister, and question them thoroughly!
This guy is still turning the tables!
How could you still turn the tables on me!

As a man of the Jianghu, as a swordsman, as a son of the Duan clan—what can be endured, and what cannot! You slander the Young Lord like this; I could draw my sword and cut you down right now, and no one could hold me accountable for it!

You shouldn't have done this, you shouldn't have done that, yet you even went so far as to include my former sect, the Diancang Sect, in your accusations. Is this an indirect way of accusing me, Duan Zhixiu, of being ungrateful? You not only insult my character as the Young Lord but also slander the Duan Family of Dali's reputation!
Dream on—if the Young Lord went to the Tang Clan, wouldn't that be a sheep walking into a tiger's den? Would you actually dare seize the Young Lord, torture him, and beat a confession out of him?
You have your own secret schemes that no one else knows about—dare you come with me to Meishan and settle this face-to-face?
Brother, if you have nothing to say, you don't need to force yourself to speak.
This...... How do I know you?
Moreover, Young Hero Zhao accuses me of hiding behind the scenes and harassing the Six Great Sects of the Central Plains. I wonder, for me and for the state of Dali, what benefit could there be?

I, Duan Zhixiu, am a distinguished member of the royal family of Dali. Unlike the Tang Clan, I would rather change my name than my surname. How could I forget my own ancestors and change my surname to Nangong? This is a great insult to me, the Young Lord.
Master, please judge this fairly.
Master, Daoist Shentu, kindly consider
I can't believe you'd say such a thing—you're utterly shameless.
Don't sling such baseless slander!

Younger Sister Yunshang, how can you be sure the Tang Clan isn't just staging this to win your trust and trick the secret of the treasure out of you? The Tang Clan's history of wrongdoing speaks for itself.
Miss Ye, whether you believe or not, it's naturally up to you. Whether this old Daoist believes or not, it should be up to me.
Huh?

Oh Brother, I did warn you, and yet you still let your sister run her mouth and offend people. As the saying goes, a child's misdeeds are the father's fault, and since you're standing in for our father, Shang'er's mistakes are your mistakes.
Yunshang!
Compared to that smelly guy over there, I certainly believe in Brother Zhao! As for why, it's because my mind is sharp and my eyes are keen, while you're not only blind but also as foolish as pigs!
Although I just said to keep a low profile, I can't help but feel this way!
Even you too?
......I'm sorry, Brother.
Then do you believe this young lord of the Dali royal family, or a mere outsider disciple of the Tang Clan?
Um, that's not the case
Or perhaps, was Miss Ye also present at that time?
This scoundrel insisted firmly that he is not the black hand; I really can't point him out on the spot.
Brother, that's enough for now. The situation's against us, and there's no use talking to them. Better we lie low and avoid a direct clash for the moment, for our own good...
You might as well ask the passerby, do you believe this Young Lord from Dali's noble family or merely a simple outsider disciple of the Tang Clan?
Just think reasonably. The lighter the person, the less trustworthy they are.
Daoist Shentu, how... did you...
I believe more in Young Lord Duan
Junior Brother, tell me, do you believe in this young lord from the Dali royal family, or this mere outsider disciple of the Tang Clan?
Heh, so the Young Hero himself personally witnessed it and now comes forward to name the culprit? Forgive this old Daoist's bluntness, but isn't that just your one-sided word?
How could you be so cold‑blooded?

What 'trusted henchman Nangong Ji'? This young lord has never even heard of him. You grab some random person, torture a confession out of him, and think you can frame this young lord? Hmph, not that easy.
You... you dare do it but dare not admit it! Despicable wretch! Your trusted henchman Nangong Ji has fallen into my Second Senior Brother's clutches, so there's no denying it now!
You can deny it all you want, but do you think that lets you off the hook? Don't forget, your trusted henchman Nangong Ji has been captured by the Tang Clan, so there's no room for your lies.
No
Young Lord Duan, this Young Hero Zhao accuses you emphatically. Do you admit it? Did you go to great lengths to impersonate Nangong clan members and attack the Six Great Sects of the Central Plains?
In the ruined temple at Meishan Town, I saw it with my own eyes! At the time, I had infiltrated a band of Greenwood bandits and was mistaken for one of them, so they let the plot slip to me!
Oh...? There's such a thing. May I ask, Young Hero, how did you come to know such a secret matter?

It must be this person who impersonated a Nangong clan member, bribed bandits, and disguised as a righteous individual to launch a night attack on the Tang Clan! The attacks on various sects are surely linked to this person!
Daoist, this guy is not a good person!
Daoist, may I add one more word?
Two Daoists, it's this fellow!
Two Daoists, please hear me out!
Though the words are not pleasant to hear, they are indeed very reasonable. Too many comic roles on the stage will only make Jianghu murky and corrupt.

Even fighting one-handed as a concession, you're still no match for this young lord.
As a henchman, know your place—why show off and get yourself killed?
Brother, stop fighting. His internal skill is profound; if you hit him, you'll end up injuring yourself instead.
Damn it!
You're just dreaming!
After all, the Ye siblings and I are like family—we just have some misunderstanding. It's nothing irreconcilable; we only need to talk it through.
I can't sympathize with you!
Oh, right, his hand...
Master Iron Crown, never mind it. Fighting one-handed, I fought this man to a draw - that's no disgrace to you, Master.
Not reliable at all!
Layman Zhao struck first; this humble Daoist has nothing more to say.
Daoist Shentu, say something!

I dare not, but Iron Crown Daoist is the eldest of our sect. Yet he was at odds with a junior from another sect within Qingcheng. Once this spreads, the world will accuse Qingcheng of bullying with power.
Yichenzi, siding with outsiders now?
...Senior Brother, they are evenly matched; why go out of your way to interfere?

What a low-class enlightened master! Earlier your disciple looked so sure of himself, and you didn't stop him, just stroked your beard and smiled. Now that you've realized my brother isn't easy to bully, you want to pretend to be fair?
Insolence! For Sect Leader Tang's sake, I'll go easy on you. How dare a rat like you harm my disciple?
What underhanded tricks is this ugly brute pulling? Getting kicked and punched by him in front of Yunshang - how can I keep any face!
This man's Internal Skill runs incredibly deep - my punches and kicks against him nearly dislocated my own joints.
You're just dreaming!
After all, the Ye siblings and I are like family—we just have some misunderstanding. It's nothing irreconcilable; we only need to talk it through.
I can't sympathize with you!
Oh, right, his hand...
Master Iron Crown, perhaps it's better to give up. It's all my fault for being overconfident; fighting with one hand, losing the battle, there's nothing to say.
Not reliable at all!
Layman Zhao struck first; this humble Daoist has nothing more to say.
Daoist Shentu, say something!

I dare not, but Iron Crown Daoist is the eldest of our sect. Yet he was at odds with a junior from another sect within Qingcheng. Once this spreads, the world will accuse Qingcheng of bullying with power.
Yichenzi, siding with outsiders now?
...Senior Brother, he is still our guest.
What a low-class master! Your disciple looked so sure of himself earlier, and you didn't stop him, just stroked your beard and smiled. Now that he's lost, you come to uphold justice?
Insolence! For Sect Leader Tang's sake, I'll go easy on you. How dare a rat like you harm my disciple?
Why do you care what move it is? Any move that can beat you is a good one.
This is the Turtle-Slaying Fist, made especially to deal with bastards.
This isn't Tang Clan martial arts! What move is this?
Huh, turns out Brother's martial arts skill is this high.
That sudden strike wasn't half bad.
It happened so fast that I saw it coming but still couldn't react in time!
Wow!
I can't act rashly first, or else I'll give them an opportunity to accuse me, but I can still report it!
Report immediately!
Damn it, you're telling bald-faced lies, you piece of shit!
Throw a few punches first!
Stay away from her!
Who's your little sister! Don't talk nonsense—my Brother Zhao is right here, you, you'd better not try anything!
Yes, that Young Lady is the orphan of the Ye family—Yunshang, whom this disciple watched grow up since childhood.
Xiu'er, do you know these two people?
Diancang sect's? That's no surprise at all!
You are from the Diancang Sect. As far as I know, the Diancang Sect is obsessed with swords, yet their conduct remains upright. When did someone like you emerge?
What!
He's not a Nangong clan member at all! This scoundrel is from the Duan Clan of Dali──the young master of the Diancang Sect's Songyan Pavilion, Clear Smoke Swordsman Duan Zhixiu!

How could I not recognize him? Even if he turned to ash, I would never mistake him! That day at the ruined temple, it was this Nangong Xiu who bribed bandits and disguised himself to attack the Tang Clan!
You also...? Could it be...?
Wait, do you know this person?
You!
You... It's you!
Hmm? How come there are disciples from other sects wandering around Qingcheng?
Senior Brother, forgive me...
Junior Brother, don't tell me you're planning to send this fellow to represent us in the competition?
I would kill them all with a single palm strike, but I can't.
Oh, don't kick me, I was just joking.
Oh dear, don't kick‑food and sex are the nature of man. Isn't this a natural human feeling?
You just go ahead and envy, you pervert.
How could you not know you're in a place of happiness?
Sigh, these ladies are everywhere; I truly don't know how to deal with them.
Daoist, you're being a bit too harsh on your dignity.
So Daoist Shentu has a weakness after all.
Hmph... I don't believe this door god will stay in Qingcheng forever. Daoist Shentu, you may dodge the first of the month, but not the fifteenth! Sisters, let's go!
You're using this move again?
Hmm? You're saying something quite strange. If you don't let me provoke you, what other use is there?
If you don't provoke me with your words for a while, you feel off all over, right?
Where did you learn to talk so sweetly? Even a good-for-nothing brother like you knows how to flirt with young ladies? Shameless!
Little sister, you're so beautiful you'd shame the moon and put flowers to shame—turns out you're a heavenly maiden come down to earth!
Fie, how shameless! Who is your wife! Where did you learn to be so smooth‑tongued? Even you, my smelly brother, dare to hit on me, speaking like an animal.
My dear, you're so beautiful that you could close the moon and shame the flowers; you're actually my wife.
Brother, you looked frightening, but it turns out you're just Tang Clan small fry.
These two seemed unremarkable at first glance, but they turned out to be Qingcheng elites.
Yes
Bibozi, come with me. When the exam comes, I intend to enter you in the trials, testing your Internal Skill first.
Let's see who is at fault
It seems this fight is unavoidable. For Martial Uncle Bu Ping's sake, I'm afraid I'll have to offend you, Junior Brother.
Yes
Nephew-Disciple Gao He, come over here. The Segment Exam is approaching, and as my—Buping's—prized disciple, don't waste time squabbling with others. I'll start training you again from the ground up.
So you're in cahoots with them!
Infinite longevity and blessings, greetings, Daoists. Have you seen my brother Zhao Huo? I've looked everywhere but haven't spotted him.
I was ignored, huh?
Damn it, looking down his nose at people—what's so great about that?
Infinite longevity and blessings, Miss Ye.
Greetings, Daoists......
But I can understand.
Although I only half understand what Miss Ye said, seeing you two play around all the time, with such harmonious feelings, almost like siblings, I can't help but smile.
Haha!
This is getting more and more off—you'd better keep quiet!
You all heard what my brother said! No money needed! My brother is free and can be used freely!
Oh
No, no, no! This has nothing to do with money, okay?!
You all heard what my brother said! You have to pay extra!
Oh
You're pricing me a bit too cheap, aren't you?
Put away that greedy look of yours—I'm the one who guards my brother's chastity! If you want to lay a hand on him, hand over fifty wen first!

Speaking of demons, Brother Zhao, I'll say something harsh. When I first met you, I thought I saw a ghost. Over time, I got used to it and found out you're pretty easy to get along with. Hmm, a good man.
You're right!

You, Ye Yunshang, aren't you just a small‑scale natural disaster that keeps moving around? Whoever touches you ends up suffering; you're just a little one, but the damage you cause isn't less than thunder or a strong wind. I think even monsters see you and get combed bald.
It's just baseless nonsense—what are you afraid of?
Don't scare me... I mean, don't scare my sister.
It's really scary... Maybe it's better not to go out lately.
There is such a saying, generally considered to indicate impending disaster or the emergence of demons.
Daoist, my brother said that the phenomenon of thunder on a sunny day is an ill omen. Is that true?
Infinite longevity and blessings, greetings to you both.
Greetings, Daoists.
No thunder anymore? Then I'm alive again!
The thunder seems to have stopped.
Ashamed, I have failed in my teachings, and my children lack outstanding talents, so I will not cause further trouble.
It seems the two elders have no objections. Sect Leader, Junior Brother, if you're not content with solitude, why not send out a disciple too—let's make it lively.

Iron Crown Senior Brother, what good fortune you have. In the past, Lai Xinzi was simple and steadfast; today, Young Lord Duan can endure humiliation and bear a heavy burden. Their natures couldn't be more different, yet both are talents worth cultivating.
......Heh heh.

That's right, the Qingcheng Internal Method hinges on the ability to remain calm and patient; winning isn't about immediate victory. You've just joined the sect, and defeating a Qingcheng disciple would disgrace the Qingcheng sect. Today's loss will be redeemed in the future when you use Qingcheng martial arts to triumph again, and only then will others respect you and acknowledge your strength.
Oh... you've reached such an insight, that's no small feat.
Master's words are full of profound mysteries; winning is losing, and losing is winning.
Junior Brother, your question is a bit foolish. Don't forget, after all, I am also from the Qingcheng Sect.
Oh? You're also a young hero who's made a name in the Jianghu, willing to admit defeat?

Martial Uncle Buping's straightforward nature is what makes his methods effective, but they don't work on Master Huaisu. In truth, as Master said, I'm still a newcomer, not yet proficient in my craft. How could I possibly be a match for the Senior Brothers? Struggling for thirty to forty moves without falling would already be sufficient.
Young Lord Duan, your provocative strategy does work.

You little brat, you've got quite the attitude. Don't think I'm just talking about your broken arm‑even if your right hand were intact, my disciples wouldn't be inferior to you! Iron Crown Senior Brother wants you to enter the competition, heh, who will be the one to be embarrassed then?
Could it be that my two Martial Uncles worry that the Nephew-Disciple's performance on stage might dampen the prestige of Qingcheng's finest disciples?
Sect Leader, in my opinion, Young Lord Duan's status is special, and the matter of entering Qingcheng should be carefully considered.

Moreover, the Duan Family of Dali's Ku Rong True Qi is also an internal divine technique. Xiu'er joining Diancang was already like casting a pearl into the dark; how can you prevent him from mending the fold after the sheep is lost? His foundation is solid, and with my personal guidance, he will surely become a pillar of Qingcheng in the future.
Old Patriarch Nangong promoted studying at other sects, easing sectarian divides. My taking on a disciple who arrives with existing skills‑isn't that reasonable too?
My gracious teacher naturally agreed for me to become an apprentice under the Iron Crown Immortal.
That's correct. However, regarding the matter of switching allegiance to Qingcheng, has Sect Leader Guan inquired about it?

In the midst of utter despair, I was guided by the Iron Crown Immortal: Qingcheng martial arts are vast and profound, unlike Diancang, which excels in agile techniques, but relies on robust Internal Force. I still wish to deepen my martial arts practice, and Qingcheng shall be the only path. I need not practice sword techniques; I can instead master palm and fist arts.
Junior, I have lost my right hand; in swordsmanship, I fear that even with a lifetime, there will be no further progress.
This arm is injured this badly; even if it heals, you won't be able to use a sword anymore.

Duan's reputation, though not as far‑reaching as that of the Cangsong Swordsman, is still nothing to scoff at. I only lament that I underestimated his resolve; caught off guard for a moment, I had this sword arm of mine injured.

I won't hide it from the esteemed masters. The disciple and the Ye siblings were once close, like brothers and sisters. Later, due to some reasons, a misunderstanding arose. My Ye brother regarded me as a person driven by self‑interest, deeply protective of his sister, and drew his sword against me.
Sect Leader, there is something you may not know. Alas, it's a long story.

Young Friend Duan, you are still young yet oversee one of the two Diancang mansions, holding a high position. And you are also a kinsman of the Duan clan. The Diancang Twin Venerables would never neglect you. How come you are now coming to Qingcheng to seek a master?

Martial Uncle Huaisu, what a good memory you have. I, the junior Duan Zhixiu, humbly oversee the Diancang Songyan Pavilion. Unfortunately, my name isn't well‑known in the Jianghu, so I dare not show off in front of the senior masters. I'll just refrain from mentioning it.

Young Lord, are you a disciple of the Diancang Sect and a member of the Duan clan of Dali? A few years ago, at the Leshan Sword Discussion, you and the Cangsong Swordsman Ye Yunzhou were both present. I was deeply impressed.
You... Wait, I recognize you, you... you seem like...
Disciple pays respects to Martial Uncle Sect Leader and the two Elder Martial Uncles.
Xiu'er, come in and pay respects to the several Martial Uncles.
Have you recently taken in a disciple?

This old Daoist also wanted to send someone to compete. It's not to contend with the two Junior Brothers over such petty power or gain, but rather to use this as an opportunity to introduce this old Daoist's newly taken disciple to the people of Qingcheng.
After all that, you still have no opinion.
High opinion? No. I thought the method proposed by the Sect Leader's Junior Brother, where an elder assigns a disciple to compete, was still quite good.
......Good, then what is the Iron Crown Elder's esteemed opinion? I would like to hear the details.
He knew well of the master's past friendship with Junior Martial Brother Zhao, yet deliberately brought it up, seemingly intending to make the master feel guilty.

Iron Crown Senior Brother has spent over ten years in secluded cultivation, and his temperament hasn't changed one bit. Having kept to himself for years, he makes his appearance with a great show of force, trading on his seniority to try to overpower the Sect Leader.

But this old Daoist could not entirely eliminate worldly desires; the sect is in trouble, and all disciples of our sect bear responsibility. This old Daoist, humbly being the eldest among the 11th generation disciples, how could he remain seated?

Alas, due to Zhao Kui's betrayal of the sect, this old Daoist lost his beloved disciple Lai Xin, his heart turned cold with grief, and he retreated from Jianghu. These years, he has forced the heavy burden of Qingcheng upon you, and feels deeply remorseful.
Iron Crown Senior Brother, you have been in retreat for many years; now returning to the world, everyone is very relieved!
That... you're right.

That refers to you two squabbling over trivial matters like posts and duties.
Now the New Demon Cult has risen, stirring up storms in the Jianghu and harassing Qingcheng - is that still a small matter?
You're all Qingcheng veterans - can't you tell what matters and what doesn't?

Iron Crown Elder, that's not so.
It was you who ordered us not to disturb your seclusion - could it be that you're so important you've simply forgotten?
Iron Crown Senior Brother, this is before the Sect Leader's seat‑how dare you be so disrespectful!

Junior Brother Sect Leader, please wait!
The two elders have no objections, but I, old Daoist that I am, have yet to give my answer - how can you settle this already?
Is it that you don't think much of me, Iron Crown Daoist, at all?
Yes.

Since none of you have objections, the matter is settled.
Within three days, report your chosen candidate, and burn incense to inform the Three Pure Ones.
From now on, unless someone resigns or the post falls vacant for cause, there shall be no more disputes.

Even if he truly doesn't know his place and wants to compete with the two of us, he doesn't have what it takes anyway.
It's no wonder, spending all his days carrying on unclearly with female pilgrims and never even taking on a single disciple.
All the elders have valid points, and he himself also shares this view.

Senior Brother is right - Junior Brother Shentu is devoted to the Dao and fond of nature.
If we burden him with worldly duties, it might hinder his cultivation.

Junior Brother Shentu, though he's Martial Uncle's closed-door disciple and one of our own tenth-generation brethren, is still quite young.
I fear the sect's various duties would be too heavy a burden for him, and hard to win people's respect besides.
Very good. As for Junior Brother Shentu...

Yes, I have already paid respects to the Fire Dragon Immortal Monarch and am registered for now as an apprentice at the Flying Heaven Gate. I wondered what eminent figure Ah He Xia was, but it turns out it was Senior Sister Yu playing tricks on me.
My master is Fire Dragon Daoist of the Flying Heaven Gate; you must have already met him.
So, a formal self‑introduction. It's a pleasure to meet you. I am Yu Xiaomei, a Direct Disciple of the Flying Heaven Gate.
Ha ha ha～
This isn't something to be rejoiced in, is it?
Fortunately, now that we've met, I'm confident I won't see you as a person at all!
It's different; I like dogs more than people.
In your eyes, are all those who flatter you like dogs?

You should get a little more worked up, like the other Senior Brothers did when they saw me,
with faces as eager to please as a dog's.
Otherwise, what should I do?
You're clearly praising me, yet so coldly! Mei is utterly devastated!
Hmm, the miss indeed possesses the beauty that makes the moon hide and the flowers blush.
Not bad, I suppose
Just joking!
Wait, really?
Hahaha, your expression is a bit scary. Mei is quite frightened and already wants to go home.
Truly enchanting
This girl is indeed very beautiful, like plum blossoms blooming in the snow, white with a hint of red, pure and charming.
Yes
Ha ha ha～
This isn't something to be rejoiced in, is it?
Fortunately, now that we've met, I'm confident I won't see you as a person at all!
It's different; I like dogs more than people.
In your eyes, are all those who flatter you like dogs?

You should get a little more worked up, like the other Senior Brothers did when they saw me,
with faces as eager to please as a dog's.
Otherwise, what should I do?
That's supposed to be a compliment, but so cold! Xiaomei is devastated!
Hmm, the miss indeed possesses the beauty that makes the moon hide and the flowers blush.
How's it going? The girl introduced by Ah He Xia, are you still satisfied? Is your little heart spontaneously racing uncontrollably?
This elder is truly interesting
I'm sorry to the person who snores loudly. I'm sorry to the person who sleeps without clothes.
Oh, right. I'm sorry, I often overlook others' feelings.
Alright, alright. I'll go out. Senior, please quiet down, there are still many people asleep.
Come out to play! Come out to play! Come out to play!
This Crane Hand Elder's clinginess rivals the Eldest Senior Brother's. No, not the same... she at least invited me from outside, while the Eldest Senior Brother would just barge in and kidnap me.
Come out to play! Come out to play! Come out to play!
Then you're definitely going to come out and play. Don't even think about running away; I know your name and where you live. I'll come bother you every day until you come out.

Then please spare me, Senior. The less you know, the longer you live.
I only came to Kongtong to properly learn the arts.
Oh... you really might be pushed off the mountain by someone.
I am naturally not afraid of idle chatter, but if the young lady mentioned by my senior is too beautiful or has too good of a reputation, I often end up being envied and beaten afterward.
You are upright in heart, merely forming ordinary friendships; why worry about others' gossip?
I do mind; you can imagine how I'd be used as an example‑like the toad wanting to eat a swan.
What if she herself doesn't mind?
Even though we're all Jianghu folks who don't mind small details, you see... I mean, I do look like this, after all.

That's not a matter of liking or not; it's for the girl's sake.
If the girl you mentioned, Senior, is too kind and gets too playful with me, it would hurt her own reputation too.
Indeed, being quiet and gentle, soft as cotton, is better.
Being too lively isn't good either? Could it be you prefer quiet women?
Being too lively isn't good
Well, strictly speaking, it's not really very pretty, just okay, right? Being outgoing and lively is an advantage; is that satisfactory for you?
It's better not to compare if someone is too beautiful; men and women should not be too familiar.
Okay
Yesterday you practiced, today you rest‑this is called the balance of tension and relaxation. Hurry up and come out.
Ha ha ha! Naturally, what Xiaomei says makes sense.
Senior, your guidance is spot on. I'm bowing in complete humility.
Your name is Zhao Huo, right? If you don't understand carpe diem, then you're not living up to your name. You can only be called Zhao Huxi at most.
You're overworking yourself, feeling so distressed and wronged, and angry. You've been enduring, even though you know tomorrow might not get better?
Me? How am I used? I'm a person, not a prop.
Really? Then you're not meant to be used that way either.
No, just saying the stairs aren't used like that...
Stairs are like weapons; they have no inherent good or bad. It's the person standing on the windward side of the stairs who decides whether to do good or evil.

That's not what stairs were made for!
Besides, stairs don't only help good people, do they?
The staircase is the most selfless accomplice to each pitiful person who longs for revenge.
You can take matters into your own hands; even if you can't beat them, you can still push them down the stairs from behind when they're not looking.

Living under someone else's roof, if you can bear it, bear it. Take a step back, and the sky will be wide and the space vast. Even if I can report to the Disciplinary Officer, once I report once, the next time someone else will come to bully me. As an outsider disciple, if I keep complaining about other initiated disciples all day, in the end, even the master will come to hate me.

You don't have to grow strong at all.
Just find a chance and push those senior brothers who love to bully people down the stairs—that'll do it.

Filing complaints is useless—those disciples come and go, they usually don't stay long.
I need to grow strong enough on my own that no one can bully me anymore.
That's an outrage! Don't your sect's elders do anything about it?

They can just barge in and beat me up.
They'd yell at me for still sleeping when the sun's already high, asking why I'm not off doing chores to honor our sect.
If you don't go out, what more could they do?

I've lost count. After that, I just stopped going out whenever someone tried to provoke me.
But of course, people looking to bully you don't just give up that easily.
That miserable thing happened to you more than once?!

The second time, and the third time I fell for this trick,
I believed that same nonsense about 'I'm different.'
...I'm not trying to mock you. I'm different. Come on out.
Because this isn't a joke to them—I myself am the joke.

That's just too cruel...
You people in the Tang Clan sure have an unfunny way of joking around.
If I protect that miss, you will quarrel and force me to marry that innocent young miss. If I am angry, it will become an opportunity for you to break off and fight with me.

But going by past experience, the moment I happily agree...
you'll push out some girl who's also been bullied for her looks.
Then a crowd will come rushing out from every direction to mock us as a perfect match.
Hey, that's great!

Hi, nothing much—I just wanted to ask if you'd like to come out and have some fun.
I can introduce you to a lovely young lady and show you around the famous sights of Kongtong Mountain.
You've been cooped up here for days anyway, and nobody's taken you around, right?
Oh... I wonder what wisdom you have for me, senior. And why won't you let me train?
I am the spirit crane who has cultivated on this mountain for a thousand years, known as... the Crane Hero!
...Dare I ask, what divine being are you?
Yes, that's me!
You looked toward the sound and saw, at the window, a crane-shaped puppet hand speaking to you.
Where are you looking? Over here.
Who? Who is speaking?
Hold off on your training for a moment—you there, the guy in blue!

Good, the quilt's folded.
Today I'll put in extra effort on my training!

Since joining the Tang Clan, this has been the first time you've been so far from home, and a certain amount of anxiety is inevitable. However, at this moment, your heart is filled with determination and ambition, burning with passion. Your six‑month study period at the Kongtong Sect has officially begun.
Stop meddling!
Isn't this nickname a bit too long and awkward to say? Just call him Blazing Divine Eagle instead—it's smoother, and easier for people to remember.
That's fine, that's fine! Then I'll be going first, as the younger brother. Master Zhao, please do as you wish, I'll be taking my leave now.
So you're Senior Brother Xu, the Flying Heaven Fiery Flame Divine Eagle! I've long admired your name!
What a grand nickname! It must be self‑chosen!
I am Xu Sheng, the Flying Heaven Fiery Flame Divine Eagle.
Thank you. Might I ask how to address you, Senior Brother?

This is our sect's newly built guesthouse; you'll be staying in the southern Lingguang chamber.
Feel free to train here, and when you have time to spare, you can stroll through the Colorless Square market.
You're registered under the Flying Heaven Gate, so there's nowhere in Kongtong you can't go—count your blessings, Old Zhao.
This Immortal Monarch expects nothing from you. You may go.
Thank you, Senior! I will definitely devote myself to training!

That's all; you may withdraw.
If during your six months at the Kongtong Sect you cause no trouble and train diligently,
this Immortal Monarch will then teach you profound martial arts.

Today, this Immortal Monarch will first grant you a secret manual of the Flying Heaven Gate.
Go and study it well; in time, someone will come to guide you through the martial arts within.

No matter. It's only natural that a mere mortal should admire this Immortal Monarch's methods.
If you truly wish to seek immortality and serve this Immortal Monarch, you'll need to bide your time and see what fortune brings.

How dare you! Samadhi True Fire is my master's exclusive immortal art!
You, a mere mortal, dare covet the immortal arts—what are you plotting!
Please, I also want to spray fire

Hmph, clinging to worldly attachments, short-sighted, pitiable and laughable. Ah well — the foolish delusions of a common mortal; this Immortal Monarch will make an exception and humor you, just this once.
No, I just want to practice some mundane martial arts.

Since you've drawn the Flying Heaven Gate lot, that's a sign of considerable karmic fortune on your part. But the path to immortality cannot be achieved without decades of arduous, single-minded cultivation — let alone in a mere half a year.
Why did I almost get killed and still have to thank the criminal?
Um... Thank you, senior?

...You wretch, you're hideously ugly, you gave me a fright. If it weren't for this Immortal Monarch's extraordinary composure and quick restraint of the immortal art, you'd already have been burned to death by the Samadhi True Fire. Now hurry and kneel to thank this Immortal Monarch for sparing your life.
Uh!?
Junior Zhao Huo of the Tang Clan pays his respects to Senior Fire Dragon Immortal Monarch, Sect Leader of the Flying Heaven Gate.
Yes
Among those assigned to the Flying Heaven Gate, there are also Quanzhen Sect members. This Immortal Monarch has no wish to invite the world's mockery over such an empty title.

Heh, calling this Immortal Monarch "Immortal" — you creature, ugly as you are, you've got a bit of an eye for things. But for now, you'll address this Immortal Monarch as "Senior," same as everyone else.
Junior Tang Clan Disciple Zhao Huo humbly greets Senior Fire Dragon Immortal.

Since joining the Tang Clan, this is the first time you've left home so far, and a bit of anxiety is inevitable. However, at this moment, your heart is filled with ambition and determination, brimming with fervor. Your academic life at the Kongtong Sect for half a year has officially begun.
Thank you... ah, they're already gone, didn't even tell me their name. How cold.

Just watch out for thieves when you go down to the Colorless Plaza. If there's no summons from a master or elder, try to avoid the Flying Heaven Gate as much as possible. If you go there, first you'll draw suspicion from us at the Soul-Stealing Gate, and second, you can't be sure you won't suffer disgrace. Take care.
This is our sect's newly built guesthouse; you will stay in the Mengzhang Chamber on the east side. You may focus on your training here; when you have free time, wandering around is also fine.
Let a Junior Brother from the sect take you to the guesthouse. Everything you need for daily life will be provided; we'll come find you for a chat again in a few days.
Understood. I'll keep it close to heart.

What we've confessed to you today — if you want to report it to the Flying Heaven Gate to curry favor, that's up to you. But if the Soul-Stealing Gate gains power, you'll never set foot on Kongtong Mountain again in your lifetime.
Don't get too excited just yet; first courtesy, then force. Since I've given you this secret manual, no one can accuse the Soul-Stealing Gate of being stingy. There's more unpleasant talk coming.
Thank you, both Senior Brothers.
However, using your fingers instead of claws to practice this technique, I suppose it's also acceptable.

Our sect excels in unconventional weapons; by rights, the sect leader should personally lead the trip to the Iron Fist Gate to have a pair of iron claws custom-made. But with the sect leader away, and neither of us able to summon the Iron Fist Gate's craftsmen, we'll have to trouble you instead.
This is the sect's introductory secret manual. Now, the Acting Sect Leader is transmitting it to you.
Don't worry — whatever the other three Gates can do for you, given our standing within the sect, we should be able to manage it too.
But I've come all this way — surely you're not going to send me straight back home, are you?
If there's no karmic connection to receive the transmission, then there's nothing that can be done.

Since both of you say I'm half one of your own, then of course the Soul-Stealing Gate's important matters take precedence. It's true I came to the mountain to learn martial arts, but frankly, that's just my own personal business.
I see.

The Venerable Golden Crow's signature weapon, the Blazing Sun Hammer, happens to be the natural nemesis of our sect's martial arts. The sect leader is absent because they took our sect's finest into a mountain cave to seek a way to counter it. It's already been six months — not out of any intent to neglect our guests.
If the General of Dao Techniques who left Flying Heaven Gate to join the army doesn't return to compete, the candidate Flying Heaven Gate puts forward will undoubtedly be the Venerable Golden Crow.
Well, of course, a country cannot go a day without a monarch.

This is a major event for our sect that happens once every thirty years. Our previous sect leader passed away before completing their term; since our sect has always attracted many extraordinary individuals, we cannot go without a leader. No matter what happens, the sect leader election will go ahead as planned next year.
Somewhat heard of
You must have already heard about the upcoming election for the Kongtong Sect Leader.
What do you mean? Please enlighten me.
Brother Zhao, you're fortunate enough to have entered my Soul-Stealing Gate, so I suppose that makes you half one of us. Shall we speak plainly?
None of them. The Sect Leader is not here.
Uh... forgive my poor eyesight. If I may ask, which of you is Senior Yao, the Soul-Stealing Sect Leader?
This junior, Zhao Huo of the Tang Clan, pays his respects, senior.
What's all this about overstepping? Don't be so overly formal‑just be straightforward!
Since senior insists, then let your humble junior dare to overstep here.
Good, young Zhao, now that's what I call being straightforward.
Good, Brother Lei! This lad Zhao Huo, please give me your guidance.
It's true, today there are outsiders, so they called the sect leader to avoid being laughed at. It made us feel very awkward.
After all, you don't know someone unless you fight; don't be too formal. In fact, these Iron Fist Gate disciples have been used to calling me Senior Brother.
This gate leader seems undignified for his age, but he's a warm-hearted person.

After all, that's the gist of it. You get the idea. Who's to blame for the fact that my fellow disciples don't care at all? If I don't step up again, I fear the Iron Fist Gate brothers will be bullied even worse by the other three sects.
How should I know? It might be something you just made up. Grand Sect Leader... If you haven't read books, don't be stubborn.
What's wrong with it? This is called that thing, what stinks like a pig... can't be on the table? Is there such a proverb?
How can that be possible?

Little Brother, this time it's my fault. If you don't mind, don't call me Sect Leader; just call me Senior Brother. I'm only a few years older than you, with a bit more beard. Being called Sect Leader feels awkward.
Stop talking nonsense, who could possibly have such a thing? Enough, don't say anymore; the more you say, the more it doesn't make sense.
No, Sect Leader, he's always looked like this.

But my recklessness isn't something that happened just a day or two ago. You bunch of kids, not only didn't you stop me, but you even joined in the fun. Look at how you left that person in such a state of disarray‑how can I possibly make amends?
Er... yes, is that right? What you said seems to have some merit; this time, I was a bit reckless. Well... I'm sorry.
Sect Leader, I don't know that your Iron Fist Gate hasn't received the money. Let's talk properly. I'm also often exploited by people, so I can very much empathize with your situation.
You little guy, weren't you quite dissatisfied just now? Why not go down the mountain with those people?
I admit defeat, don't hit me
I must tell my master! I'm going home to tell my master! You'll see!
I'm done! I'll just go down the mountain! What a mess, what's so great about it! Teaching martial arts is enough, but they still hit people!

Since joining the Tang Clan, this has been the first time you've been so far from home, and a certain amount of anxiety is inevitable. However, at this moment, your heart is filled with determination and ambition, burning with passion. Your six‑month study period at the Kongtong Sect has officially begun.
Hahahahaha! Alright, I'm off. Brother Zhao, get some revenge for us — treat this guesthouse like your own home and turn it into a smoky mess.
Fortunately, I drew the Iron Fist Gate! Heavens be praised!
How could that be? Not spraying the dishes directly with our backsides already counts as showing consideration for a fellow disciple.
Damn... this move is really too vicious.
Truer words were never spoken.
Now that's a solid move — whoever provokes the people who make the food is an idiot, asking to eat shit.

Through generations, it has become what it is today. If you encounter people from the other three gates who mock you, just ignore them. Report back to us, and we'll retaliate by putting nose mucus in their nice dishes.

The people of the four sects all need to eat; with more people, the demand for food and daily necessities increases. The other three sects were unwilling, and the situation escalated until the Iron Fist Gate made a concession, taking on the undesirable tasks that the other three sects refused to do. They lived simply, with just enough to sustain life.

That's not the case. Our sect's leaders through the generations have always been kind‑hearted. They took in people rejected by other sects indiscriminately, and over time, the number of people grew. Some are naturally lazy, just eating without working, which is very annoying.
Has the Iron Fist Gate always been treated so harshly?

This is our sect's newly built guesthouse; you'll be staying in the western sentinel quarters. You may stay there as you like. If someone calls you to join them for dinner in the mess hall, don't hesitate to go. If not, don't be surprised. When you hear the dinner bell, come to the construction site and join us for meals.
Ernan, take that kid Zhao to the newly renovated guesthouse. We're the ones who did the work, and we don't even get to enjoy it — this brat gets the benefit instead.

Oh, don't be so polite! This book is my own work; the handwriting is bad, so don't mind. That's all for today. You at least count as a guest, so when you're not working, you don't have to mix with us rough folks.
Thank you, Brother Lei
Calling the book they wrote themselves a secret manual—that takes real nerve.

Today, I'll teach you a complete manual that integrates our sect's External Skill with the art of smelting. You'll start learning on your own; if you have any questions, come to the blacksmith shop later, and learn by doing. The more you practice, the stronger you'll become! In a few days, I'll bring someone I know over to check on your progress.

This isn't even rough stuff! Damn it, aren't you here to learn martial arts? This is live sparring! It's a test! Watch me knock some sense into you spoiled brats who never worry about a living and treat the Jianghu as a game!
What! You, you dare to rough up disciples from other sects?!

Who dares to mention donations? I haven't seen a single penny! If you hadn't said anything, I wouldn't be angry. If there really were coins, it would be in that little girl from Mystic Skill Gate's hands, not for Iron Fist Gate to use! Brothers and sisters! Grab your weapons! We're about to fight!

You little brats, what are you saying?! Go on then, you little brats, get out! I'll tell you honestly, I was never in favor of this exchange-disciple business in the first place. But the Fire Dragon Old Daoist had already given his word, so out of regard for our fellow disciples, I had to go along with it.
Is this still one of the Six Major Sects? This is nothing short of thuggery! I'll make sure it's all over the Jianghu—that the Kongtong Sect treats its guests like slaves!

This brother is absolutely right. The Nangong family head clearly donated funds. If the Kongtong Sect didn't want to take part in this cause, why accept the donation in the first place? Since they've taken it, they ought to do right by it!

That's outrageous! We didn't come to the Iron Fist Gate because we wanted to. Even your own Kongtong Sect disciples, sent to study at other sects, surely wouldn't be treated this way! Gate Leader, words like that are enough to chill the hearts of every fellow in the Jianghu!
Participate in a riot
This gate leader seems to lack the dignity befitting his age, but he's a warm-hearted man.
What's all this about overstepping? Don't be so overly formal‑just be straightforward!
Since you insist, senior, then let this junior be so bold as to overstep propriety a little.
Good, Zhao lad, now that's straightforward of you!
Sure, Brother Lei! I'm Zhao Huo—please guide me well.

Don't call me Sect Leader—being one just makes this old brother feel like a fraud, and I've got no real skill anyway. I only took the job because I feared our Iron Fist Gate disciples would keep getting bullied by the other three gates. Just do as the others do and call me Brother.
This lad's name is Zhao Huo. Please give me your guidance, Sect Leader.
Good, you little guy, you're not bad at all. You're born with a fate of hardship, and it seems you fit well with our Iron Fist Gate. What's your name?
How could I dare, how could I dare.

This is what you said; don't blame us for not being hospitable when the time comes. I'll be straightforward; the funds from the Nangong Family's sponsorship this time haven't reached my hands at all. So you shouldn't blame me for being stingy.
That's fine; I'm in the Tang Clan and am used to doing odd jobs.
You little fellow, why aren't you leaving? I'm not here to play around. If you want to stay, you'll have to do something.
All the young Wulin members from various sects felt resentful upon hearing this, and soon left the mountain one after another.

Gate Leader Lei, I won't be staying any longer. Since you also say the Iron Fist Gate has no skills worth learning, everyone's wasting each other's time! All fellow Wulin martial artists, if you think I'm right, then let's go together!
If it's like that, this farce will end here. It's not that I don't respect your seniority, but I was born with a stubborn bone, unable to bend. Since I can't force myself, I'll take my leave!

Although unwilling, if I don't compromise, I can only return to the Tang Clan and never have a chance to rise again. I must endure humiliation and hardship. Even if the martial arts are elementary, at least there's someone to teach them.
Endure humiliation and bear a heavy burden

I always knew Old Master Nangong's idea was asking the impossible, pure fantasy. It's fair enough that the Kongtong Sect won't share its true teachings, but for the gate leader to make us work the fields ourselves—that's far too rude a way to show us the door.
Are you kidding me? What is this about?

I'm a rough man, I don't know how to beat around the bush, so let me say the ugly part up front. The Iron Fist Gate has no free food, drink, or grain; we can't play host to well-heeled disciples from prestigious sects. If you've come, you'll have to work to feed yourselves; otherwise, pack up early and go report back to your own sect.
Uh...
Then what else can be done? If I pretend to be something I'm not, what if someone among them has higher martial arts skills than me and beats me? That would be even more embarrassing, wouldn't it?
Sect Leader, don't talk yourself down like that!
By the way, although I am the sect leader, my martial arts aren't very good. I will still teach, but don't expect me to have any formidable martial arts.

Honestly, I don't mind if it sounds amusing to you, but the Iron Fist Gate specializes in the rough work nobody else wants: forging iron, trimming feet, shaving heads, tailoring, farming, weighing goods, selling oil, running errands, and the like. There are young ladies here too, so I won't mention the dirtier ones.

Rotten is rotten, that's all. Our Iron Fist Gate's days have been particularly wretched, that's no secret. No need to dress it up—if people are disappointed later, they'll only blame me for not being honest.

Sect Leader, Senior Martial Uncle, you shouldn't put it that way. Whatever the truth of it, don't use a word like 'rotten'—leaving aside how it makes us fellow disciples feel, what will our friends from other sects think when they hear it?

Hahaha, friends from other sects, this is truly embarrassing. Although it's not proper for me to say it myself, the Iron Fist Gate really is the worst gate in Kongtong! The other three gates dump all the people they don't want on us, so we've got more than our share of riffraff.

Since joining the Tang Clan, this has been the first time you've been so far from home, and a certain amount of anxiety is inevitable. However, at this moment, your heart is filled with determination and ambition, burning with passion. Your six‑month study period at the Kongtong Sect has officially begun.
Then I'll take my leave. Senior Brother Zhao, please make yourself at home.

While you're here at the Kongtong Sect, Senior Brother Zhao, you'll be a guest of our sect. I wouldn't dare trouble you with chores — your food and lodging will all be seen to by the Mystic Skill Gate. It's just that Kongtong has no shortage of skilled, unusual characters, so please be careful with your belongings when you visit the Colorless Square market.
No, I'm truly grateful for Senior Sister's kind reminder.
Senior Brother Zhao is a person of manners; it seems I was being overly cautious, my words were offensive.
Senior Sister, you worry too much. I know my place. Sect Leader Wei's graciousness to men of humble station is a virtue, but I won't be foolish enough to presume on it.
Brother Zhao, I did give you that advice — I hope you've taken it to heart.
......Oh, okay, I get it.

Sect Leader Wei is very polite to you, constantly calling herself 'this girl' or 'little sister.' But you, Senior Brother Zhao, mustn't grow used to it and start treating her as your equal, or I fear there will be no end of trouble.

Although the Sect Leader of our Mystic Skill Gate is young, her position is lofty, and she is held in high regard. Given her age and experience, that she can stand as an equal with the sect leaders of the other three sects says a great deal about who she is.
Senior Sister, please speak. I listen with utmost respect.
...I have a piece of good advice to offer Senior Brother Zhao.
Thank you, Senior Sister
This is the newly built guesthouse of our sect. Senior Brother Zhao, please stay in the Zhiming chamber to the north.
The disciple obeys the Sect Leader's decree. Senior Brother Zhao, this way, please.
Senior Sister, could you please take this Senior Brother Zhao to the guesthouse to rest?

Senior Brother Zhao, there's no need to stand on ceremony with me. I only hope Old Patriarch Nangong's wish truly comes true, and the Wulin knows no more strife. I have matters to attend to, so forgive me for not visiting every day — I'll come see you again in a few days.
Thank you, Sect Leader Wei, for your generous gift. I will definitely practice well.

The Iron Arm Divine Fist is a grueling art for toughening muscles and bones, much like the Songshan Iron Sand Palm. The Iron Fist Gate takes in people of mixed quality, with many coming and going, so there were inevitably some light-fingered sorts among them. That's why this manual already spread throughout the Jianghu, while the Iron Fist Gate's own disciples no longer know how to use it. Haha.
Iron Fist Gate's Secret Manual 'Iron Arm Divine Fist'

The Shadowless Claw is an Unorthodox Arms technique that every disciple of the Soul-Stealing Sect knows.
Nowadays they have the Iron Fist Gate forge iron claw gauntlets to perform it, though it used to be done with bare fingers.
The secret of the Frost Blade Breaking Bamboo Finger is also included in this very manual.
Soul-Stealing Gate's Secret Manual 'Shadowless Claw'

The Flying Heaven Kick is a Qinggong technique every disciple of the Flying Heaven Gate knows.
It's actually simplified from a more advanced martial art, the Immortal Crane's Elusive Fist.
The basic Crane Stance exercise is recorded right in that manual.
Flying Heaven Gate's Secret Manual 'Flying Heaven Kick'
Hehe, I somewhat abused the sect leader's authority, don't mind, don't mind.
Hmm? Can I?

This is the difficulty I mentioned.
But don't worry, Senior Brother Zhao — I can borrow a secret manual from another sect for you.
Then how do I practice? I can only stay here for half a year.

Even if it cannot yet emit sound, one can only accumulate days and months, quietly waiting for the Mystic Skill to gradually form. Disciples of the sect must complete a piece on the iron pipa to pass the trial, often requiring seven to eight years.

The Mystic Skill Gate excels in internal skills, and all disciples practice the Iron Pipa technique. Practitioners must stand on one leg, using their leg to support the Iron Pipa, which is the Crane Stance technique of the Flying Heaven Gate. To pluck the strings, they also need the finger strength of the Soul-Stealing Gate's Frost Blade Breaking Bamboo Finger.
What do you mean by that?

Within the Kongtong Sect, the Mystic Skill Gate oversees the scriptures above, and all household records, livestock, and finances below.
Senior Brother Zhao has come here to train, so food, clothing, and daily expenses are not lacking.
But if you wish to practice advanced martial arts, there's a small difficulty.
Senior Brother Zhao didn't even taste it, just drank it all in one gulp. How could he know it's good tea? Alas.
Good tea
You picked up the tea bowl, exhaled slightly to cool it, then drank it all in one gulp.

and now that I have his own letter of instruction, how could I dare disobey?
Let me personally serve Senior Brother Zhao a cup of tea to apologize, then it won't be too late to discuss business.

How could I! Senior Brother Zhao, don't wrong an innocent person.
......You're still angry with them, aren't you?

Confucius said: 'Without learning propriety, one cannot stand.'
In my humble opinion, Senior Brother Zhao understands social matters far better than the other outstanding disciples of renowned masters, and is much more mature.
Sect Leader Wei, why do you treat me with such courtesy? I am indeed just an outsider disciple, as your senior sister said.
...I obey the Sect Leader's command.
Senior Sister, that's enough for now — please go fetch the twelve tea sets.
But—

Senior Sister, I dare not agree with your words. How can professions be divided into high and low? If they were, everyone would only wish to do respectable jobs, and how could we have the comfortable life we enjoy today?

Sect Leader, Junior Sister! You must never condescend. You are the face of the Mystic Skill Gate, while this person is merely a disciple from another sect. I heard he is also an outsider's disciple, in the end, he's just a servant.

Is no one serving tea? How rude of us.
Then, Senior Brother Zhao, please sit. Shall I personally brew the tea as an apology?
Don't say that, Sect Leader Wei is too kind.
Oh dear, I've had so much to attend to and kept Senior Brother Zhao waiting so long. Please forgive me.
Good, thank you for the trouble, Sect Leader Wei.
I will now have the disciples of Flying Heaven Gate come down to lead you to the guesthouse.

Senior Brother Zhao, allow me, a humble female, to speak a bit more. Flying Heaven Gate is located in the highest part of the terrain, with excellent scenic beauty; just need to be extremely careful, don't lose your footing.
Such is the will of heaven. Anyone else who wants to join Flying Heaven Gate will have to wait another half year.
Even if it's just so she can use me to needle those few who spoke rudely about her, it's worth it to me.

Sect Leader Wei really looks out for my dignity at every turn and always has my back.
I've never been cared for like this by anyone before.

Even if I wanted to show favoritism, it would mean persuading Senior Brother Zhao to join the Mystic Skill Gate instead.
How could I just hand such a talent to someone else?
Sect Leader Wei's verbal tai chi in that reply was impressive - it shielded me without leaving herself exposed. It left that guy nothing to work with.
This... I certainly know, Sect Leader Wei was just joking.
Haha, if you gamble, you accept the outcome - I didn't favor Senior Brother Zhao at all.
That's definitely a true immortal. What virtue does this guy have? How can he be so lucky! The opportunity to go to Flying Heaven Gate should be given to me!

Really?

This little woman can't say for sure. After all, I'm still young, and even if I live nearby, I lack the opportunity to witness the divine sword technique.
Actually, I'm also a bit curious
If Senior Brother Zhao doesn't mind, then I don't mind either.
You... how dare you interrupt the Sect Leader?

The special training lasted until dusk before a victor was determined. Both sides were exhausted, but they gained a lot of insights.

The Flying Stone Gang had had many dealings with the Tang Clan, and knew that you were the most proud and aloof of all—if they offered you money, you would surely refuse to accept it. So they went to Lu Weng and redeemed the deed to the Tang Clan's Outer Fort, returning it to its rightful owner. This would not only provide for the allies gathering for the Western Wulin Assembly, but also express something of an apology.

You fought the Shangguan family head's broadsword with nothing but your small sword, wave after wave of blade-strikes rolling in; you rode with the current and struck back off its own momentum, matching him blow for blow. Though he had long since retired and his strength no longer matched his prime, the Shangguan family's art was subtle and its force domineering, pressing in without mercy-few of today's younger generation could have withstood it even so. Worse, he meant to kill: what he unleashed was not the Cang Gang's Surging Wave Blade Technique but his hidden trump card, the Sagara Blade, cutting through churning waves with no way to dodge. Startled, you seized the instant his strike had not yet fully gathered its force and lunged in to cut it short. The blow still shook you enough to bring up a mouthful of blood, but in that same desperate moment you struck back, loosing hidden weapons to wound him in turn.

You alone went down to the Outer Fort to look in on your allies' wounds. With the fighting paused, the Wulin Alliance had withdrawn ninety miles as promised, but wherever the war had passed, countless fields lay trampled and countless houses had crumbled to ruin—so much for their boast of not touching a hair of the common folk. You feared the local elders and kin would blame you, but instead they spoke as one, all firmly behind the Western Wulin, and cared nothing for how many hands you had: chicken, duck, fish, meat, vegetables and fruit were all crammed into your arms regardless, everyone hoping the Tang Clan would eat its fill and gather strength before going off to give the enemy hell.

You're far from as easy to bully as you seem. The opponent grew more frightened with each battle, couldn't escape the combat circle to exchange a few polite words, and was knocked unconscious to the ground. Those women finally panicked, immediately stopped crying, no longer concerned with propriety, and raised their skirts to flee in disarray.

The Golden Light Divine Fist beat you and threw you into prison. You had meals in jail, while he gained reputation and became another great hero. Fortunately, Shentu Long testified, and your suspicion was quickly cleared. With the help of Tang Fang and Ye Yunshang, who paid to smooth things over, you spent only a few days in jail and suffered little before being released. Afterward, when you questioned Shentu Long, he looked completely confused, as if he had no memory of the incident at all, clearly determined to pretend to be dead. You couldn't beat him, knew you couldn't get justice, and had no choice but to swallow your anger.

This sudden misfortune is entirely Shentu Long's doing. But he saved you first, and you're deeply grateful, so you can only give up. The more you think about it, the more absurd it seems, and you can't help but laugh out loud. Shentu Long was taken aback, and he too couldn't help but laugh.

You've suffered this unexpected misfortune, grumbling resentfully; you can't possibly beat them, so scolding a few words to vent is fine. Shentu Long spread his hands helplessly, not even taking your complaints to heart.

The pilgrims to Qingcheng were endless, and many Jianghu individuals came to the mountain seeking to pay their respects or seek guidance. Upon hearing the commotion, someone immediately popped their head out, and upon seeing your esteemed presence, they felt a surge of joy: there was no need to think twice; it was clear who the bad person was. They didn't forget to announce their name before making a move to strike.
You're used to being framed by others; as soon as she calls you, you know you're in for trouble. Since you're going to have bad luck anyway, why not slap her first to vent your frustration?

He instantly hit on an idea—with one bound he darted behind you, seized the vital point on your back, and shoved you toward the three women. They collided with you head-on, and at the sight of your face their souls very nearly left their bodies; they screamed at the top of their lungs, accusing you of indecent behavior. Even though you had meant them no harm, they meant to vent their fury in full, dragging you before the authorities to see you put to death.

He instantly hit on an idea—with one bound he darted behind you, seized the vital point on your back, and held you up as a shield. His Internal Force surged into you, and you found yourself instantly frozen, unable to do anything but endure as the women rained fists and kicks upon you, until they, breathless with the effort, stormed off in anger.
Suddenly catching sight of a corner of blue robe, he realized you were nearby.
Even in his best temper, Shentu Long could not bear the annoyance, and evil thoughts surged within him. He quietly channeled his internal skill, intending to kill these women with a palm strike.

You were wandering idly through the mountains when you suddenly heard a woman's giggling laughter ahead—a group of gaudily dressed female pilgrims had latched onto Shentu Long, their conduct brazen and heedless of propriety. Seeing him flustered and trying to dodge them only spurred them on further.

After playing all day, you returned to Qingcheng Mountain Town, and your little sister Yunshang wasn't tired in the least — she still wanted to drag you off to hear some songs and have evening tea to rest your feet, then wait for the lanterns to light and the night market to open before charging into the fray once more, sweeping everything before you. When Yunshang wasn't causing trouble and was simply being sweet, she was utterly charming; having such a lovely companion left you flattered and overjoyed beyond measure — no matter how late, as long as you still had breath in you, you'd stay by her side to the end. The two of you traded a knowing smile, ready to blow through your entire life savings in one go, but Tang Fang stepped in and found an excuse to hurry you home.

Qingcheng's scenery is renowned for its seclusion and beauty, with ancient trees towering into the sky and flowers and grasses flourishing abundantly, making it a famed natural wonder. When you were unconscious and unable to travel, Ye Yunshang had no interest in sightseeing. Now that you've awakened, you must take this opportunity to roam freely through the hills and valleys, fully experiencing the landscape, ensuring this journey is not in vain.

You were angry inside, yet ultimately couldn't bring yourself to scold her, so you held your temper in check. This still failed to reveal your limits; Ye Yunshang secretly marveled at your self-restraint. Next time, she would have to think up an even nastier scheme.
