Not even a month—even working day and night without rest, by rights she shouldn't have improved this fast. Palace Mistress, is Shang'er's talent...?
...Mingyu, how long would you say she's been studying?

Yunshang acted out of character, fully immersed in learning the zither, to the point of neglecting food and drink. When her fingers were cut and bleeding from playing, you took her small hand in your palm and applied medicine to it.

Driven by curiosity, Yunshang lightly plucked a few strings of the zither. Charmed by her, the elderly Jinxiang Palace attendant called her over and taught her the basic fingerings. You were on edge, dreading that her being so well-behaved was cover for some scheme.

Practice is out of the question. You, this rascal, even have the leisure to listen to music? Xiaomei smiled and followed into Huayin Pavilion to keep an eye on you. Others asked her what instrument she was skilled at. She laughed and said you were her instrument; depending on where you struck it, different sounds could be produced, and she demonstrated on the spot.

You came to Huayin Pavilion to listen to music and cultivate your temperament. Long Xiang saw you come and was quite embarrassed, playing the wrong tune, and was whipped on her palms by Lady Wen with a whip. You applied some ointment to her.
I got one for you; go ahead and eat it.
You really are too greedy, aren't you?
It's the aroma of chestnut braised chicken legs! Wow wow wow!
Sister Xiang, what's wrong with you all of a sudden?
Nonsense! I've memorized this poem thoroughly. I'm not just good at swordplay, am I? What prejudice is this!
Every time you recite poetry, I always feel there must be a part that's mispronounced.
Good poem, right? I also like it.
Good poem, good poem
Fishermen's fires on the sandbanks, merchant boats in the smoke. West Garden and South Bank, ten thousand miles sharing the same quiet.
You don't live by Dongting Lake, yet you also know this poem.
I believe that those living by Dongting Lake must be able to recite it backwards with ease.
Ah, show-off, you rascal, why did you have to cut in? I could recite it myself!

Fishermen's fires on the sandbanks, merchant boats in the smoke. West Garden and South Bank, ten thousand miles sharing the same quiet. This is the poem A Night at Dongting Lake by the Tang dynasty poet Li Duan.

In addition to that, if you have nothing to do, you can also take a boat to tour Dongting Lake. There is a Tang poem that says: White water connects to the sky at dusk, rushing waves carry the sun's flow. High winds on Yunmeng at dusk, the moon fills Dongting Lake in autumn‑
Who can't do that? What are you so smug about?
And I can sing folk songs.
I'm rather clumsy—I can only play the xiao, and not even that well. As for pipa or zheng technique, no matter how hard I try, I just can't learn them.

It's a place for playing the qin, performing music, and studying instruments. Master requires all palace attendants to practice at least one instrument to help balance body and mind. The most gifted senior sisters can even play four or five.
Oh, so that's how it is. What about Huayin Pavilion?
He'll end up prim and mincing. If you're not afraid of being laughed at, go ahead and learn it, by all means.
What if a man learns them?
Master said, the martial arts of Jinxiang Palace are all learned by women. Whether or not they are from Jinxiang Palace, women who learn them can defend themselves and need not keep it secret.
Are you afraid that other sects will steal your martial arts?
Wuying Hall is where palace attendants practice martial arts; you might as well go and observe.

The academy, as its name suggests, has the Jinxiu Pavilion as the weaving workshop and the Fragrant Dew Pool as the female bathhouse. Don't wander around recklessly in these three places; if you get scolded, I won't care. Don't worry about bathing; every evening, hot water will be prepared for foreign male guests, allowing you to bathe in your rooms.
Long Xiang led you through the academy, Wuying Hall, Jinxiu Pavilion, Xianglu Pool, and Huayin Pavilion. All the way, they talked and laughed, and the palace attendants were amazed at the sight.
Let's go too, take a stroll and come back, perfect for having lunch.
Then you just take the Young Lord for a stroll around. Senior Sister, I need to go attend to something.
Alright, alright—your sister will make good on this promise eventually.
Then let's save the clay-pot cuisine for another day.
Once every two or three days, it's not that rare, after all.

Little Brother, the chestnut-braised chicken legs at Jinxiang Palace are a marvel too. Being so close to the lake, we mostly eat fish and shrimp—chicken is a rare delicacy we only get once every two or three days. You really must try it.
Sister Xiang is locked in a battle between conscience and desire.
Lunch is about to start. There's braised chicken legs with chestnuts, which you love. Still going to eat out?
Little Brother, your sister has treated you so many times—this time let me host. I'll take you to the famous local restaurant for clay-pot cuisine!
That's true.
You've grown up here since childhood, how could you not know? What nonsense!
Senior Sister, I volunteer! I'm very familiar with Jinxiang Palace.
Long Xiang
That's settled. If there's any good news, I'll let you know later.
You're being way too honest about that.
Others may not believe, but my Junior Sister Long will probably believe it, because she's very stupid.
That's too suspicious, isn't it?
I can pretend to be curious about you, using it to probe her feelings and see if she gets nervous.
It's a pity.
I really can't do it after all! I can't! Forget I said anything.
You're really caught in a struggle between heaven and man, marvelous. You dare to administer medicine, I dare to take action.
I could... wait, no, I can't, but...
This...
Are you going to help me poison her food?
What are you going to do to help?
But Sister Xiang is so beautiful — if Lady Sheng's words have set her heart aflutter, wouldn't it be a fine thing to bring her into my fold?
Although I have no romantic feelings for Sister Xiang...
Oh, so... then, please, Young Lord, forget what I said. Farewell.
No need to bother, Sister Xiang is fine, but I have someone in my heart.
Whether you call me despicable or not, if the Young Lord has feelings for her, I am willing to lend you a helping hand.
A young woman's heart truly is hard to guess — is it always this complicated?

Young Lord, I truly hope you are as good as my Junior Sister says you are. I hope she really does have eyes as sharp as they say, that she's found a true hero, and that her heart belongs to you. I don't want to see her as a rival — I don't want to hate her.
Ugh, we just met, why would I tell the Young Lord all this? Really, really embarrassing! I'm leaving.
...Yes, that's right. People are like that.
Even though he's gone, I still keep him in my heart — I don't want anyone else remembering him. Selfish, unreasonable, overbearing: I know myself well enough. But isn't that just how the heart works?
I know, I know. Don't say it.
My Eldest Senior Brother has already...

Hmm, on a cold night by a lonely lamp, he arrived lightly, two liang of wine in hand. We might call ourselves confidants — except he knew my heart, while I never knew how many other women's hearts he held.
Does Lady Sheng know my Eldest Senior Brother?

Junior Sister Long and I are both favored by the Palace Master, and we get along well. But... I can't help envying her, so bold and open-hearted. When she speaks of you, my heart settles; when she mentions Young Lord Tang, it tightens.
......Yes, right. No matter how you think about it, it's the latter.
Is Junior Sister Long really interested in you, or is she using you as a decoy, with her true interest being Tang Buyi? Generally speaking, it's more likely to be the latter.
I might as well ask more directly then.
Shameless to the extreme.
Is that so? Haha, Sister Xiang's eyes are as sharp as a torch, truly remarkable.
Indeed, very humble.
I am truly ashamed and dare not accept it. Zhao is merely an ordinary person struggling in the mundane world; it's not worth the trouble.
Could my Junior Sister have fallen for this scoundrel's poison arts, his dark sorcery?
N-no, that can't be...
Isn't that so? She's brought you up more than once, looking rather pleased with herself — as if of all the men in the world, you alone are worth looking up to. She mentions it wherever she goes.
Why would Lady Sheng say such a thing? How could Sister Xiang possibly take an interest in me.
{size=50}What!{/size}
I naturally know you two aren't blood siblings. What I mean is... after all, with looks like yours, Young Lord, how could my Junior Sister Long possibly fall for you?

You can't really believe that we are siblings. With her beauty, she must have inherited it from our parents. Do you think her parents, who are both exceptional individuals, could have given birth to someone like me?
Just friends.
It's you... you and my Junior Sister Long... what's your relationship?
Thank you, Young Lord, for sharing this with me. Sheng Xue takes her leave.
Isn't that right?
Is that so... that's good, that's good, that's just like him. The mortal world isn't fit to keep a man like that — a Flying Hero was always meant to fly.
......Eldest Senior Brother left so gracefully, as lightly as he had come.
When he passed, did it hurt? Was he afraid?
Who says it's not? Such a foolish person, there will never be another.
To run all the way to Suzhou for a handful of soil... it really does seem like something Eldest Senior Brother would do.

Yes, in the cold night under the quiet lamp, he carried two liang of wine and arrived gracefully. He listened as I wept and recounted my past, then resolutely went to my hometown, bringing back a handful of hometown soil.
...Does Lady Sheng know my Eldest Senior Brother?

Of course

You're welcome

Would you like to go boating on the lake with me?

Sheng Xue leads you to visit the Academy, Wuying Hall, Jinxiu Pavilion, Xianglu Pool, and Huayin Pavilion. She hails from Pingjiang Prefecture, and when she speaks, her voice is soft and sweet, making your heart flutter.
Then, Young Lord, please follow Sheng Xue
This humble one, Zhao Huo of the Tang Clan, kindly instruct me.

When I first arrived at Jinxiang Palace, I was very solitary, feeling out of place. Every night, I would carry a lantern up to the high tower to gaze at my hometown. The fishermen returning late at night on the lake thought I was kind, lighting lanterns to guide others, so the nickname spread.

The Young Lord has actually heard of me.
Please, don't call me that — do you know where this nickname came from? It's pure coincidence.
So you are Heroine Sheng, the 'Silent Night, Compassionate Lantern' — I have long admired your name. This humble one is Zhao Huo of the Tang Clan. Please guide me.

Wow, this person is a genius!
That wasn't chance, but my handiwork. While the Sect Leader wasn't looking, I secretly altered our sect's Secret Manual so our disciples aim their hidden weapons straight at people's money pouches.
Compared to that, today I picked up a lot of money during the chaos. The Flying Stone Gang members' wallets are too unreliable.
You wiped away the bloodstains and removed the Throwing Dart from your head.
Well... you've done well, Junior Brother. Today the two of us struck together and dealt the Flying Stone Gang a heavy blow to their spirit—the credit is largely yours. Come, let's get you patched up.
Excuse me, Eldest Senior Brother, you just mentioned something that's hard to let go of. You just said you have a conscience? Do you have the courage to look me in the face and say it again?
Although it was my idea, beating those new henchmen who don't know martial arts and only throw stones randomly really makes one's conscience ache a bit.
Who told them to bully you like that, the fools. Enough talk—go gather the juniors, and let's make good use of daylight on the road.
Oh... I never thought about these things.
That's even more reason to go back and show off. We'll spend money freely, making them envious and jealous. When your family wants to reconcile, we'll cut off our ties with them.
I was cast out of my family as a boy—what elders do I even have left?
Moreover, our matter hasn't even been approved by your elders yet.

Itching for a beating, are you?
Are you easily embarrassed?
A-anyway, just don't say that word. You know very well I'm easily embarrassed, yet you tease me on purpose.
Ow! I was trying to praise you—why hit me!
I, Zhao Huo, am truly fortunate, wise...
Alright, now let me see to you.
Go ahead
Yes, this lowly one will see to it without fail.

The Tang Clan brothers will arrive and need rest; I don't want to face the embarrassment of not having enough rooms. Also, we must have hot and steaming food and drinks prepared. We may not necessarily change horses, but you should have contingency plans in place to ensure thorough preparation.
Yes
No need for that; get up. What is this, kneeling in the middle of the street?
I beg your pardon, this servant misspoke. I'll slap my own mouth for it.
Don't call him Master yet; we haven't even married yet.
Okay
...Please wait a moment
Uh... Young Mistress, perhaps ease off for a moment—the master has come out.

Both of you take the silver taels to make arrangements along the way, greet the chamber president of the merchants' association, book the inns and guesthouses in advance, they must be the best inns, and all of them must be upper rooms.
Farewell, friends.
Farewell
I actually helped the sect leader! Father, Mother! I've repaid Kongtong's kindness in taking you in!
The sect leader bowed with clasped hands to thank me! I will be on a lucky streak for the entire year!
Thank you, everyone.
Respectfully see off the Sect Leader.
Respectfully see off the Sect Leader.
Good, thank you very much.
Overwhelmed with gratitude!

The Tang Clan can afford to take this journey at a leisurely pace — there's no need to rush. Should anything unforeseen arise, they can send word through a Flying Heaven Gate disciple skilled in Qinggong to arrange a response.
I hope so.
With A'Sheng as Alliance Leader, I'm quite at ease.

Young Hero Rui possesses a heart of benevolence and righteousness, and should be able to restrain the Wulin's heroes. Now that the Wulin has someone to stand above and judge right from wrong, there should no longer be innocent people wronged by mob sentiment.

Young Hero Rui is a man of benevolence and righteousness, and should be able to restrain the Wulin's heroes, so they will not pursue the Tang Clan. This journey can be taken at a leisurely, unhurried pace. Should anything go amiss, we will send a Flying Heaven Gate disciple skilled in Qinggong to bring word and arrange a response.
I just heard — a new Wulin Alliance Leader has emerged.
After you went down the mountain yesterday, there were further developments. Have you heard the news, Young Hero?
Yesterday, the Sect Leader led everyone down the mountain. There have been further developments — have you heard?
I'm just as grateful.
These horses and carriages were all arranged yesterday by Sect Leader Wei. I merely manage them on her behalf and dare not take credit for it.
A wife so virtuous, what more could the husband ask for?
Did you finish it yesterday?
These horses and carriages were all arranged by Lady Ju yesterday. I am merely acting as a caretaker and dare not claim credit.
My thanks for all your trouble, Daoist.

I imagine the Tang Clan members must be eager to return home, so I have prepared horses and carriages, and hired drivers as well. Our Kongtong Sect owes the Tang Clan a great debt, and this small gesture is far from enough to repay it. Please do not refuse, Young Hero.
Young Hero Zhao, good morning.

I imagine the Tang Clan brothers must be eager to return home, so we have prepared horses and carriages, and hired drivers as well. Flying Heaven Gate disciples have gone ahead to escort you, ensuring no one troubles you along the way.
This subordinate pays respects to the Sect Leader!
Daoist Danxiazi!
You two exchanged a bow and then parted ways.
Mountains high, rivers long — take care, and farewell.
Well, it's about time, then.
Hahaha!
Hahaha! Now that's a true brother!
Of course I will.
And does that cover the brothels too?
Afraid of you? Hardly. Just come on, then — this brother will see to all your food and drink!
Young Lord is willing to host a meal? Then even if the world is not peaceful, I will eventually go eat and drink for free.
Good! The great poet Lu once wrote: A Glass Spring Wine, looking afar to Wuyue. Someone from Nangong has long been curious about its flavor.

Your kind intention, Young Lord, this humble one has received. The days ahead are long — there will be time enough for you to make good on it. And since courtesy calls for reciprocity, I've brought along Mishan's famed wine, Glass Spring, for you to sample.
Jianghu at peace, is there really such a day?

Brother Zhao, you've traveled far and suffered for it. By rights, I of the Nangong should play proper host and keep you here a while to be entertained. This time I've failed in that duty — but once the Jianghu is calm again, Brother Zhao, we'll share wine and speak from the heart.
We'll talk about it when the time comes.
The way you talk... sigh.
Although we are not the Mud Cult, we are not incapable of being a match for ten thousand men.

You know the Tang Clan is narrow-minded and holds a grudge forever. None of us are as fiery-tempered as our Sect Leader, who'd travel a thousand miles for revenge, but we're not easy to handle either. If the Wulin heroes come stirring trouble on Tang Clan ground again, they'll live to regret it.
On account of the Eldest Young Lord's face, I naturally can't hold a grudge. But if the Wulin Alliance Heroes still refuse to stop, insisting on bullying the Tang Clan, that's a different matter.
They were temporarily deceived by villains, but with the new leader taking the helm, they should no longer err. The Nangong Family will also gently advise from the side.
No wonder they call you Master of Fairness in the Wulin — already here pleading for the Wulin Alliance.

Most in the Wulin pour their energies into martial training and have little learning to speak of — many can't even read a word, which makes them easy to stir up and quick to follow the crowd. In this matter, I hope the Tang Clan will be broad-minded enough to let it go.
......Thank you.
As the Family Head, I judge the Tang Clan to be potential friends to associate with. It's a matter of pride to have you as friends, don't you think?

I suppose you could call me a snob and not be far wrong. When I meet the capable and the righteous, I want to befriend them; the incompetent I brush aside without a second glance, with no patience to feign courtesy.
Aren't you afraid, Eldest Young Lord, that associating with us will tarnish the Nangong Family's reputation?
Is Young Hero Zhao intending to leave without informing anyone?

I know you probably won't listen to these words, but I have to say them or I won't rest easy. Even if you don't appreciate it, think of your injured Junior Martial Brothers and Sisters — with my Nangong Family's carriage to escort them, they can recuperate in peace along the way.

Sigh, the Nangong elders speak with one voice. As the newly appointed Family Head, this Young Lord truly lacks the power to overrule them all, and can only go along with it — while still clearing your name of the wrongful charges.
...By the way, wasn't your Nangong Family trying to force the Tang Clan to stay? What's this little drama now?
No matter.
Forgive the poor display, Eldest Young Lord.
I'll check the room to make sure nothing valuable is left behind; you can chat.
It was I who broke off the marriage — what is there left to say now?
...No, that gaze is exactly the same as before, rambling on, not at all concerned with others' opinions. To her, I have already become insignificant.
Is Ying'er intentionally being close to Brother Zhao, making me jealous and regretful?
As Shangguan Ying set about tidying your collar, her concern showed plainly, unguarded and utterly natural.
Look at you, you're already a grown‑up. How did you sleep, not even fastening your collar? Nangong Family Head is here; you can't be too sloppy, or you'll disgrace the sect.
What's with the "uh"? If you have something to say, ask me later — don't be so hasty you lose your composure.
Uh...
Since Zhao Lang has arrived, you men can talk. This tactless little woman will step aside now.

Talented Woman Wei isn't as easy to deal with as I am. A few light taps won't hurt, and even the biggest issue can be brushed aside. If she's really pushed to the brink, the Nangong Family will have to replace their patriarch again.
Is she really so unruffled about it? Does she truly not care at all?
I warned you for the sake of our old schoolyard friendship. Do as you please.
She's gentle and demure — nothing like you.
Don't push her too far, or she'll end up hitting you.
A graceful and virtuous lady is a gentleman's ideal match. She has no interest in me, yet I still enjoy listening to her speak.
Eldest Young Lord, can't you see that Lady Wei keeps her distance from you out of respect? Why make it difficult for her?
By the way, yesterday Kongtong's Talented Woman Wei also came to the horse market to buy a horse. In the end, she lost out to this Young Lord, but fortunately, we got to chat a little.
How could we possibly want to owe you a favor? If anything, Nangong owes the Tang Clan more.
We didn't want to owe you a favor, so we wanted to pay for the carriage and horse, but the Eldest Young Lord insisted on not accepting, leading to a stalemate.

Madam Shangguan sent people to the horse market early in the morning, but unfortunately, this Young Lord struck first and got the upper hand. I had already booked all the horses yesterday, hired the drivers, and paid in full with silver and goods.
Shangguan Ying smiled and gave you a solid punch—not too light, not too hard—then stood at your side.
It's not what you think, idiot.
You...
Brother Zhao, did you sleep well last night? I've prepared the carriage and horse for you.
Eldest Young Lord!
......I'll go out to take a look.
The guests outside asked this lowly one to see to it, and the tip's already been paid.
Where did we get the horses and carriages?
Gentlemen, the horses and carriage are ready.
Okay, I won't say anymore
Don't think you're the only one with backbone in the world, hush.
Forget it, if you don't want to change, then don't change. I'm just thinking of you all.
Do you think I don't want to?
Exactly, a true man doesn't change his name when he walks or his surname when he sits‑what are you changing? Senior Brother, why don't you change to a more handsome face?
I'm hurt, but I won't change. To explain why, it's because this worn‑out uniform is my pride.

The injured person who can't move doesn't need to hurry. You can still travel together, just change out of your uniforms and pretend to be commoners, to avoid having other Jianghu people challenge you.
Has everyone had enough sleep? The gourd is full of water; we're setting out back home.
Exactly.
You must certainly believe me; we are good friends.
Same to you.
Thank you, I will not let you down.
That much, I can still guess.
Do you read minds?
......I trust you.
Brother Ye was severely betrayed by his former villainous companions, and now he trusts no one.
Young Hero Rui seems to be a righteous gentleman, but one can never truly know another's heart and nature.
Oh dear, being praised by this famous swordsman like this feels a bit awkward.
You are too humble. In my view, you are indeed a true great hero.
It's him who's making a name for himself; I'm still just small fry in the Jianghu.
Did he really say that?
You and Young Hero Rui have a friendly relationship, right? He mentioned you more than once at the banquet, saying that you and the other hero have surpassed all expectations.
I just realized

I have made some progress in cultivating Internal Skill; not sleeping for one or two days is no big deal, so there's no need to worry about it. Speaking of which, do you know that Young Hero Rui has been appointed as the Wulin Alliance Leader?
You've really worked hard... But you've been running back and forth‑did you stay up all night?

Brother Zhao, I went back to Fengyu Mountain yesterday for investigation. I didn't leave until the lights on the mountain were turned off. The Wulin Alliance seems to have no intention of pursuing, so it seems we can be at ease for now.
No way, I'll just aim at someone else.
......My scheme to win Sister Xiang's heart has been exposed.
Good!
Sister Xiang, besides chicken legs, I also made four types of seasonings that can be mixed. Come over, I'll teach you how to eat them.
Sure thing!

Heroine Long......! No wait, you're A'Huo's elder sister, which makes you my sister-in-law too.
Can I call you sister from now on?
Uh...
Master said, a man who has a wife yet favors an outsider is unfaithful to his wife. Even if I am your sister, I must avoid suspicion and cannot make you appear unfaithful.
Sister Xiang, why bother with her? Xiaomei is just being childish.

......Very well, I promise you—Brother Zhao and I won't overstep the bounds of brother and sister.
We won't be alone together in a room, or do anything that would upset you.
Right, you flirtatious scoundrel are only worth one chicken leg, at best.
Xiaomei, don't be silly, it's just a chicken leg, let her have it.
It's as simple as asking you to stay away from my husband a bit. You're a noble Heroine; wouldn't you be content to be a second wife?
Really? Go on, go on, tell me.
If you want some, that can be arranged—but Mei has one small request.
Why are you staring at me? Am I being blamed for the chicken legs?
Truly, truly envious... The sisters back at the sect all say Lady Xiaomei's cooking is excellent—it must be delicious.
Heroine Long, the morning meal I made for A'Huo has soy-sauce chicken legs, you know?
Every word out of her mouth is about chicken legs. Looks like Sister Xiang has gotten her spirits back.
That's not necessarily the case; wherever there are chicken legs, there are chicken legs both day and night.
Who would sell chicken legs in the early morning? If there's lamb sausage, just help yourself to some and make do.
Alas, the morning market has no chicken legs.
Okay

Senior Brother, are you awake?
This backwater inn has nothing worth eating—the noodles have no oil, no salt, bland enough to torment a man on purpose.
We used the clan's funds to buy some food at the early market; everyone can eat a bit before we're back on the road.
No, I, I'm going back!
Alright, little brother, watch your mouth and keep your eyes in check‑don't keep looking around. If you don't go home to study, come help me.

Why does this young lady call him 'my dear Zhao'? Could they be husband and wife?
How could that possibly be! A fresh flower planted in cow dung!
Is it impossible to say yes or no?
Really...? You can't keep anything from me, or else we'll drift apart.
No
Oh no! Don't! Don't use the Iron Pipa Skill! You're committing domestic violence!
Af—afterward, please be sure to tell me all about it.
Whoa‑?!
They said some things that at my age I completely don't understand.
Don't be angry, I was just joking with you.
......Hmph! Hmph!
Exactly
......Are you smirking?
Why don't you say something!
I, I, I... what did I do?
Who would have known that you, relying on your strong Internal Force, would do such things to me...!
That's good... You intentionally scared me, you're so mean‑spirited.
Didn't say anything special
What did I say?
Yes
Zhao... Zhao, my dear, I drank too much last night... I didn't misbehave, did I?
Good morning, Lady Ju
My dear, good morning — your humble wife bids you a good morning.
This short, round woman has a nice face, quite adorable. But her eyes are a bit fierce. However, why is she dressed like this, holding an iron hammer?
Probably because I was too tired, I haven't slept that deeply for a long time.
Lady Bamboo, did you sleep well?
Good morning
This sister is really beautiful; how come she's so close to this ugly person?
Why don't you sleep a bit longer?
A'Huo Lazy Pig, you finally woke up. I went to the early market to buy some meat and vegetables, and borrowed the kitchen to cook something delicious for you.
Oh, how beautiful the little miss is. Such an ugly person, how could they have such a lovely younger sister? Could they possibly be from the same parents?
Yunshang, did you sleep well?
Brother!
Ah, how beautiful the Young Lady is, but I wonder which sect they belong to? I also want to seek a master.
Little Junior Sister, good morning
Good morning, Senior Brother

Please, in light of the little dishes I fried up to go with your wine last night — they weren't too bad —
be the bigger man and overlook a lesser man's fault; forgive him this once.
Still won't shut your mouth? Don't make me have your sister-in-law discipline you!

Brother, what's the use of reading? No matter how much you read, you still can't beat a Wulin master! Don't always treat me like a child; I'm thirteen now! I've read enough books. I want to become a great hero!

Apologies, Young Hero, don't mind. It's my younger brother. Our father and mother passed away early, and I've worked hard to support him in his studies so he can secure an official position. Who knew this boy is so unambitious, always daydreaming.
You little brat, what are you babbling about again!
When you listen to a storyteller spin a tale, don't you have to pay? My news is fresher and hotter than the Jianghu Bulletin! You want it for free—shall I report you to the authorities?
What money?
Done talking, pay up
It's a pity you departed too soon, unable to witness his heroic bearing.
It's okay, it's okay, go on
Are you crazy? What's funny about this?
I'm dying of laughter, hahaha!
Huh? Ah Sheng became the Wulin Alliance Leader?!

When Alliance Leader Nangong took office, perhaps nine in ten nodded their approval, with only one or two left unconvinced. But when Great Hero Ruisheng was put forward as Wulin Alliance Leader, the whole hall roared its approval. There was no help for it—such martial skill, such character, such graceful bearing—who could fail to admire him?

Afterward, Divine Constable Song Bei and Dragon King Blade Shangguan Sun ordered a grand banquet to honor the heroes of the Wulin, seating Great Hero Ruisheng in the place of honor. The Wulin folk lined up to offer him toasts.
Ruisheng.
Then let me enlighten you—remember his name well. From today, this name will ring through the Jianghu: Ruisheng!
I don't know
I just guessed
What? You already knew? And here I've been talking so long my mouth's gone dry!
Ruisheng?
Do you know the name of that young hero?
...I never imagined something like this would happen after I left.

At once, the Sect Leaders of the Six Sects and the Beggar Sect Gang Leader, even the Nangong and Shangguan families, set aside their old grudges and rallied as one under his command. Masters from every side stopped hoarding their secret techniques and answered the call one after another. The tide turned at once, and the Demon Cult's two Paths fled in rout.

But there stood the heroic and spirited, charming and gallant sword hero in white, blocking their way! He blocked their way! A single blade held off a million mighty soldiers—what heroic spirit! What peerless martial skill! Everyone was struck dumb at once, all thinking: where did such a formidable young hero come from?

He first drove back the Dharma King of the Hell Path with his blade, then turned to duel the Dharma King of the Hungry Ghost Path! Either of those two demon lords ranked among the era's foremost masters—let alone the two of them together! Who in this world could withstand their combined, thunderous strike? Even Alliance Leader Nangong himself might not have managed it!
White-robed? Could it be A'Sheng?

At the critical moment when the righteous were in peril, a graceful young hero in white raised his precious sword and let out a long roar. Transforming into a white dragon, he moved as if entering an empty realm, sweeping away thousands of enemies with his single sword. Amidst the chaotic array, he cut through the battlefield, carving out a bloody path straight for the head of the Demon Cult!
Moment was brief!
The Mud Cult's Six Paths are indeed each acting independently; it's not strange for them to fight among themselves. You say they are inseparable, but I don't believe it.

By contrast, the Demon Cult's two Paths were thick as thieves, snake and rat sharing one den, as if a horde of demons ran riot together. In an instant, they drove the Wulin heroes back step by step, plunging them into dire straits!
Don't interrupt
What does the Tang Clan have to do with this? It's their own business, suspecting each other.

The heroes of the Wulin, formidable as they were, could not withstand the Human Path's cunning schemes—treacherous plots and ambushes that dealt them grievous losses. Alliance Leader Nangong perished, and with the Tang Clan implicated, suspicion spread through every heart. The great sects and clans, left leaderless, could only fend for themselves, scattered like loose sand!

This rumor likely originated from the mouth of a righteous martial artist. It is true that the martial skills of the officials and soldiers are not as good as those of the people from the Wulin, but they are well‑trained and in group battles, they will not fall short compared to those from Jianghu.

Whispers spoke of the righteous and wicked factions fighting so fiercely that the sky darkened and the earth trembled, blood staining vast stretches of Dongting Lake. Though officials and Imperial Soldiers longed to intervene, they lacked martial arts skills and could do nothing but cower in fear at the sight of this battle.
I went down the mountain before that
What, weren't you at Fengyu Mountain too? How could you not know?
What...! Did such a thing really happen?
None of your damn business.
My life is mine. Whether I fight or not is my own freedom!
Charge out? What's wrong with you? Why aren't you fighting the Demon Cult to the death?
I was, but I managed to fight my way out safely.

After that, the Hell Path from Western Shu and the Hungry Ghost Path from Eastern Sea converged on Fengyu Mountain without warning, clashing with the Wulin Alliance in a battle between good and evil that shook heaven and earth and moved even the ghosts to tears. Were you there too?
That's too much! 'Spring back up'? Are you calling me some kind of pest?
Old man, one look and I can tell you're just some Jianghu nobody, aren't you? The kind that gets cut down by the righteous wanderers, only to spring right back up the moment nobody's looking.
I cannot agree to that. I am certain I will achieve fame as a great hero, but you may not live to see that day.
If you insist on getting involved in the Jianghu, we'll meet again if we have the chance.
Most of the Cang Gang members wear white... forget it.
Have you seen a shark? Ah～I see, you're from the Cang Gang? So you wear all blue and green, I've heard that's the color of the sea.
Ah, that's right, like a shark
I even tore down the wanted notice for Liu E, Dharma King Liu himself. That mouth of his is truly enormous.
You're treating a wanted poster as a collectible? That takes some nerve!

Tang Clan Flying Hero, the Ruthless Young Master, robbed the execution ground before he was even ten. After he came of age, he was wanted by the imperial court for a wrongful crime for a time. I secretly tore down the wanted posters from back then and kept them for my collection.
Hmm? Are you serious?
What are you talking about? I'm a die‑hard fan of the Tang Clan, right? Once I save up enough money, I'll also go to Shu to find a master!
Tang Clan's devoted follower
Oh

So all that hard training of yours is just third-rate stuff. Real mastery requires a senior's transmission. Otherwise you'd have to swallow spiritual elixirs and spiritual fruits — without deep Internal Force, even the most diligent practice just makes you a lackey. Do you get what I mean?
The master opens the door; the practice is up to you.
That's what gets me — I also dream of becoming a Wulin expert, a great hero. Why is it that with my good looks, no senior master has come to teach me martial arts, yet he has one?
So because Zhao Huo isn't good-looking, he can't dream of becoming a great hero?
Why does this kid have such a poisonous mouth? I don't even know him — is he normal?
I really want to chop this kid! No, I can't, I have to hold back. He's just a child, and he doesn't know any martial arts. If I touch him, the Imperial Court will not hesitate.
Damn it! This punk's asking for a beating! Ooh ooh ooh, my blade's already itching to come out!

Now that I look closer, you're pretty ugly yourself, but too bad your martial arts are so poor anyone can tell you're just a lackey. See, Zhao Huo's set a bad example for you ugly folk, giving you ugly men hope.

He looks so unattractive that he shouldn't have learned martial arts. If he were honest and decent, it would be fine, but he's exceptionally skilled in martial arts and shows off everywhere, making others uncomfortable.
You haven't even seen him, so why hate him without reason?
As for me not supporting the Tang Clan, it's because I heard that the current top master of the Tang Clan is very ugly. I heard his name is Zhao Huo.
Good, good, good
Rubbish! He's nothing like that! Don't you dare insult the man I admire!
Don't you know that the Tang Clan Flying Hero has always loved talking nonsense and visiting brothels?
Who, who said I wanted to go to a pleasure house?
What a remarkable ambition for someone so young to want to visit a pleasure house!
Is that so?

The Tang Clan Flying Hero, who appears without a trace and vanishes without a trace, travels a thousand miles a day, performing heroic deeds and upholding justice. He is one of the most famous young heroes in the Wulin. I want to become like him.
What does this mean?
I sort of support the Tang Clan, but I sort of don't, too.
Somewhat support the Tang Clan
I did warn you, you know.

Forget it, how could I be as dull and ordinary as you lot? I want to learn the strongest martial arts under heaven and shatter heaven and earth! I'll make everyone who looked down on me kneel and beg for mercy, kowtow and apologize!
Are you really not aware of the situation? If you haven't been hit, you're lucky. I advise you to stop right away.
Hmm... I really want to kill this guy. However, it seems I don't need to do it; let him go and annoy others.
I know that Wulin elders all appreciate bold juniors. I will continue to challenge others, and eventually, a Wulin elder will laugh heartily and take me as their disciple.

I'll just share my own opinion; you shouldn't get angry and hit me. I know you're from the Wulin and support the Tang Clan, yet I still dare to speak without holding back. How about that? Am I really bold?
Pfft, wishful thinking!
It seems somewhat reasonable.
That's not necessarily so; anyone with a mouth can lie. Monks can return to lay life, and villains grow old too‑you can't judge a person by reputation alone.

Those who do not support the Tang Clan believe that they not only use poison but also employ hidden weapons, which feels quite eerie. Master Shi Ming is the esteemed abbot of the Fujian branch of the Songshan Sect, known for his high moral standing, and would certainly not falsely accuse the Tang Clan without reason. I think there is a good chance that the Tang Clan is indeed up to no good.
Do not support the Tang Clan
And I am──
Yes, I will support them to the death.
Oh, you support the Tang Clan, don't you?
Tang Clan follows the Asura Path, yet it is a baseless rumor.
The Alliance Leader Nangong indeed died for Lady Wen......

Is that really true? I've heard that yesterday on Fengyu Mountain, Nangong Family Head fell to the Dharma King of the Human Path. Moreover, a high monk from Southern Songshan has accused the Tang Clan of following the Asura Path. Are all these things true?
We are from Fengyu Mountain.
Great Hero, looking at your attire, you must be from the Wulin, right? Then you must want to know what major events happened at Fengyu Mountain yesterday?
Brother, may I inquire what the news is?
You all look down on me, just you wait. Once I master martial arts and become a great hero, you'll see!

Enough, you little brat, stop dreaming of becoming a chivalrous hero every day. You're already past the age when you're supposed to be studying; if you don't want to study, at least be practical and learn to fight and kill like others do. If you have the time for such nonsense, you'd be better off carrying manure to fertilize the crops in the fields.

You can say whatever you like; I reckon you're trying to ask me for money, but I won't fall for that. Whether the Jianghu is flooded or dried up, what does it have to do with me? I don't have anything to do with the Jianghu.
How come you don't even want to know what happened?
My dear, let's go.
Shopkeeper, there's a major event in Jianghu!
What are you shouting about?
Extra, extra! Big news from the Jianghu!
Well done, that's what real warmth between folk looks like. Then how can I not drop by? At noon I'll bring some vegetables and meat to cook up at your place.
This shop was entrusted to me by my father-in-law; he showed me great kindness, and I'll guard it with my life.

Don't rush, everyone is from the same hometown. You're running an inn in this remote, impoverished area without making a profit, yet you still insist on doing it. The townspeople are quite admiring of your dedication, so they've been helping a bit. There's no need to be overly particular about it.

N-no, nothing's wrong. We've talked a lot; we should head back to the main courtyard. There are many people there, the Yang Qi is strong.
Great Hero Xie, what's wrong? You suddenly trembled and your face turned so pale?

But then again, how does she stay so young-looking? I heard the Flying Heaven Gate of Kongtong practices immortality cultivation‑did she also master some technique of eternal youth? Or could it be that she truly became a female ghost, her spirit still wandering the mortal world?
Now there's no problem; she's already twenty‑six or so, a mature beauty. I'm going to get married, and I won't be interested in her.

Thank goodness, thank goodness. It was thanks to your Eldest Senior Brother always picking fights with me, keeping me distracted. Otherwise, if I'd looked a moment longer, I might truly have fallen for her beauty's trap. Even a hero can't pass the beauty's gate‑the old saying doesn't lie.
I had just thought about it, and unexpectedly, I felt a flutter in my heart.
You've already said this three times.
W-well, even if she were to take the initiative and show interest in me...
Even if she proactively shows goodwill towards me...

Hmm, pity it's ineffective. I have studied martial arts and cultivated Zen with unparalleled composure, and romance holds little interest for me. Not to mention her heart already belongs to another; even if she were to show interest in me...

She is hailed as the first beauty of Jianghu, her beauty truly unparalleled, her eloquence and temperament particularly empathetic and warm. When she smiles gently, her presence is like a poem or a painting. Her nickname is Soul-Stealing Orchid‑as the name suggests, merely gazing at her can steal one's soul.
So Great Hero Xie also has a connection with Heroine Xiahou, the Soul-Stealing Orchid?
Since I first heard her name, she has been called the Soul-Stealing Orchid by the world. She is also hailed as the first beauty of the Jianghu. I wonder what kind of person she was before?

Besides those two, Xiahou Lan has become like a different person, cold and unsettling. Ah, thinking of it all fills me with sorrow. Life rushes by in an instant, swift as a white colt glimpsed through a crack in the wall; some come, some go, gathering and parting like duckweed on the water.

...I often get so angry my teeth itch at him, but we once traveled together too. Old friends of ours, a couple, married and went far off beyond the frontier to herd sheep. Now even your Eldest Senior Brother has passed on. I don't know when those two, so far beyond the frontier, will hear the news.

Should I follow his example, spend some silver, and have a resounding nickname made for me? Then little misses who don't know me might hear my nickname and start to yearn for me. I could find a mask and play mysterious besides. Maybe then I could get away with a thing or two.
So that's how this nickname came to be.
Refuse to comment
Eldest Senior Brother is indeed annoying; it's no wonder people are always looking to fight him. If I were strong in martial arts, I'd want to beat him three times a day myself.

Right! This nickname is excellent! Yet your Eldest Senior Brother heard it and turned sarcastic about it for days on end, calling me by it every time we crossed paths. Calling me by it was one thing, but he'd waggle his eyebrows and even burn incense to me like I was some idol. It drove me half mad!
That's the Wind God, indeed very formidable
It sounds pretty impressive

I wanted to erase that impression from people's hearts, so I needed a more formidable nickname. On someone's advice, I spent ten taels of silver to have a scholar craft me a new one, then spent another five taels to have it spread far and wide, and that's how I came to be called the Wind God.
This nickname sounds formidable enough, but it never sat well with me. Dragon in the Clouds is the nickname of Gongsun Sheng, a hero of Liangshan, not mine.
I used to read the Jianghu Bulletin, watching you two duel whenever you crossed paths, which was particularly amusing.
You actually know that.

Weren't you both equally renowned? People used to speak of the Twin Elites of Shu, Flying Heaven and Cloud Dragon. Flying Heaven was my Eldest Senior Brother, Flying Hero Tang Buyi; Cloud Dragon, naturally, was you, Great Hero Xie. Before you took the name Wind God, the Jianghu once praised you as the Liangshan hero, Dragon in the Clouds.
In the Wulin, when discussing the new talents from Shu, the first one mentioned is him. How could I accept that? I can lose to anyone, but I don't want to lose to him.
That's right!

Hearing you say this, I'm not at all surprised. Eldest Senior Brother is unpredictable. He always manages to appear at the right moment, either taking the spotlight or causing some ridiculous trouble, trying to drag you into it.

...Ever since ten years ago, when we first stepped into the Jianghu, he was always one step ahead of me. It's unclear whether there's an inherent destiny at play, but wherever I go, I can't escape him, always stealing the spotlight.
Calling him despicable is still polite; this person is utterly detestable and hateful. He always looks down on me everywhere, and now that he's won, he runs away.
I don't know what you're referring to, but if you say my senior brother is despicable, that's correct.
Yes
Your Eldest Senior Brother is really despicable.

After your earnest words, he finally let go of the thought and accepted that his lifelong rival was gone, now resting in peace beneath the Nine Springs. He uncorked the wine gourd — though no drinker himself, he took a sip in the Eldest Senior Brother's memory, then passed it to you for a drink. Fragrant as the wine was, neither of you had the heart to taste it; instead you poured it onto the earth, leaving it for the departed to enjoy.

Xie Wuchen stood motionless before the Eldest Senior Brother's grave for a while, saying nothing. After a long while, he spoke, suspecting that the Eldest Senior Brother was faking death and intending to dig up the grave to open the coffin for inspection.
......Please this way.
Take me to your Tang Clan's heroic martyrs' resting place, please.
Wine Gourd... could Great Hero Xie possibly be thinking...?
Don't shout, I came for this
Pay homage to the Eldest Senior Brother
It's your own fault for using such an enticing move. Take this!
What? You're willing to trespass on the Tang Clan's back mountain just to fight me?
Trade a few blows
What kind of nonsense is this!

Don't worry~ I cut across the mountainside, used Qinggong to climb upstream against the current, and hauled myself up with a grapple rope to reach the back mountain. Since I never set foot on the plank road you built, it hardly counts as breaking in.
Great Hero Xie! What are you doing here?
Please wait a moment
Ah, without realizing it, the sky has already darkened. It's also time to go back, isn't it?
Please
We've talked long enough; this young lord shall return to his seat now. I take my leave.
Very well.

Whether the marriage proposal succeeds depends on fate. As for the alliance, that is a matter for separate discussion. Though it is of great importance, there's no need to rush to a conclusion — let Brother Zhao first present the Immortality Pill, then take counsel with Third Hero Tang and Fourth Hero Tang; there's no hurry.
That makes sense
What did Brother Zhao mean by that? It's not that this Young Lord is asking you to secretly help me; clearly, it was you who first asked. I was only being honest in my response.
...I understand, but this is not something I can help with. I hope you'll forgive me.

If I, Nangong Shen, am fortunate enough to welcome Miss Tang as my true wife, I will honor her as an equal all our days, and see that she never wants for food or clothing, that she knows peace and happiness. I will make certain no one in the Jianghu dares look down upon her.

By contrast, Miss Tang is gentle and kind, pure of heart — she might well embrace Lady Yue with great magnanimity, and the two could live in harmony. Should the marriage proposal succeed, it would be a most fortunate thing. And even should my affection go unanswered — the falling blossom yearning, yet the flowing water untouched — it need not harm the bond between our two families in the least.

Ying'er has a fierce, jealous temperament; no matter how much Lady Yue yields to her, she cannot be won over. There is nothing I can do — Senior Shangguan purchased his official rank and holds noble standing now, far beyond a common son of the Jianghu. Fine words indeed — but isn't it just wanting the bear's paw and the fish both? No one can have both at once; there's no sense in that.
Disagree

I may not be of the registered lowborn, yet my station is humble, and I've grown used to being looked down upon. That the Young Lord would stoop to befriend me, and never once scorn entertainers of base birth — such generosity of spirit is rare indeed.
Agree

Ask yourself — if, as a man, I could not keep faith with a delicate, defenseless woman with no one to turn to, what trust could Nangong Shen ever command in this world? So Young Lady Yue — I will never betray her. No matter whom I marry, she must be brought into my household.
Though she is but a woman, she deeply understands honor and duty; mindful of my reputation, she is willing to take the lesser place as concubine.

The Eldest Young Lord, though debonair, was quite trustworthy. As a descendant of a prestigious family, he was entirely unafraid of the world's mockery for his scandalous behavior, remaining steadfast in his devotion to the courtesan.
Sigh, even as this young lord says so, it sits ill with my conscience — I am truly ashamed. I'm no wide-eyed young boy; what confidante of the opposite sex could there be?
Even you believed that? It was nothing but a convenient excuse.
Young Lord, didn't you say you and Lady Yue were merely confidants, nothing more?

Yet, this young lord's lifelong love is none other than Lady Yue. She is not only his confidante but also the one he deeply admires. There was a prior vow to free her from her lowly status, restore her to commoner status, and then take her into the house.
Miss Tang is as beautiful as a flower - what man could see her and not fall in love?
Since you asked this, I won't lie

Young Lord is chivalrous and affectionate; admiration indeed!

Other folk who seek out immortals run into trials they can't get past. Who else but the Eldest Young Lord, such a shameless philanderer, would dare covet even an immortal? No wonder her chariot won't descend for you.

Your intentions are far from pure, your head full of impure thoughts. No wonder the immortal saw right through you.

Sect Leader Wei is indeed a rare and extraordinary woman.

Kongtong Sect's Mystic Skill Sect Leader, Talented Woman Wei, combines the best of those other two. Brilliant without lording it over others, gentle in temperament, serene and refined - this Young Lord has admired her a long while. Pity she always keeps me at arm's length.

Ying'er was truly flower-fair and moon-bright in beauty; her temper wasn't endearing, but her looks were striking indeed. If not for Lady Yue's pregnancy, this Young Lord would gladly have taken her home too, alas. Pity there's no having it both ways.
It's really not impossible

A man who can't even keep from wronging his own woman - what right has he to speak of responsibility? I'm nothing like my father.
Young Lord, you truly live up to being a hopeless romantic - shouldering your family's reputation, yet still able to stand alone against the crowd, unafraid of worldly censure.
Sigh, what this Young Lord says is indeed against my conscience, and I feel truly ashamed. I'm not a naive and ignorant youth; how could I have any close friends of the opposite gender?
Even you believed that? It was nothing but a convenient excuse.
Young Lord, didn't you say you and Lady Yue were merely confidants, nothing more?
However, then she couldn't be married as the primary wife. I'll wed Lady Yue first, then bring your sect's Junior Sister into the household afterward.
That... that's true, actually. How did I not think of that?

How many unmarried female disciples does the Tang Clan have? Quite a few of them are beauties, too. Marrying one who isn't an only daughter would, if anything, lighten the burden on this young lord's shoulders.
Marry a different Junior Sister instead
Please

This... this seems...

My brother and Brother Zhao share a deep bond; their relationship is even closer than my role as the older brother. Given this connection, mutual trust is sufficient.

Thanks to my grandfather's far‑sightedness, he sent my younger brother A'Qian to study at the Tang Clan, making him half a Tang Clan disciple. With this opportunity, it's enough to serve as the bridge between the two families.
Nangong Qian

Why should I? How could I not want to protect her thoroughly? But I just can't do it.
Didn't you understand? Young Lord is saying, A gentleman does not take what others cherish.
......Young Lord, what nonsense are you talking about?

What did you say?
I cannot.

Please

...I understand, but I can't help with this matter; kindly excuse me.

If I, Nangong Shen, am fortunate enough to welcome Miss Tang into our family as my official wife, I will treat her with courtesy and do my utmost to ensure she has no worries about food and clothing, living in peace and happiness. In the Jianghu, no one will dare to look down upon her.

If the marriage proposal succeeds, it will naturally be an auspicious and excellent outcome. Even if the flowers fall with intent and the flowing water remains indifferent, it cannot in the slightest diminish the sentiment between the two families.
Only someone as gentle-natured and pure of heart as Miss Tang could find it in her to accept Lady Yue and live with her in harmony.
Even knowing Lady Yue fawns a little to please others, isn't that itself proof she wants to make someone happy? Such devotion beats Ying'er, who does nothing but nag.
That's true; not everyone is like me, who can tolerate her fiery temper.
Forgive my bluntness, but even the courtesans of the pleasure quarters — the chaste ones who sell their art, not their bodies — one still can't help being wary of their true intentions.
Sigh, what this Young Lord says is indeed against my conscience, and I feel truly ashamed. I'm not a naive and ignorant youth; how could I have any close friends of the opposite gender?
Even you took that seriously? It was merely a convenient turn of phrase.
But didn't you say you and Lady Yue are merely confidants of the opposite sex, nothing more?
Very welcome indeed.
I'm tied to my family's business, so when others are around, I naturally have to appear upright. But with you, Brother Zhao, can't I be a bit more relaxed?
Never thought you'd say something like that
They say even a hero finds it hard to pass beauty's gate — what kind of hero doesn't love a beautiful woman?

By comparison, Lady Yue was gentle and gracious, her voice always soft and low, delicate as a bird nestled close. In looks she fell a shade short of Ying'er, but in spirit there was no comparison at all — she could make a man lose his head entirely.

You and Nangong Shen, both suffering under Shangguan Ying's tyranny, forged a bond as close as comrades in arms. If it isn't you who is scolded most in all the world, then it's surely the young lord sitting before you.
This Young Lord fares a little better than you — she's not quite so bold with me.
Still hits people
Mmm, terribly fierce indeed.
Terribly fierce.
Agree
Haha!
Apologies, I couldn't hold back
Oh dear, you're taking the chance to mock me. A noble young lord like you, being so sly and sarcastic as well.
This Young Lord has lived a life of ease and comfort, and truly doesn't understand — but you, I daresay, know that taste all too well.
That's because you haven't experienced others' malicious insults, so you can't tell the difference.
Is being like a nagging old woman really any better?
At least she scolds people for their own good, which is different from the usual way of scolding. It's more like an old woman's nagging, sharp‑tongued, but her heart still holds good intentions.
I really like being scolded
You're overthinking, Brother Zhao. She looks down on everyone — and scolds whoever she doesn't like.
I get scolded by her often too — I thought she had it in for me.

Jiangling and Fujian are thousands of miles apart. Even though we've been betrothed since childhood, the two of us are apart far more than together. Every time we meet, we can't avoid a scolding. Scolded too often, who wouldn't grow disheartened?
That's it, exactly.
She is the kind of person who is straightforward.
In your opinion, does she seem like someone who is particular about time and place?
When she scolded you for associating with villainous friends, was your friend still present?
But does the name of concern give her leave to hurl abuse at will? No one wants to be berated head-on by their own betrothed, in front of family and friends.
Do you truly think this Young Lord has never considered that?
Miss Ying is sharp-tongued but soft-hearted — perhaps it's simply that worry clouds the mind. Who's to say?
I wonder, Brother Zhao, what would you think if it were you?

Ying'er heard the news and traveled a long distance to visit me. She didn't say a single word of intimacy and immediately flew into a rage, scolding me for not striving for progress, for spending all day with dubious friends, and thus being less skilled than others.
Ah... that masked villain seems to be Eldest Senior Brother.

It was only after her encounter with Lady Yue that Ying'er learned some caution and eased up a little. Let me tell Brother Zhao an embarrassing tale: a few years back, this Young Lord and my younger brother were beaten by a masked man right at our own front gate.
Is that so? I thought you were evenly matched.
Among peers, only the words of Sect Leader Wei of Kongtong can barely reach her ears. Even this Young Lord, in her presence, can only bow his head and yield.
This... this doesn't seem wrong, actually. Miss Ying really is fierce — quick to raise a hand at the slightest thing.

Ying'er is stubborn and headstrong, proper and well‑mannered toward superiors, but arrogant and rude toward subordinates. She is petty and meticulous, jealous and sharp‑tongued, and enjoys citing correct principles to lecture others with an air of superiority.
You've hit the nail on the head. However, none of this is the reason for my split with her.
......Bearing the weight of a family's reputation is truly no easy thing.

...I want to believe you, but it's hard. Who is Liu E, if not the foremost name on the Villains List? Once Ying'er fell into his hands, could she truly remain untouched? Even if I believe it, will the world? How will the world speak of me?
Liu E and the pirates did not touch Miss Ying; I can testify to this.

Ying'er is simply too beautiful — what man could help but steal a second glance?
I humbly urged her to give up trade, not wanting her seen everywhere in public.
She turned it back on me, scolding me for clinging to old ways — and it's not as if she's run into danger only once or twice.
But things turn to their opposite once pushed to the extreme — anything carried past its proper limit brings harm.
I had thought the Eldest Young Lord didn't get along with Miss Ying, yet here he is, speaking of her so fluently and to the point.

Ying'er's temperament is resolute and steadfast, and she carries herself with genuine substance — every inch a lady of a noble house; though a woman, she has no lack of spirited courage.
In talent, this Young Lord is not her equal, and gladly admits it.
In beauty, she is beyond compare, one of the finest women of this age.
I would like to hear the details.
......Since you're asking this question, I won't lie.

I won't hide it — the kindness of your gift of medicine will remain etched in my heart forever.
But to my eyes, the Eldest Young Lord has been rather harsh in what he's said and done toward Miss Ying.
How can I trust that you won't fail my Junior Martial Sister?

This Young Lord does not mean to trade on past favors, but if our two families were joined by marriage, the alliance would naturally become unbreakable.
I hope your esteemed clan will consider it carefully.
Is this the reason the Eldest Young Lord has come to seek a marriage proposal?
Oh, so that's the case...

This Young Lord knows his experience is still shallow, and no amount of earnest pleading could move the leaders of the six sects.
Since Uncle Shangguan has withdrawn from the Jianghu, the only path left is to ask Uncle Tang to come out of seclusion, so the Nangong Family and the Tang Clan may stand together, advancing or retreating as one.

Except for Immortal Qiu of Quanzhen, whose status is exalted, the new leader of the Kongtong sect has not yet emerged, but they are already among the three major sect leaders, with the heads of the three sects holding the highest status.
This is indeed worrying.

The Mud Cult's Six Paths each act on their own; even when someone is captured, torture draws nothing useful from them.
No one can say what the remaining four Paths might do, so we dare not let our guard down.

After the battle at Jiangling with the Beast Path, the Hungry Ghost Path and the Hell Path have grown restless.
Friction with the righteous sects of the Wulin has worsened, not to mention that mysterious Human Path still lurking beneath the surface.
Don't tell me the Mud Cult has made another move?
Preventing the Old Demon Cult from making a comeback is certainly important. But for now, the top priority should be addressing the Mud Cult.

The reemergence of the Thousand Lantern Tower of the Supreme Bliss Cult in the Jianghu‑I have also heard about it. I do not doubt it entirely, but since both the Qingcheng and Kongtong sects deny it outright, we cannot simply go to their doorstep without cause, based solely on the Tang Clan's account.
You are correct. The Supreme Bliss Cult and Thousand Lantern Tower are advancing fiercely. If we do not prepare early, I fear the Jianghu will once again witness a storm of bloodshed.

Now, Jianghu is in constant chaos, no one submits to another, competing for fame and profit, with families being destroyed daily. It is precisely the time when someone needs to raise their voice from a high place, urging the Wulin peers to unite and jointly resist the great calamity.
Eldest Young Lord, please speak.
There is another matter, please let me speak, Brother.

It is only right to repay a kindness.
The Nangong Family owes the Tang Clan a great debt, so this Young Lord has come — bound, like tied grass and a returned ring, to repay it.
Between peers like us, matters of honor are one thing, but debts repaid back and forth would never end.
If that's the case, that would be wonderful! This favor, Zhao will certainly repay!
Brother Zhao, you and I are peers in our friendship; I will not accept your bow, please rise quickly.
If we obtain this pill, the Sect Leader might indeed be saved. Eldest Young Lord, please accept my bow!

This pill truly is worth a king's ransom — though put plainly, that's no more than a single city. If it can save Uncle Tang alone, and through him revive the Tang Clan and give life to thousands of common folk, then this pill will not have been wasted.
The Eldest Young Lord is indeed righteous, so readily giving away this priceless elixir of immortality to others.

Brother Zhao, this pill is not for you — it is offered to Sect Leader Tang, my uncle.
The dead are beyond our reach, but the living we may yet aid.
This Young Lord knows nothing of medicine, yet I am glad to lend the Tang Clan what small strength I have, that our friendship not go to waste.
Such a precious Immortality Pill, why would you give it to me?
Unfortunately, my grandfather has reached the end of his natural lifespan; he passed away suddenly, without the fortune to enjoy this Immortality Pill.

The Qingcheng elixir known as the Void-Returning Pill.
This pill was obtained from Sect Leader Zou of Qingcheng, a gift to Grandfather on his hundredth birthday.
This is......

Is this place okay?

While the sun hasn't set yet, I'll go to the back mountain to practice a few sets of martial arts.
Can't let my martial arts skills go to waste.
Train at the back mountain
Even the trivial me knows how to fight back.
I am not the 'trivial' me; I am me.
You... you trivial—
So I will definitely not let the Eldest Young Lord have his way, both in official and personal matters.
Oh~ If you'd said so from the start, of course I'd have understood.
So long as the Tang Clan follows Nangong's lead from now on, once Miss Tang marries in, I promise she won't be treated unfairly - she'll want for neither food nor clothing.

What's wrong? Just say it!

Was I not speaking the truth?

You're intentionally making your words so unpleasant, aren't you?

Oh, I see.
Whatever you say.

Unfortunate for you, but compared to how the Central Plains Wulin would handle it, our Tang Clan values our own kin all the more—putting private ties before public duty is what we do best. My Junior Martial Sister can't be entrusted to a hypocritical, pretentious Young Master like you.
Hmph.
You have already taken up enough of my time. Whether this Young Lord becomes a worthy son-in-law of the Tang Clan is not for you to decide, so why waste more words? Please take your leave.
You...

How laughable—wasn't it you yourself who broke off that match with Miss Ying?

The true culprit is still under investigation, and no conclusions can be drawn until the matter is settled. Marriage alliances are made to unite the power of two great families, raising a voice for justice, and collectively resisting the Demon Cult.

Since the Eldest Young Lord does not believe our sect innocent, how can he form a marriage alliance with our enemies? Otherwise it would be a disgrace to the old master's spirit in heaven—would that not be unfilial?

How could there be none? The treasure of King Yue, how can one just ignore it! Even I want to sneak a peek at his little sister taking a bath.
It's just a legend from Jianghu. How is it that you, Fourth Junior Brother, a traveling merchant who roams the south and north, have not heard of these rumors?
I heard it all; someone mentioned treasure?
Moreover, they have the treasure map; why don't they retrieve it themselves? Eighty years have passed, and even if there really is a treasure, it must have long been taken by their ancestors.
That's true; one remark was enough to wake me from my dream.

Because this story has flaws. The strategy of having the soldiers disguise themselves as commoners and scatter throughout the mountains and forests is quite clever, but how many able‑bodied men are there in Zhuxian Town, aside from the elderly and young women? How can they fill the vacancies of the five route generals? I'm afraid that even if they emptied Zhuxian Town of its residents, it might not be enough.
How can you assert that it's fake? There might really be a treasure.
It might really be true
That's right! Eighty years have passed, and even if there were really treasures, they would have long been taken by their ancestors.

Ha, this is really interesting. Who came up with this? They really have a vivid imagination. If the Ye siblings truly knew where the treasure was, why wouldn't they just go and take it for themselves?
That's right
Don't you find this issue's story particularly entertaining? So far-fetched, yet told as if it were dead serious.
They are not trying to take anything; they just want to see Miss Ye bathe. It turns out it's not simply lustful, but rather to confirm that treasure map!
I understand now; no wonder the Three Fiends of Yan Pass are giving the Ye siblings trouble!

The Listening Cloud Sword in Ye Yunzhou's hand is irrefutable evidence; the Listening Cloud Sword signifies following the will of Yue Yun. As for the treasure map, it is engraved on his sister Ye Yunshang's body! Obtaining it would make one as wealthy as a nation.

Eighty years have passed, and the legends of Jianghu have surprisingly been revived. Now, the Jianghu is abuzz with rumors, claiming that the ancestors of the Diancang Ye siblings were former members of Yue Yun's old troops!

The Yin Tally has been lost in the Jianghu, and the followers of the Five Paths and their descendants are like wandering souls and wild ghosts, with their heroic spirits lingering to this day. Yue Family's Treasure is no longer known to anyone.

However, the day of the counterattack never arrived. After the Shaoxing Treaty, Jin Wuzhu sent envoys to secretly meet with Qin Hui, leading to the deaths of Yue Fei and Yue Yun at Fengbo Pavilion. Ultimately, the Song dynasty fell.

The loyal soldiers lie in wait in the wilderness, only waiting for the wise ministers to clear the ruler's side, to disperse the clouds and reveal the sun, restoring a clear and bright atmosphere to the Imperial Court. Yue Yun, once again holding the Yin Tally, climbs high and calls out, rallying the old troops to reclaim the vast and beautiful lands.
The strong men and common folk of Zhuxian Town, inspired by a sense of righteousness, volunteered to serve as substitutes.

In legend, King Yue knew he was destined to die, yet he did not give up. Instead, he placed his hopes for a counterattack in his disciples. Within five days, he reforged the Yin Tally. He commanded the Red Canopy King, Master Zeng Wen, Zhang Xian, Yue Yun, Xu Qing, and others to divide the main force of the Yue Family Army into five, disguising themselves as common folk, and to migrate south with the army, scattering throughout the Wulin as heroes and bandits.
Jianghu Bulletin: The legends of Jianghu are not as they seem.
The question arises: why defy the imperial order for those five days? Was it truly just to 'let the people of Zhuxian Town pack up their belongings' before moving south with the army?

King Yue knew the cause was already lost, yet he defied the order all the same. Only after five days did he withdraw his troops from Zhuxian Town, bringing the local people south with the army to settle them, before at last returning to the capital to face the emperor. The counties of Henan that the Yue Family Army had reclaimed soon fell back into Jin Wuzhu's hands.
This foolish ruler, this treacherous minister!

That year, Emperor Gaozong heeded the treacherous minister Qin Hui and set his heart on seeking peace with the Jin. He sent the Twelve Golden Plaques one after another to recall General Yue Fei from the front, and King Yue lamented: 'A decade's labor, undone in a single day.'
This special edition of the newsletter announces that King Wumu's Treasure has reappeared in the Jianghu!
Ohh...!
Oh.
While you eat, take a look at this newspaper; the content in this issue is quite interesting.
Ah, really? You've worked hard for this.
Huh? Is there something else? It's almost noon, and I just started eating.
Junior Brother, don't eat yet!

The whole morning slipped by, and only you, delayed by chores, had yet to eat a bite.
The kitchen table had already been wiped down, leaving you no place to sit, so you could only carry the cold steamed buns back to your room.
Me too! This is what we call heroes seeing eye to eye.
I need to find people everywhere to discuss the current content! How can it be that only I see it?
Is that a Jianghu Bulletin in your hand? Could it be...?
I apologize; look at me, claiming to be a cultured person yet acting so rashly. I've embarrassed myself in front of you... oh!
Cluck...! I injured you, Third Senior Brother!
Is anyone there?
Oh... is that true? This is incredible! I can't be the only one who sees this!
You bought the current issue of Jianghu Bulletin and are reading the newspaper.
After a long night of hard work, you return home only to be brutally beaten.
You ate my chicken! It seems you've forgotten what you went out for. How dare you come back without the chicken, intentionally looking for a fight.
...it rained heavily yesterday, and I got trapped, so I...
Afterward, Second Senior Brother offered the chicken soup to the sect leader, also mentioning your contribution to it.
...If Second Senior Brother really falls into the hands of Sister Tang Xian'er, would I be considered a traitor or a hero?
Very well, very well. On the day I marry Second Senior Brother, you will be the hero.
Chicken is here.
Where is the chicken?
Sigh, her martial arts skills surpass mine by tenfold, yet somehow I can't help but worry about her. I hope she travels through the Jianghu with more caution — it's wise to be wary of others.
Sister Xiang... what a graceful person. Her pure heart is like white clothing, untouched by any dust.
Sister Xiang... what a bold and straightforward woman she is.
...Alright, we shall meet again.

Yes, there's no rain now. I want to take Senior Sister to see the sunrise and find a good place to lay her to rest. Younger sibling, Senior Sister will come to find you next time. Until we meet again.
It's not even fully bright yet, are you really leaving now?
The heavy rain has finally stopped.
Okay... I understand.

Even his own junior martial brother says so; it seems this Tang Buyi is truly no good. Still, since a life is at stake, I must investigate thoroughly and verify his own testimony before taking action.
My senior brother is a lecher, and I don't know how many girls' reputations he has ruined. Sister Xiang, you must not let him off the hook!
My senior brother is a lecher; you must kill him.
Oh, I understand. I will investigate thoroughly and verify his own testimony before taking action.
My senior brother Tang Buyi acts in a free‑spirited manner, but he has a broad mind and will definitely not be like these lecherous scoundrels... or at least, he shouldn't be.
My senior brother is not a lecher
At this moment, I would like to hear your thoughts.
Rest assured, I will verify the facts and hear his own account in person. I would never wrongly accuse an innocent person, and I'd like you to be a witness when the time comes.

...your Tang Clan's Flying Hero, Tang Buyi, is also listed among the records.
Great, let's wipe out all these well-dressed beasts.
I see.

Before we set off, the Master gave us a list called the Flower Appreciation Order. It contains many notorious scoundrels who bully women, and we are to seek them out and verify the rumors.
