Don't speak carelessly like a crow; what if it comes true?
I believe you will soon become infamous in the Jianghu.
I believe you will soon become famous in the Jianghu.

This time, my fellow disciples and I are leaving Jinxiang Palace to roam the Jianghu. Besides pursuing our own goals, we also follow our master's orders to right wrongs and uphold justice, hoping to make a name for ourselves and for Jinxiang Palace.
Oh, speaking of which, I've been meaning to ask you about someone.
It's hard to tell what time it is now, but it feels like dawn is not far off. Sister Xiang, where will you go next?
That's what I mean — if you'd come a day earlier or a day later, we'd never have crossed paths. That's what they call fate.

Speaking of Sister Xiang, this matter is truly a coincidence. If my Senior Sister hadn't forced me to come out to handle things, if I hadn't encountered this sudden rain, and if those three wicked Young Lords hadn't happened to seek shelter in the temple, you and your Senior Sister wouldn't have just happened to chase in after them.
Just now, when life and death were at stake, I didn't receive such a heavy promise, yet I was surprisingly bought off with a chicken leg.
I ate your chicken leg, so our bond just grew deeper. Little brother, if you're ever in trouble, don't be shy — just tell your Sister Xiang, and I'll be there to help.
You have just been taught false scholarship — but since you've never been one to dig too deep, the poison hasn't taken much hold.
I see

I remember the first time I heard someone recite this poem; I was quite taken aback. This chicken really does have a fragrant aroma even in death, no wonder the old man with white hair sneaks into the study to have a taste.
It turns out that Li Bai also loves to eat chicken.
This is not a poem I wrote; it is Ode to Gallantry by the Poet Immortal Li Bai.
You're even reciting poetry now? Are you that happy?

If Long Xiang held a sword instead, you might not have noticed the subtlety of her technique — but with only a chicken leg, barely shorter than a Small Sword, one careless swing seems to carry the ghost of true swordsmanship. It leaves you, unexpectedly, with a flicker of insight.
Hmm? Did I?
...Did you just use a chicken leg to perform some kind of sword technique?
I've heard the Poet Immortal's swordsmanship is quite something too. If fate ever grants me the chance, I'd love to seek his guidance.
Steal my drumstick! I'd never forgive even the Poet Immortal for that!
You're far from it; even the Poet Immortal would descend and kick you, snatching away your drumstick.
Huh? Isn't that right? I thought it was originally like this.
Could you please refrain from altering Li Bai's poetry?
Though I die, a hero's bones stay fragrant; I shame no hero under heaven. Who was it, beneath the study window, white-haired still — poring over the Great Mystery... Chicken?
If no one told me about such things, how would I know?
You have to pluck it! Whoever heard of roasting a chicken without plucking its feathers first!
Pluck the feathers? Won't the fire just burn them all off anyway?
You wouldn't roast it without plucking the feathers, would you?
You're just like a real chef. Not like mine — mine always tastes of mud, and it's fishy, rank, and sticky.
It's just roasted, that's all
Master, your disciple has made the acquaintance of a remarkable person today!

Fortunately, while hunting the wild chicken I picked up some mountain mushrooms and fresh bamboo shoots too.
I always keep a pinch of salt on me — a splash of wine on top, and the flavor really comes alive.
Delicious...!

You looked around and picked up the chicken corpse that had been flung into the air during the fierce battle, trampled by others, and ultimately slid down beneath the altar. You took it outside to wash it clean again.
All right, just you wait.
I want to eat.
Yes, it's just a chicken. Heroine, why must you be so agitated?
A chicken!

I remembered I caught a pheasant today—already cleaned and dressed it, meaning to roast it. But then the fight broke out, and it went flying off somewhere. It's already cleaned, so it'd be a shame to waste it.
What happened?
Ah
Chicken
That's true... My senior sister's grudge has also been laid to rest. It was her dying wish, but leaving her lying out there exposed to wind and rain just doesn't sit right with me.
No, that's their family matter, so let's not interfere.
...Should we go find them?
I expect that woman fled in the chaos, and the Quanzhen Taoist went after her.
I don't have any righteousness or anything like that!
You're not afraid of ghosts, are you? Don't be scared; with an open heart, righteousness can suppress all evils. With our righteous spirits, ghosts and deities will be deterred!
...Could it be that they were taken by mountain spirits or ghosts to be eaten?
I didn't see them; as soon as we returned to the temple, both of them disappeared.
Did you just see that Quanzhen young Daoist and that lady?
Speaking of Miss Long
Um, what's the matter?
Sister Xiang
Sister Xiang
Speaking of Miss Long...
I don't know either; as soon as we returned to the temple, both of them disappeared.
Speaking of which, that Quanzhen brother and the lady who murdered her husband, what about them?
Daoist Priest and Young Lady
That's more like it.
I know.
So overbearing...
Naturally, I can tell from your height, and your martial arts.
Wait, how can you tell that I am younger than you?
Unless you are unwilling, from now on I will call you Brother Zhao, and you can call me Sister Xiang. How does that sound?

To be honest, I'm a newcomer to the Jianghu myself, and given my circumstances, I have precious few friends. I envy those famed heroes—wherever they go, people greet them with cupped fists and hail them as brothers.
You're still alive, which means you haven't been defeated yet.
I... I'm not as good as you think. I've never really overcome any scars.
I... I'm not as good as you think. I've never really gotten over any scars, and when I smile, it's awkward and ugly, not at all dignified.

My Master said the rarest, most precious virtue in this world is to endure suffering and still choose to treat others with kindness. My Junior Sister said that to smile openly while covered in scars is undeniable proof of rising above one's wounds. Only people like that are worthy of being my friend—Long Xiang's friend.
Am I not part of the latter?
It's hard to find, but not impossible; aren't you one of them?
Even those who are good‑looking should be approached with caution, and those who are unattractive should not be associated with. Does that mean there is no one in the world worthy of your friendship?
I know.
I have indeed suffered from bullying, but I would never harbor hostility towards others for no reason.
Isn't that just me she's describing? She wouldn't be taking a jab at me indirectly, would she?

As for those who are unattractive, it doesn't mean they are suitable for socializing. Constantly being bullied and insulted over time will lead to feelings of inferiority and a twisted personality, filling them with hostility towards others.
Few in this world can match the wisdom of my Master and Junior Sister. If I weren't convinced, I wouldn't have taken their words to heart.
Well said—your Master and Junior Sister are truly wise.
That's right
That makes sense.
Perhaps there is, but I cannot discern it; it's better to keep my distance respectfully.
This is a bit too sweeping, as if condemning everyone for the actions of a few. Surely there are people in the world who are both beautiful and soft yet have kind hearts.
I cannot agree
The soft-looking ones tend to care deeply about their appearance. Lacking any manly vigor, their minds are full of crooked schemes besides.
Because they are naturally good at winning others' affection, over time, they come to take it for granted, becoming arrogant and greedy, and are the best at deceiving others.
What does this mean?

When I left the palace, my Master and Junior Sister warned me especially to be wary of handsome men—particularly ones with a soft, delicate look, the kind who even pin flowers in their hair. Nine times out of ten, they're no good.
Then you will have to suffer the consequences.
I would rather believe that there are more good people in the world.
I have tried my best; who wants to be schemed against? But constantly being on guard against others is just too exhausting.
One should be more vigilant when navigating the Jianghu.

Oh, back in Jinxiang Palace, I'm really just ordinary and nothing special. My Painting Immortal Senior Sister, and... a certain Junior Sister, are both far more beautiful than I am—you'd better believe it.
Is this what you call not bad? Have you considered my feelings?
My Master told me to be careful when making friends out in the world, since my looks are decent enough.
...You have such poor judgment in people; navigating the Jianghu will surely lead to losses.
You worry too much. Skill and looks are trivial matters. Among people like us, isn't a chivalrous heart and an unwavering sense of justice what we prize above all?
Of course I'm willing! I'm just afraid you'll think my martial arts are poor, unremarkable, and that I'm ugly to boot. Even I have a bit of self-awareness, after all.

Naturally, nothing would please me more, but I... well... heh, I really feel rather unworthy of it. After all, my martial arts are poor, and I'm not much to look at either. I do have some self-awareness, at least.
I helped you out first, and then you helped me. So we owe each other nothing; we should consider ourselves friends. Do you agree?
What nonsense are you talking about? You make it sound like I'm some kind of female Mountain Bandit.
Female... female monarch?
Otherwise, how should I address you?
Then how might I address you properly, so as not to seem discourteous? Please, enlighten me.
Why do you still call me a Heroine? After going through such a hardship, it feels a bit distant to be addressed that way.
Title
As long as you don't do anything wrong, why should you be afraid of me?
I have no objection when it comes to others, but if I'm ever unlucky enough to anger you, Heroine, please be sure to give me a chance to explain myself.
Heroine, you take it too seriously — I never wanted such a promise.

Alright, you don't need to say anymore. I'm just starting out, after all. They say you don't gain wisdom without experiencing something firsthand. I promise that next time I get into a fight, I won't even give them a chance to scream.
I-I know what you're thinking. You're definitely thinking: if I hadn't wasted time talking and just stabbed him dead, he'd have had no chance to pull any more tricks, right?
If you truly showed no mercy, you wouldn't have waited for him to beg for mercy — one stroke of the sword would have ended it, and none of what followed would have happened.

It's hard to say, hard to say. My master taught me: until your opponent draws their last breath, you must assume they still have a signature move in reserve. So once you're in the right, you can't hold back when you strike — mercy to others is cruelty to yourself.
I don't think he had the strength left to counterattack. Even if he'd landed the blow, he'd most likely have just turned and run.
If you hadn't pulled me back, I might have been blinded by the lime powder, and that Wicked Young Lord would have followed up with a fatal blow — I'd be dead.
It's just some lime powder; it won't kill anyone.
...Brother Zhao, it's all my fault for overestimating myself. This time, I owe you my life.
Yes! That's great!
Speaking of which, Heroine Long, you've stopped crying — it looks like your eyes are fully healed.
Heroine Long lit up with a smile just speaking of her master — she clearly reveres Lady Wen.
That makes a lot of sense, right? These are all things my master told me. She isn't only supreme in martial arts — her scholarship and insight are first-rate too.
Humility is an essential quality for the strong. Only by recognizing their own shortcomings can they strive for excellence.
Yes, really... I didn't expect Lady Wen to be so humble.

Her martial arts are naturally very high, but Sect Leader Tang is no slouch either. My master once said that if the two of them faced off directly, there's an eighty to ninety percent chance Sect Leader Tang would win.
Even Heroine Long, her own disciple, already wields such formidable martial arts — I dare not imagine how high Lady Wen's skill must reach.
Hmph. That's right.
Renowned indeed — her name rings in the ear like thunder.
Exactly
Is your esteemed master Lady Wen of Jinxiang Palace?

The skill of Listening to Momentum isn't only hindered by silence — Sound Wave Skill is also a natural enemy to it. My master is herself a master of Sound Wave Skill; the sharper your hearing, the more it's turned against you. Once she strikes up the pipa, anyone with the slightest weakness in composure can't even stand upright before her.
Naturally.
Then your Junior Martial Sister's martial arts must be exceptional.
Speaking of it, my Junior Martial Sister's Heaven and Earth Silent Force is a kind of soundless martial art. She wears seven strings of bells and flits about, yet you never hear them ring.

Because there are people in the world who created skills like the Silent Sword Technique and the Sword Song. By channeling Internal Force to affect sound, relying on hearing alone will never be as fast as seeing with your eyes.
Why is this?
Well, those who have refined their five senses to a certain Realm can often discern the source of sounds. However, relying solely on hearing ultimately limits one to a second‑rate level.
Can you do it?
Are you talking about Listening to Momentum? I can do that too.
I heard that there are people who are blind but can rely solely on their hearing to confront their enemies.
For a swordsman, being blind is like having one leg in the coffin. If one becomes blind to the point of lacking self‑awareness, dying on the roadside is just a matter of time.
It's just some lime powder; it won't kill anyone.
...Brother Zhao, it's all my fault for being so presumptuous. This time, thanks to you, I owe you my life.
What just happened
End

That's fine

I do want to sleep, but the sound of the rain and thunder is just too loud. Every time I start to feel drowsy, the booming noise jolts me awake.
The rain is roaring down, with thunder rumbling now and then—it's truly hard to fall asleep.
Aren't you tired? Why aren't you sleeping yet? I promise I won't disturb you anymore.

Alright, thank you, Brother Zhao

Who made you so reckless, rushing out without a second thought? It seems that it's not pure lime powder; I wonder what else is mixed in. If it's not too hot, shedding a few more tears to wash it away should be fine.
I can't help but tear up; it's not hot, not painful, just that.
If you open your eyes...
It still stings a little.
Does your eye still hurt?

She was startled at first, thinking you meant to harm her, but quickly realized you meant no such thing.
Quick, come with me.
I trust you, I trust you!
Miss Long, I am a disciple of the Tang Clan. I have a way to help you. Do you trust me or not?

When Chen Xu suddenly struck without warning, Long Xiang dodged just in time, and only a little lime powder caught her face.

Swept downstream and forced to swallow a bellyful of water, she still came away with her life and her eyes intact.
What you don't know is that she was born lucky and hardy — strong in body and stronger in fate.
This isn't about your conscience awakening; you're just afraid they might become ghosts and haunt you.
You return to the temple, and the woman who murdered her husband along with the young Daoist priest have both vanished, leaving you alone to silently pray for the souls of those who perished today.
...What a pity, such a beauty — what a wretched way to die.
...Amituofo, I truly have the will but lack the strength.

Long Xiang was terrified to the extreme and lost her footing, falling into the mountain stream. No matter how skilled she was with her Sword Technique, she could not contend with the forces of nature. The torrential rain and swift currents of the mountain stream swept her away in an instant, leaving no time for rescue.
Ahh!
Miss Long!
You, don't come over here! Go away!
We— we need to find cooking oil for her eyes, quick! But deep in these mountains, where would we even find it?
My eyes... my eyes are so hot! I'm going blind! Waaaahhh!
You mustn't!
Don't think I won't dare!

Hahaha! Your eyes are covered in lime powder — aren't you afraid of going blind in the rain?
Why not come catch me, then!
My eyes...!
Miss Long!
Ah! What are you doing?!
Young Lord Hero: Eat my lime powder!
No need, I have medicine with me, and I'm fine.
You're right, then. Sleep — I'll keep watch over you, and once dawn breaks we'll go find a doctor.

I was sleeping.
After tossing and turning all night, I only just started feeling better. It's only natural to feel tired.

I saw your eyes closed and thought you were still in pain.
It's all my fault for dragging you into this — I feel terrible about it, truly.
...Miss Long, you've asked me a dozen times already — I was asleep.
...Brother Zhao, Brother Zhao. Does your eye still hurt?
After a little more than half an hour, there were no major issues.

You were swept up in Long Xiang's arms and carried in a few bounds to the mountain stream to wash your eyes. You had already brushed off most of the lime beforehand, and the little that remained grew hot at once on contact with water. But just as you had foreseen, the ceaseless flow of water poured down, and the lime's heat posed no threat at all.
Thank you, Heroine.
I found a mountain stream; I'll take you there.
I understand, I believe you, I will go find it now.
If there is enough water, the cooling speed will be faster than the heating speed. I am a disciple of the Tang Clan; you can trust me.
Lime reacts with water and generates heat; it can damage your eyes.

No, don't worry about it. Rubbing oil on your eyes will make it worse. It's raining so heavily; please, Heroine, take a look around to see if there are any places where the rainwater is pooling, like a small waterfall, or even a pond would be fine.
After a chaotic ordeal, you are blind.
Long Xiang followed your instructions and roasted the chicken, enduring hunger without eating. As you commanded, she smeared the fragrant, oily chicken meat on your eyes.
Oh, I see! You're really smart!
I have a chicken; if I roast it over a fire, won't it produce oil?
Got it.
I, I know I need to use vegetable oil to wipe it. But where can I find vegetable oil at this moment?
I was hit by lime powder.
Little Brother, how are your eyes doing?
Long Xiang chased after them, and before long, a mournful cry echoed through the rain. Aside from the sound of the rain, there was no other noise.
Damn it!
Curse it!
Argh! My eyes! My eyes!
Eat my lime powder!
Be careful!
This person has a scheme!
I wouldn't dare.
If you want to run, it's better to give up on that thought early; I will be watching you.
I will take my own life outside the temple, so as not to trouble the esteemed Heroine. Once I am dead, let the beasts carry my corpse away.
Alright.
Sigh... at least let me end this myself, is that too much to ask?
Ha! Did you not consider that there are orphans and widows in other people's homes when you harmed others?
Wait! I, I haven't finished speaking. I still have orphans and widows to support at home in Lin'an...

This has nothing to do with you. Thank you for your invitation; my father is a hero of great stature, and as his daughter, I cannot covet fame and fortune, tarnishing his reputation. Therefore, I must respectfully decline. Young Lord Chen, your last words are spoken. Now prepare to die.
Who is the Heroine referring to?
...So that's how it is; it turns out someone has been sending messages calling for me, not out of good intentions.

The Great Jin established the Dragon Nurturing Courtyard and sent me to infiltrate the Central Plains, specifically to recruit and persuade the martial artists of the Song nation. Many have achieved great success through my mediation. With your remarkable skills, if I were to recommend you, you could become a female official in the future and amass wealth. Wouldn't that be wonderful!
This person is actually a traitor to the country.

...In my younger years, I faced disappointment in the examination hall and, in a fit of anger, sought refuge in the Jin Kingdom, where I finally encountered a wise ruler. Now, I am serving under the Lord Pusan Anzhen, the pacification envoy of Shandong.
Is that so? Very well, speak.

Wait! I, I still have great value; I carry a big secret that concerns the overall situation of the Wulin. Even if you won't spare me, how about letting me finish telling this secret before you strike? Consider it my last words.

Who you keep company with is none of my concern. You use sweet words to entice naive women into ruin, harming them for life, and now you've even killed a disciple of Jinxiang Palace. Do you still think you have a way out?
I admit defeat! I am a man of the righteous path, and I'm on close terms with Young Lord Nangong. You cannot kill me.
Long Xiang had just felt invigorated and was in high spirits, but upon hearing those words, she couldn't help but feel greatly disappointed.
Is that so? Sigh.

I have spent half my life honing my finger techniques, and now my fingers have been severed by you, my fan is broken, and my leg has been wounded by your sword. My martial arts skills are rendered useless, and I could bleed to death. You, what else can you say about sparring?
Young Lord Chen, your character is lacking, but your martial arts are quite good. Let's spar again.

She drew her sword, and he attempted to catch it. With a twist and a flick of her wrist, the Sword Song echoed as it severed his finger. Then, with three elegant flourishes, she balanced offense and defense, slicing through the fan and even carving away a piece of flesh from the Young Lord's leg. If these wicked women break through the encirclement, both the Wulin Alliance and the Song Court will lose face!
Amituofo, the Alliance Leader's obsession runs too deep. If he cannot sever this ill-fated bond, I fear he will bring ruin on himself and others.

{size=50}Yes!!{/size}

Are you still harboring grievances?
Otherwise? Su Yingxiang. Besides fame and power, what else can I pursue? You devoted your best years to him and expect others to submit to you?
Butchering the people of Jinxiang Palace — what good would that serve you, my lord? Shangguan Shangzhi, sacrificing virtue for personal gain is no wise deed worthy of praise.
Sister, this time you've been cleverly outwitted; you've invited the wolf into the house.

Exactly! As long as Uncle Shangguan is willing to act, Lady Wen will be unable to focus on her playing.
Without the Sound Wave Skill, this formation poses no threat at all!

Commissioner Shangguan, don't push so hard. Don't forget the two of you stand within this formation, cut off with no one to aid you.

How laughable—do you still deceive yourself?
I am an official, you a commoner; I am born of a noble house, you the orphaned child of a condemned traitor; I am a man, you a woman.

We have been friends for thirty years.

I am an official—my authority will not suffer some Jianghu rabble to test it. How dare you threaten me?

True enough—twenty years apart, without word or news between us, how could you know what kind of man I've become?

Why be so surprised? Aren't you the Dharma King of the Human Path?
You're so skilled at reading others' hearts—how could you not have seen this coming?

...Lady Wen, you heard that. The political arena is dark and difficult to navigate, not because Shangguan does not value old friendships. While our friendship is genuine, it still holds no weight for my career advancement.

Thus, Commissioner Shangguan, please forgive this humble official for speaking bluntly—do not let petty gain cloud your judgment and draw suspicion from His Majesty!
If you insist on having your own way, do not blame me for not warning you first: I will surely memorialize the Court and impeach you!
This matter could turn out serious or trivial, but I truly mustn't let my guard down.

Commissioner Shangguan was ordered by decree to pacify the Wulin—not to grant amnesty to the Mud Cult. This is outward compliance masking inward defiance; this is defying the imperial edict!

This wicked cult and their sorceress have ensnared Commissioner Shangguan into leading his entire sect to surrender—how could they possibly mean well? This is a trap!

If the Wulin Alliance suffers a great decline in its vital energy, then it will merely exist in name without substance. If Uncle Shangguan and I were to make our move -- I fighting the Painting Immortal, he fighting Lady Wen -- our odds would not be poor. But the trouble is, ruthless as Uncle Shangguan is, he is also a man wrapped around Lady Wen's finger. Would he truly give it his all?

The Shangguan Family Head has a profound Internal Skill. Even if he hasn't practiced Jinxiang Palace's 'Mysterious Candle Heart Sutra', he might still be able to resist. Palace Guardian monk, focusing fully on activating the Sound Wave Skill, the string sounds reached everyone present. Not a single soldier or warrior? Haha, how naive of the Eldest Young Lord.

...Even though array formations can be infinitely mysterious and profound, human energy has its limits. Though you might not fall in the short term, you will eventually succumb. Give up this stubborn resistance. If I encircle but do not attack, waiting for you to exhaust your energy, I won't need to deploy a single soldier or resource; the formation will disintegrate on its own.

Uncle Shangguan spoke too simply. This array's intention to change but not changing, its fluctuations indecisive, is not solely about seeking perfection without flaws. It subtly contains the principles of yin and yang, flowing ceaselessly at all times, much like turbulent underwater currents‑truly terrifying.
This Shangguan has only dabbled superficially in military studies and knows little of its finer points. Yet even I can sense, however dimly, that this formation is no small matter.

Commissioner Shangguan speaks plainly. Allow me to be frank with you. The Fenghou Formation in Jinxiang Palace has eight transformations and can repel a larger force with fewer troops. Though it cannot win outright, it can maintain an unbeaten position for some time. Even the powerful Sect Leaders of the Six Sects would find it impossible to break through the array without discerning its key points, no matter how much brute strength they wield.

Eldest Young Lord, what Lady Wen says is not unfounded. Let us set aside this fruitless quarrel. His Majesty tends to countless affairs each day and must keep his eye on the whole realm; governance depends on the court's many officials submitting memorials for his judgment. He cannot attend to every last detail himself.
This... Are you insulting His Majesty by failing to distinguish right from wrong?

The Son of Heaven sits high in his court hall; all matters of the Jianghu reach him only through his ministers' reports. Do you really think the Emperor can tell friend from foe with his own eyes? If the Eldest Young Lord can condemn a whole boatload with one sweep of the pole, why should the Emperor be any different?
We're every bit as much people of the Jianghu ourselves — by that logic, you, Eldest Young Lord, are one of our own too.
...You are all from the Mud Cult, like snakes and rats in the same den. Birds of a feather flock together, so you naturally bear the responsibility.
But what does that have to do with my Jinxiang Palace?

Never mind the Dharma King of the Beast Path who dared to incite the Beggar Sect to surround Jiangling and cause unrest. The evidence against plotting is irrefutable. If not for a united effort from the government and nobility, and later, Gang Leader Li, upholding righteousness by eliminating his own kin, wouldn't this have led to national disaster!
The Hell Path traffics in ghosts and spirits, peddling superstition and delusion. They plunder far and wide and abuse private punishment — utterly lawless!

Dharma King Liu E of the Hungry Ghost Path gathered pirates to run rampant across the East Sea, striking officials and tormenting the people. The court put a bounty on his head, and he tops the Wanted Notice as its number one villain.
Is Lady Wen saying that what your Mud Cult's Hungry Ghost, Hell, and Beast Paths have done doesn't count as evil either?
Commissioner Shangguan, hold on. This is spoken too soon.

Oh-ho-ho, if that's so, then everyone Jinxiang Palace ever saved should go kill themselves right now and pay back their lives.

Our conduct has been open to the scrutiny of all in the Jianghu, for everyone to see and hear. Do you really believe that everything we did before was false just because our beliefs differ? Is what you consider righteous truly righteous?

Once, Jinxiang Palace was part of the righteous, and the Imperial Court could still be tolerant and magnanimous. But now, you palace attendants are rebels, so naturally, you cannot be treated the same way.
Commissioner Shangguan, we go back a ways; let's speak plainly. If we were truly guilty of this, there'd be no need to wait until today to call us to account.
Jinxiang Palace defies Confucian rites, which goes against the foundational principles upon which our dynasty was established.

This palace wishes to ask the Commissioner — and the Alliance Leader as well — what grave offense we have committed, that the court and the Wulin Alliance hound us so relentlessly, refusing to show any mercy?

Shangguan Jun was a veteran of the Wulin accustomed to great waves and storms, while Nangong Shen was a man of both literary and martial talent, a standout among the new generation of the Wulin, with the air of a general. The two plunged deep into the heavily guarded area without any hint of fear, and everyone present couldn't help but give them silent applause.
Is that so? Forget it.
As for skill honed in officialdom, I have little else to offer, but keeping one's feelings off one's face is nothing unusual.
Commissioner Shangguan, you don't seem very shaken by my being the Mud Cult's Dharma King, do you?
I wonder, Palace Mistress, what instruction do you have for us, having summoned us here by name?
...good.

My father is the Wulin Alliance Leader, revered by all — a gentleman does not stand beneath a crumbling wall, so he could not come in person. I ask the Palace Mistress's forgiveness. Senior, should you have words to impart, this junior will listen with the greatest respect.
Is Nangong Yuan not coming?
This junior, Nangong Shen, pays his respects to Senior.

Lady Wen gave the command, and Fenghou Formation opened a breach in the array, allowing people to enter. The array then flowed and contracted immediately. This array had both an inner and outer layer; it was easy to enter but extremely difficult to leave, like trying to climb heaven itself. Unless one's Qinggong was absolutely supreme, enabling them to leap several dozen feet into the air, otherwise, it would be virtually impossible to cross the array's perimeter.
Sister Xiang... Sigh.
The situation is unclear; to avoid implicating the sect, I will refrain from making a statement for now.
Thank you all... otherwise, I really wouldn't know where to stand.
Before you clear your debt, don't think about running away.
...Th-there might be a little bit of trouble for you all, perhaps.
No one's competing with you on that.
Hehe, I won.
Besides Young Lady Ye, nobody else causes more trouble than you.
No?
I never did!
Please, you've caused enough trouble already. Now you're being polite?
But I'm afraid I'll drag you all into trouble.

Exactly. Miss Long shouldn't wander off either. If a fight breaks out and things descend into chaos, no martial arts skill, however high, can guarantee you won't get hurt. Better to stay with the Tang Clan, where we can look out for each other.
The innocent will be proven innocent, and the guilty will be proven guilty—let them say what they like. I've got hold of you now anyway. If you want to run, you'll have to kill me first.
Where else can you go? You stay here.
Ignoring the cold gazes of others, they took in Long Xiang.
Forget I said anything.
The words had barely left his mouth when he noticed the gazes of those around him, and immediately reconsidered his decision.
Tang Clan great heroes... can I stay here for a while?
Brother... Can I stay with you for a bit?

Don't rush just yet... Lady Wen invited the Alliance Leader and Shangguan Family Head to discuss something, didn't she? Let's observe their intentions first and avoid creating unnecessary trouble for ourselves.
Wh-what should we do, Senior Brother!
The numbers are too lopsided—even with that array, Jinxiang Palace's people can hardly escape death.

Although Jinxiang Palace holds the line for now with that array formation, the numbers are too lopsided. Even if Sun Wu himself were reborn, he'd find it hard to turn the tide. Jinxiang Palace is doomed to fall here.
And here I was thinking about switching over to Jinxiang Palace!
So these past few days we've been living in a demon's den? We thought it a land of tender bliss, but it turns out to be a dragon's pond and a tiger's den!
Jinxiang Palace Lady Wen is the Dharma King, Jinxiang Palace is the Human Path!
Chaos! Chaos! How could a peaceful Wulin Assembly turn out this way?

She had thought the dust had settled, never expecting the situation to shift so suddenly.
All manner of associations blossomed in Xiao Ju's mind, spiraling out of control—the more she thought, the more alarmed she grew.

Could the princess really not know? No... she must know.
Perhaps even this whole turn of events was arranged by the princess herself. But why...?
Is she going to abandon Jinxiang Palace?
Lady Wen is... the Dharma King of the Human Path!
Lady Wen is actually the Dharma King of the Human Path!
Something big has happened!
Don't run off yet; let's see the situation first!
A'Huo, stay right here—don't move. I'm going to help Auntie!
So what if they are? Wasn't the Tang Clan wrongly accused too? And yet you believe it the instant someone says so!
But they are from the Mud Cult!
We—we should hurry and go help the heroines of Jinxiang Palace!
Oh no, oh no! A fight is about to start!
With your words, I can come back to life even if I die.
...Young Lord, please also be careful.
...Then I shall trouble Eldest Young Lord to look after me.
Lady Firefly, don't worry. This Young Lord will handle it from the side, so there should be no mistake.

They dare not move against me; otherwise, the Human Path would be solidly branded with the name of rebellion. With Lord Song present, a single command could result in the complete destruction of all those in Jinxiang Palace.
Father, be wary of any deceit. As an official of the imperial court, you cannot risk your safety.
Eldest Young Lord, let's go.
Nothing I'd want more.
Do you have the courage to accompany your Uncle Shangguan on this journey?
Your child is here.
Shen'er, come here.
...Brother, what you say does seem to make sense.

Why not let your son stand in for you? He's the heir you've groomed with care—skill and courage he has in full, only experience is lacking. Isn't this the perfect chance? With me at his side, I'll see he comes back without a scratch.
If I do not intervene, how can we resolve this matter today!

Brother Yuan, no! To enter the array now is to cast yourself into disrepute! Everyone knows of your old ties to Lady Wen—as Alliance Leader, you must avoid suspicion! However you step in, you'll be faulted for it, let alone win anyone's trust. Do you still mean to hold the title of Wulin Alliance Leader?
Great! I'll be right there!
Wulin Alliance Leader, Commissioner Shangguan! Would you be willing to enter the array for a conversation? I can guarantee that the palace servants will not touch you with even a finger!
Who dares lay a hand on her! Not before they answer to this chessboard of mine!

If Great Hero Nangong were to act on personal bias, who would believe those lofty principles you just espoused? You may have a past with that witch, but it cannot stop everyone from tearing them to pieces!

We can trust the Great Hero Nangong! But you must not be blinded by lust and speak falsely! That Dharma King of the Hungry Ghosts, Hell, and Animals is a depraved and wicked fellow. As they say, birds of a feather flock together. This woman, associating with evil doers, surely harbors malicious intentions; how could there possibly be any misunderstanding?

Ladies and gentlemen, please bear with me; there must be a misunderstanding! Allow Brother Nangong to speak for a moment! As I know, Lady Wen is far from being a vicious person. Though Jinxiang Palace consists of women, they have always been at the forefront in doing good deeds in the Jianghu!
You be quiet first.
Oh well, one can't say it's entirely your fault.
Just so! Everyone knows the Human Path is best at toying with people's hearts! You lot of crooked heretics can't have a shred of good intent left in you! Stop putting on that false face!

You have the gall to say that? What shameless nerve! We poured out our hearts to you in friendship, and you witches harbored evil intentions all along, deceiving the heroes of the world to build your false reputation! Now that you're afraid, you want to play on our feelings!
We have retired from the Jianghu and shall no longer be involved in mundane affairs of the mortal world. Why must you press us so, great heroes? Do you not harbor any old feelings at all?

This is the true enemy of your great ambition: the preconceptions that overshadow humanity. It is the result of following the crowd, the false hatred instilled by others, the fear of the unknown, and sheer stupidity.

...Alliance Leader, listen and look. I only claim to be the Dharma King of the Human Path, yet these people want to kill me. When have they ever seen me do evil? I have clearly harmed no one, yet I am unjustly treated as an enemy, with the desire to kill me at all costs.
Surround the Jinxiang Palace guards! Kill this demoness! The forces of the righteous stand in opposition to the Demon Cult!

I always said a hen crowing at dawn was never a good sign! What equality between men and women, my foot—I say it means the nation is doomed, for demons always appear when a dynasty falls! In ancient times there was Daji and Bao Si, and now we have the Demon Cult's witch Su Yingxiang!
Still putting on airs of moral superiority, going about slaughtering tender-hearted men wherever they pleased—turns out they were never decent people themselves! Pah!

Are all the ladies at Jinxiang Palace witches of the Human Path? My dear heavens! I was hoping to marry one and bring her home to honor my ancestors! If I'd been ignorant and fathered a child with her, wouldn't the next generation all be Demon Cult spawn?

This time, the Dharma King of the Human Path lived up to his reputation for being upright and virtuous, seeking fame and praise. Whenever people in the Wulin mentioned Jinxiang Palace, they could only marvel and try to establish connections, which were out of reach. They never expected it to be associated with the Demon Cult! If not for Nangong Qian's revelation, the consequences would have been unimaginable.

With her own words confirming the situation, tensions escalated further. All righteous individuals felt a chill down their spines. They all suspected that the Dharma King of the Beast Path had infiltrated the Beggar Sect and was gradually eroding the foundations of the righteous with his insidious schemes. Ultimately, unable to contain his impatience, he revealed himself and suffered defeat, dying in the process‑considered a great stroke of luck amidst unfortunate circumstances.
The Second Young Lord of the Nangong Family spoke the truth. Jinxiang Palace is indeed the Human Path, and this Palace Mistress is the Mud Cult's Human Path Dharma King.
Are you truly a member of the Demon Cult, or have you been slandered by that Nangong brat? Don't be afraid - if you've suffered an injustice, just say so. None of us here are unreasonable!
Palace Mistress Lady Wen of Jinxiang, you owe us an explanation for this!
Since this is the Human Path, we naturally need to use methods from the Human Path. Humans are not beasts; it's because they possess reason. There is still a possibility for coexistence.
Thunder Over Mountain ‑ Regret in Excess, Water Under Thunder ‑ Await, Sky Over Water ‑ Need.
What do we do next? Should we try to deny everything, or break through and escape down the mountain?
Xiang'er... You spoke very well just now. We must know who we truly are. Don't forget your true self because of words others impose on you.
...Master, keeping something this big from me hurts this disciple deeply. This disciple will surely sulk about it for a long, long time afterward, so you'd best be prepared.
Ohoho, that won't do. How can you be so soft‑hearted? You have to learn from the ways of the Wulin, how to show no mercy when necessary. With your kindness, how will you survive in the Jianghu?
But I... I... can't bear to part with you all.
Are you going to obediently walk out on your own two feet, or be stubborn with me at this critical moment, wasting my energy and leaving me unable to protect the Palace Mistress later?
I won't do that!

You are not from the Mud Cult, so even if we do not help each other, just standing in formation is a threat. Later, when we unite to resist the enemy, we also need to guard against you suddenly upholding righteousness to eliminate your own kin.
This way please, Heroine Long~
Palace attendants, heed my order! Open the Gate of Life! Xian'er, escort Long Xiang out of the formation!
Then go outside. Don't be in the way here.
Of course not!

Jinxiang Palace has already disbanded. At this moment, only the Mud Cult of the Human Path is here. You are not one of us; what could possibly make you linger? Or do you, as the daughter of the Wulin Alliance Leader, wish to join the Mud Cult?
How could I abandon my master and sister disciples?

Lady Wen spoke while observing the expressions of everyone. Upon hearing the name Long Yuan, none failed to be moved. She remained wary of Jinxiang Palace, but when it came to Long Xiang, her face seemed to carry a touch of regret.

Though you are a disciple of Jinxiang Palace, you are not a follower of the Human Path. You are a descendant of Great Hero Long Yuan. Your father dedicated himself to righteousness and made contributions to the Wulin; everyone remembers him. Moreover, the Alliance Leader is benevolent and righteous, so he surely will not make things difficult for you. Go now.

Lady Wen glanced around and met the gazes of those surrounding her. The respectful and regretful looks she had just received were replaced in an instant with hostile ones. Everyone's faces bore expressions of anger and resentment, waiting to hear her defense.
Why are you not saying anything... Quickly tell everyone that you're a good person!
Master, speak quickly! I will believe you unconditionally if you just say he is a liar!
Master, are you joking with me...? Is this some kind of topic or test? I grew up in Jinxiang Palace since childhood; how could I possibly not know who I am.
What...? What does this mean?
In all of Jinxiang Palace, you alone are not one of us.
I told you so
You are certainly not from the Mud Cult.
Master, isn't that right?
Nangong Qian, you speak utter nonsense! How could anyone be so wrongly accused of something out of thin air! I would surely know if I were a member of the Mud Cult!
Sigh...
Ohoho, so it's come to this after all.

This formation is derived from the Eight Array Diagram devised by the Three Kingdoms statesman Zhuge Liang. Although the righteous Wulin outnumber Jinxiang Palace by more than tenfold, they are nothing but a heap of sand, merely shouting and agitating. How could they break through this array? Thus, they were kept outside the formation, and for a time, neither side made any progress.

The Jinxiang Palace disciples were well-trained, and at the command they instantly formed a wondrous array - the heavens covering above, the earth bearing below, wind rising and clouds hanging low. Once the formation's key points were set, it flowed without cease; when one drew their sword, the disciples on every side moved in support.
Yes!
Junior Sister Xue'er, let's each take one of the Yin-Yang Eyes!
{size=50}Yes!{/size}
Jinxiang Palace disciples, form up in the Fenghou Formation - protect the Palace Mistress!
Don't try anything - stay away from the Palace Mistress!

Nangong Qian said this, and everyone dismissed it with a snort. Even Shi Ming's word alone could not make them fully believe it. But when Nangong Yuan read the letter, his face turned ashen, and that spoke louder than a thousand words. How could anyone still doubt it?
Alliance Leader, you are an old acquaintance of the Palace Mistress of Jinxiang Palace. I am certain you recognize her handwriting. You may examine the document for verification.
Evil creature, shut up right now!
Father, don't be misled by that witch's words; I know that's a mind‑possessing technique! Just now when she played the zither, it was to confuse your mind.
Impossible! Absolutely impossible! I, Nangong Yuan, can vouch for the Palace Mistress of Jinxiang Palace's character!

This... this truly is the Palace Mistress of Jinxiang Palace's handwriting, identical to the calligraphy and paintings she has done! This old monk holds her talent in high regard and keeps one of her paintings - I could never mistake it! Every line of this letter addresses the Dharma King of the Beast Path as 'brother', with an intimacy that is shameless and unscrupulous! This is truly the way of a demon!
I have private messages from the Dharma King of the Human Path and the Dharma King of the Beast Path as evidence! Master, please take a look!
If not, even as the Second Young Lord of Nangong, this old monk and the heroes of the world would not spare you.

Amituofo, Second Young Lord. The women of Jinxiang Palace are known for their chastity and honor; even if the palace disbanded, their good name would live on for generations. You accuse Lady Wen of being the Demon Cult's Dharma King - do you have any real evidence for this claim?

These words left the heroes on the mountain torn between laughter and exasperation, and not a few sneered outright. It was well known that the Second Young Lord was an illegitimate son who could never be presented in polite company, and had pulled no small number of foolish stunts that shamed the family. This time no one knew what flimsy rumor he'd swallowed, but here he was again, playing to the crowd.
Senior Brother, what are you doing? You mustn't go! Do you want to make yourself everyone's enemy?
My dear, you must not! Once you make a move, it will inevitably implicate the Tang Clan and Kongtong!
Brother, calm down. Why are you stopping him?
No! Even someone like me can tell that if you go now, it'll cause a disaster!
A'Huo, you fool. If you charge out now and don't let him speak, aren't you clearly showing you're with the Mud Cult!
Oh no... oh no! Second Young Lord, stop talking!
Oh no... oh no! Fool, stop talking!
Oh no... oh no! A'Qian, stop talking!

There's not a shred of falsehood in the saying that every pitiable person has something hateful about them! I even felt sorry for him - turns out he's just a fool, slandering the innocent with baseless accusations!
This boy is talking nonsense! Everyone in Jinxiang Palace is so good!

Heroes present, never allow Jinxiang Palace to descend the mountain! Their lofty image is merely a facade; in truth they harbor filth and corruption most vile! As for why - because Lady Wen of Jinxiang Palace is none other than the Demon Cult's Dharma King of the Human Path!
Nangong Qian pressed his palm to his chest and took several deep breaths, mustering up the courage before speaking loudly.
You must be Senior Brother Xie Wuchen, the famed Wind God of the Central Plains? I've also come to pay my respects to your Sect Leader, but first I must test Young Lord Nangong's Dashing Fan.
Young Hero Yuan, the Emei Sect Leader wishes to see you.
Yes! Thank you, Brother!
If I hadn't made myself bait, when would you ever get the chance to speak? So spit it out already! Once they swarm us, we'll both end up as paste.
Brother Yuan, weren't we not supposed to say that?
Very well.
Junior Brother, go and invite him over for a talk.
He was talking about Martial Uncle Yuan Chengfeng?

Young Lord, don't be so anxious — I know what you want to say: 'Who in the world might you be, esteemed sir?' Let yours truly answer that first: my name is Yuan Wuxian, of Emei's Wu generation, the same generation as Sect Leader Xiang. It's no surprise if you haven't heard of me, but surely you've heard of 'The Strange Ape in the Wind,' Yuan Chengfeng.
What did you say!
No! You, you want to take credit for my achievements again. Ever since we were young, everything good has gone to you, and I've had enough of it!
What's going on? Tell me first.
This concerns the fate of the Wulin. Don't— don't try to stop me, or I won't go easy on you even if you are my elder brother!
Wow! When did his martial arts become so powerful? Just now, why was he taking hits without retaliating...?
What are you rambling on about? Stop it right now! Grab him.
Today, I, Nangong Qian, dare to accuse someone before all the heroes of the world gathered here — to expose an earth-shaking secret!
{size=50}Hold on!!{/size}
Lady Wen is indeed a clear-thinking woman.
Can we also retire and withdraw from the world?
Is that so... That's good then.
Who says we are not together anymore? We're just not dancing with blades and swords. Friends remain friends, family remains family.
Senior Brother... Will they not be together anymore? I just feel it will be very lonely.
Are you considered a person of the Jianghu?
I also want to retire from the Jianghu.
No wonder Lady Wen wants to commission a carriage from me.
It's probably too early; it's not yet the right time.
...A'Huo, when are you going to retire from the Jianghu? I want to take you somewhere.
Yes... Eldest Senior Brother has always tried to retire from the Jianghu, but he never managed to pull it off.
Being able to retire from the Jianghu safely and without incident isn't such a bad thing, really. Otherwise, when would it all end? What's wrong with a stable, peaceful life?
Although those from the Jianghu who had a friendly relationship with Jinxiang Palace were unwilling to see her go, they did not try to detain her, instead offering her many blessings.
The attendants in the Jinxiang Palace on that side seemed unsurprised, instead appearing relieved as if a heavy burden had been lifted.
I was thinking that if the Tang Clan couldn't accommodate me, I could still seek refuge at Jinxiang Palace. How... how is it already breaking up?
...Did Jinxiang Palace really disband like this?
Ah... a heavy burden, and such a long road ahead.
...Nangong Yuan, I hate you. But we all believe you will change this mortal world. Congratulations on becoming the Wulin's Alliance Leader.
So you have the duty to remember us, bear the aspirations of everyone on your shoulders, and dedicate your entire life.

These names of people might be forgotten in another decade, but you must not forget them. Everyone yearns for your wild yet beautiful vision, willing to sacrifice their heads and shed blood for it. From today onward, you must fulfill your promise.

......It has been a long time since anyone mentioned them. Most of these friends are no longer among the living. Even if they are still alive, they have gone their separate ways, each pursuing their own path. Whether we will meet again in this life is uncertain.

There are also Master Yixin of Songshan, Master Liaofan, Tang Yi from Shu, Tang Mian, Tang Keren, Youxianzi of Qingcheng, Xu Zilian, Yan Shiru, Iron-Gall Duke of Kongtong's Iron Fist Gate, the Quanzhen young Daoist Sima Zhiqi, and the Jiangnan courtesan Su Yingxiang.

Can you remember Shangguan Jun, Dragon King Blade, your cousin Nangong Yu, Lin'an Young Lord Shen Duchang, Qu Zhenzhuo, burying himself on Mount Changbai in memory of the Liao orphan Yelü Jinghong, Xiao Qinglan, and the Beggar Sect's Thousand-Gold Elder, Master Li?
...it's Brother Wen and Little Sister Wen — your husband and sister-in-law.
Do you still remember Wen Wuwei, Emei's Seven Transformations Divine Hand, and his sister Emerald Flute Fairy Wen Wuxia?
That was my lifelong friend, how could I forget?

You've come this far with so much effort, and you're now saying such lackluster words. Do you think the position of Alliance Leader can be renounced just by your own say‑so? Don't you remember Commandant Dingyuan Wang Chunxiao?
Then let me step down as Wulin Alliance Leader instead-you needn't dissolve Jinxiang Palace.
...As Alliance Leader, you mustn't behave so unseemly.
No, no, don't go.
I disbanded the Jinxiang Palace and vanished far away. From now on, I will no longer compete with you. You can rest assured without worry; isn't that delightful?

They are all independent individuals, and they don't need me to constantly remind them; they will find their own way. Those who still cling to Jianghu can do as they wish; anyway, I will no longer get involved in this murky water. If Alliance Leader is reluctant, how about offering them more support?
Yingxiang, you... are you serious? Jinxiang Palace shelters women with nowhere else to turn, a haven every woman under heaven longs for. If you dissolve it, where will its women go?

Jinxiang Palace is the pinnacle of clarity and nobility in the Wulin, standing above the Six Sects, with a group of women who can challenge the Three Great Families on equal terms‑truly beyond reproach. The ladies within are both scholarly and martial, talented and versatile, captivating countless heroes. How could it be said to disband so easily?
These words sparked a commotion among the assembled heroes.
What!
Therefore, I dare ask the heroes of the realm to bear witness. From this day forth, I declare Jinxiang Palace dissolved. I wash my hands of the martial world and retire from the Jianghu for good!
You... I thought you would never forgive me.

......But to be fair, when it comes to speaking of today's heroes, who can match Lord Nangong in terms of wide‑ranging social connections and virtuous friends scattered across the Five Lakes and Four Seas, while also being a master in martial arts with a heart full of benevolence? Despite my unresolved hatred towards him, how could I bear to harm such a virtuous person for my own selfish reasons?
Sigh.

This palace bears an old, unresolved grudge against the head of the Nangong family-that we cannot live beneath the same sky as him is hardly news. Forgive Jinxiang Palace for refusing to serve him as Alliance Leader, let alone obey his every word.
{size=50}To all the friends of the Jianghu gathered here today!{/size}
Is that so... I see, actually I knew that.
We are drifting further away from our best days, unable to return to what we once had.
Everything comes at a price.
We cannot.
No, it's not like that. I just... sigh. I regret it. For twenty years, I have regretted my words back then. Can we go back and do it all over again?
To you, I am merely an item that can be easily given away.

When Sir Wen sent someone to the Nangong Family to arrange the marriage, how I hoped you would shield me, grow angry on my behalf. But you exhausted yourself, speaking kind words all night long-only to urge me to marry him.

You chose brotherhood over me, pretending to be intoxicated by wine and pleasure, trying to make me feel disheartened. I am disheartened, but not because of your poor acting. It is because you, this self‑proclaimed great hero, the chivalrous one, ultimately chose to abandon me.
Times have changed. I am no longer Su Yingxiang-never again will I let you win.

Long, long ago, Su Yingxiang had also asked Nangong Yuan this very question, begging him to guide her in chess. At that time, the young girl's eyes held a deep admiration, and she would often deliberately show weakness and try different tactics just to watch her lover display his prowess with gleaming spirit.
Yingxiang...

Senior Brother Wen is deeply devoted, but Nangong Qian's biological mother was merely one‑sided? Where's the difference? This is truly confusing. I am rather unintelligent, and cannot figure it out. Young Lord, could you enlighten me?
That... is Senior Brother Wen's profound affection for you, causing him to wither away for your sake....
I became Lady Wen, how could it not be due to your efforts to bring us together?
Ha ha ha, well said, Nangong Yuan.
That was her one‑sided fancy! How could you not know how much I hate her!
You've profited so greatly, and yet you play the delicate one? That child's mother loved you with her whole heart-you're so benevolent and righteous, why not cut your own flesh to feed the hawk?
Your kindness was a plot to harm me. The sleeping powder and the music confused my mind, leading me to sleep with his filthy and ugly mother for one night. This is how he came into being.
People have compassion in their hearts — even for a dog that's fallen into the water, this palace lady would still show mercy.
You came out holding an umbrella, and I thought heaven had taken pity on me, that I'd finally moved your heart.
When you refused to give me what I wanted, I eventually stopped caring about it.
I came bearing gifts — Guangling San, Timely Clearing After Snow, Wind in the Pines Among a Myriad Valleys — treasures you once loved but could never have. And there I stood in the pouring rain.
Ah, I remember. That day seemed to be raining, and even though the bamboo fence couldn't keep you out, you still didn't dare to come in.
...After Brother Wen passed away, I went to Jinxiang Pavilion to seek you out. I didn't dare hope for a reunion — only to make amends.
You... ah.
How can it be enough? This hatred stretches on, without end.

He is not! You're using him as a pawn to get back at me. Every time I see him, I remember his mother's hateful face, and I can't hold back my hatred. Tormenting me for over ten years — isn't that enough?
Do you raise pigs? He is a person, your own flesh and blood. He came into this world because of you — that makes him your responsibility.
How pitiful can he be? The Nangong family raised him in luxury, ensuring he never went short on food or clothing.
You have wronged more people than just this palace lady, haven't you? Just look at your pitiful second young lord — it's enough to make anyone sigh.
You have grievances, and I understand. What happened back then was unfair to you, and I feel guilty for letting you down.
I had plenty to say, but now that I see your face, I can't be bothered to waste my breath.
...It's been so long since we last met. Don't you have anything to say to me?
You wicked person, they haven't owed you any money, why bother?
Fighting is great, I love watching a fight to the death.
Don't meddle in other people's business; let's just watch what happens.

Senior Brother, the Alliance Leader and Lady Wen are just staring at each other without moving. Everyone knows that their once harmonious relationship has turned into bitter rivals. It wouldn't suddenly turn violent, would it?
This is the reason I traveled a thousand miles to be here, and also the key to saving all living beings. Perhaps it is also your chance to gain someone's respect.
This is......
Heh, good boy. Since this is our first meeting, why not let this heaven-sized achievement be my gift to you.
Brother Yuan.
If I weren't truly his son, why would I go out of my way to falsely claim him as my father? Anyway, don't call me Young Lord or Young Hero — just call me Brother Yuan.
Now that you mention it, you really do look just like Monkey Brother. Could it be that Young Hero really is Monkey Brother's son?
The cheap master you call Monkey Brother is my father. Who do you think I am?
Wh-who are you?
You must straighten your back and make contributions so that they will take you seriously.
You're so useless; they naturally look down on you.
I am not Nangong Qian... I'm just a bastard. Everyone looks down on me, and even my father doesn't want me anymore...
That's right, let's go

Ah, that's enough for now. I still have to go back and hear how the Family Head handles things with Lady Wen. Second Young Lord gets a beating every day — that's nothing new — but a head-to-head like this only comes once in a lifetime. Far more worth watching.
Yes!
...If you want to discipline him, do it far enough away so you don't hit his face. Just in case he gets disfigured, bring him back to Jiangling and say he suddenly fell ill with a severe disease.
This...
Hey, today is the Wulin Assembly. Are you really coming to blows here, trying to make yourselves a laughingstock before all the heroes of the realm?
Yes!

This insolent brat, showing no respect for his elders! After him—teach him a lesson, beat him good and hard!
If anything comes of it, I'll answer for it!
...Get out, all of you!
Ah, I forgot; this boy was never taught by his mother.

The Nangong family is known for its noble character; even the servants are not to be scolded or struck on a whim.
Even the Second Young Lord can't make a mistake and just bow his head pretending nothing happened—where's the apology? Where are his manners?

Oh, it's just the Second Young Lord. Do you walk around with your eyes covered?
I was standing here minding my own business—why did you barrel into me?
Sorry, I did not see clearly... .
Widow Wen of Jinxiang Palace pays her respects to the Wulin Alliance Leader.
...Lady Wen.
This Palace lady is a widow, yet her chastity remains. I urge you to be careful and do not spoil your own reputation.
Yingxiang... You've finally come to see me. I have waited in such bitterness.
Is this how the Nangong family head—a man who claims benevolence and righteousness—treats his own flesh and blood?
Sigh... This is not your fault. But you might as well travel far away to open up new horizons.
I also want to become a Nangong clan member who can make you proud... .
They say my martial arts are not bad now, and suggest that I switch from using a sword to wielding knives instead.
I have a lot to tell you. I met three accomplished masters while out on my travels, and they taught me martial arts techniques.
Father, you are a hero of this age and treat everyone so well. Why are you so harsh on me alone?
You may withdraw.
I- I'll just stay in a corner... not make a sound. Can't I even do that?
...Father, do you really despise me so much...?

My mind is made up. You don't have to go to Diancang to learn swordsmanship.
Go to whichever sect you like—just don't stay in Jiangling vexing my spirit.

But... but Father, I hadn't the chance to tell you.
Actually, on my last trip out, I had one strange encounter after another, and met three accomplished masters... .

Every son of the Nangong family must keep the clan close to heart and make something of himself.
Jiangling already has Shen'er; your going to study at Diancang will be your way of lending the family support.

This... I— am I to go to Dali? But... but...
I've heard it's bitterly cold there, and the road is long and hard—going back and forth would be no easy thing. I'm afraid if I go, I won't be able to fulfill my filial duties...
Well, once they depart for Dali, you can go along to study there.
